title: Matthew 4:14
text: that that might be fulfilled which was spoken through Esaias the prophet, saying,

title: Matthew 4:15
text: Land of Zabulon and land of Nepthalim, way of [the] sea beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations:

title: Matthew 4:16
text: --the people sitting in darkness has seen a great light, and to those sitting in [the] country and shadow of death, to them has light sprung up.

title: Matthew 4:17
text: From that time began Jesus to preach and to say, Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn nigh.

title: Matthew 4:18
text: ¶And walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishers;

title: Matthew 4:19
text: and he says to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.

title: Matthew 4:20
text: And they, having left their trawl-nets, immediately followed him.

title: Matthew 4:21
text: And going on thence he saw other two brothers, James the [son] of Zebedee and John his brother, in the ship with Zebedee their father, mending their trawl-nets, and he called them;

title: Matthew 4:22
text: and they, having left the ship and their father, immediately followed him.

title: Matthew 4:23
text: ¶And [Jesus] went round the whole [of] Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the glad tidings of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every bodily weakness among the people.

title: Matthew 4:24
text: And his fame went out into the whole [of] Syria, and they brought to him all that were ill, suffering under various diseases and pains, and those possessed by demons, and lunatics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

title: Matthew 4:25
text: And great crowds followed him from Galilee, and Decapolis, and Jerusalem, and Judaea, and beyond the Jordan.

title: Matthew 5:1
text: ¶But seeing the crowds, he went up into the mountain, and having sat down, his disciples came to him;

title: Matthew 5:2
text: and, having opened his mouth, he taught them, saying,

title: Matthew 5:3
text: ¶Blessed [are] the poor in spirit, for *theirs* is the kingdom of the heavens.

title: Matthew 5:4
text: Blessed they that mourn, for *they* shall be comforted.

title: Matthew 5:5
text: Blessed the meek, for *they* shall inherit the earth.

title: Matthew 5:6
text: Blessed they who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for *they* shall be filled.

title: Matthew 5:7
text: Blessed the merciful, for *they* shall find mercy.

title: Matthew 5:8
text: Blessed the pure in heart, for *they* shall see God.

title: Matthew 5:9
text: Blessed the peace-makers, for *they* shall be called sons of God.

title: Matthew 5:10
text: Blessed they who are persecuted on account of righteousness, for *theirs* is the kingdom of the heavens.

title: Matthew 5:11
text: Blessed are ye when they may reproach and persecute you, and say every wicked thing against you, lying, for my sake.

title: Matthew 5:12
text: Rejoice and exult, for your reward is great in the heavens; for thus have they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

title: Matthew 5:13
text: ¶*Ye* are the salt of the earth; but if the salt have become insipid, wherewith shall it be salted? It is no longer fit for anything but to be cast out and to be trodden under foot by men.

title: Matthew 5:14
text: *Ye* are the light of the world: a city situated on the top of a mountain cannot be hid.

title: Matthew 5:15
text: Nor do [men] light a lamp and put it under the bushel, but upon the lamp-stand, and it shines for all who are in the house.

title: Matthew 5:16
text: Let your light thus shine before men, so that they may see your upright works, and glorify your Father who is in the heavens.

title: Matthew 5:17
text: ¶Think not that I am come to make void the law or the prophets; I am not come to make void, but to fulfil.

title: Matthew 5:18
text: For verily I say unto you, Until the heaven and the earth pass away, one iota or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law till all come to pass.

title: Matthew 5:19
text: Whosoever then shall do away with one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, shall be called least in the kingdom of the heavens; but whosoever shall practise and teach [them], *he* shall be called great in the kingdom of the heavens.

title: Matthew 5:20
text: For I say unto you, that unless your righteousness surpass [that] of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no wise enter into the kingdom of the heavens.

title: Matthew 5:21
text: ¶Ye have heard that it was said to the ancients, Thou shalt not kill; but whosoever shall kill shall be subject to the judgment.

title: Matthew 5:22
text: But *I* say unto you, that every one that is lightly angry with his brother shall be subject to the judgment; but whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be subject to [be called before] the sanhedrim; but whosoever shall say, Fool, shall be subject to the penalty of the hell of fire.

title: Matthew 5:23
text: If therefore thou shouldest offer thy gift at the altar, and there shouldest remember that thy brother has something against thee,

title: Matthew 5:24
text: leave there thy gift before the altar, and first go, be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

title: Matthew 5:25
text: Make friends with thine adverse party quickly, whilst thou art in the way with him; lest some time the adverse party deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

title: Matthew 5:26
text: Verily I say to thee, Thou shalt in no wise come out thence till thou hast paid the last farthing.

title: Matthew 5:27
text: ¶Ye have heard that it has been said, Thou shalt not commit adultery.

title: Matthew 5:28
text: But *I* say unto you, that every one who looks upon a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

title: Matthew 5:29
text: But if thy right eye be a snare to thee, pluck it out and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members perish, and not thy whole body be cast into hell.

title: Matthew 5:30
text: And if thy right hand be a snare to thee, cut it off and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members perish, and not thy whole body be cast into hell.

title: Matthew 5:31
text: It has been said too, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a letter of divorce.

title: Matthew 5:32
text: But *I* say unto you, that whosoever shall put away his wife, except for cause of fornication, makes her commit adultery, and whosoever marries one that is put away commits adultery.

title: Matthew 5:33
text: ¶Again, ye have heard that it has been said to the ancients, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt render to the Lord what thou hast sworn.

title: Matthew 5:34
text: But *I* say unto you, Do not swear at all; neither by the heaven, because it is [the] throne of God;

title: Matthew 5:35
text: nor by the earth, because it is [the] footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, because it is [the] city of the great King.

title: Matthew 5:36
text: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

title: Matthew 5:37
text: But let your word be Yea, yea; Nay, nay; but what is more than these is from evil.

title: Matthew 5:38
text: ¶Ye have heard that it has been said, Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.

title: Matthew 5:39
text: But *I* say unto you, not to resist evil; but whoever shall strike thee on thy right cheek, turn to him also the other;

title: Matthew 5:40
text: and to him that would go to law with thee and take thy body coat, leave him thy cloak also.

title: Matthew 5:41
text: And whoever will compel thee to go one mile, go with him two.

title: Matthew 5:42
text: To him that asks of thee give, and from him that desires to borrow of thee turn not away.

title: Matthew 5:43
text: ¶Ye have heard that it has been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour and hate thine enemy.

title: Matthew 5:44
text: But *I* say unto you, Love your enemies, [bless those who curse you,] do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who [insult you and] persecute you,

title: Matthew 5:45
text: that ye may be [the] sons of your Father who is in [the] heavens; for he makes his sun rise on evil and good, and sends rain on just and unjust.

title: Matthew 5:46
text: For if ye should love those who love you, what reward have ye? Do not also the tax-gatherers the same?

title: Matthew 5:47
text: And if ye should salute your brethren only, what do ye extraordinary? Do not also the Gentiles the same?

title: Matthew 5:48
text: Be *ye* therefore perfect as your heavenly Father is perfect.

title: Matthew 6:1
text: ¶Take heed not to do your alms before men to be seen of them, otherwise ye have no reward with your Father who is in the heavens.

title: Matthew 6:2
text: When therefore thou doest alms, sound not a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, so that they may have glory from men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

title: Matthew 6:3
text: But thou, when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand does;

title: Matthew 6:4
text: so that thine alms may be in secret, and thy Father who sees in secret will render [it] to thee.

title: Matthew 6:5
text: ¶And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites; for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets so that they should appear to men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

title: Matthew 6:6
text: But *thou*, when thou prayest, enter into thy chamber, and having shut thy door, pray to thy Father who is in secret, and thy Father who sees in secret will render [it] to thee.

title: Matthew 6:7
text: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as those who are of the nations: for they think they shall be heard through their much speaking.

title: Matthew 6:8
text: Be not ye therefore like them, for your Father knows of what things ye have need before ye beg [anything] of him.

title: Matthew 6:9
text: ¶Thus therefore pray *ye*: Our Father who art in the heavens, let thy name be sanctified,

title: Matthew 6:10
text: let thy kingdom come, let thy will be done as in heaven so upon the earth;

title: Matthew 6:11
text: give us to-day our needed bread,

title: Matthew 6:12
text: and forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors,

title: Matthew 6:13
text: and lead us not into temptation, but save us from evil.

title: Matthew 6:14
text: For if ye forgive men their offences, your heavenly Father also will forgive you [yours],

title: Matthew 6:15
text: but if ye do not forgive men their offences, neither will your Father forgive your offences.

title: Matthew 6:16
text: ¶And when ye fast, be not as the hypocrites, downcast in countenance; for they disfigure their faces, so that they may appear fasting to men: verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

title: Matthew 6:17
text: But *thou*, [when] fasting, anoint thy head and wash thy face,

title: Matthew 6:18
text: so that thou mayest not appear fasting unto men, but to thy Father who is in secret; and thy Father who sees in secret shall render [it] to thee.

title: Matthew 6:19
text: ¶Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon the earth, where moth and rust spoils, and where thieves dig through and steal;

title: Matthew 6:20
text: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust spoils, and where thieves do not dig through nor steal;

title: Matthew 6:21
text: for where thy treasure is, there will be also thy heart.

title: Matthew 6:22
text: The lamp of the body is the eye; if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body will be light:

title: Matthew 6:23
text: but if thine eye be wicked, thy whole body will be dark. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great the darkness!

title: Matthew 6:24
text: No one can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and will love the other, or he will hold to the one and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

title: Matthew 6:25
text: ¶For this cause I say unto you, Do not be careful about your life, what ye should eat and what ye should drink; nor for your body what ye should put on. Is not the life more than food, and the body than raiment?

title: Matthew 6:26
text: Look at the birds of the heaven, that they sow not, nor reap, nor gather into granaries, and your heavenly Father nourishes them. Are *ye* not much more excellent than they?

title: Matthew 6:27
text: But which of you by carefulness can add to his growth one cubit?

title: Matthew 6:28
text: And why are ye careful about clothing? Observe with attention the lilies of the field, how they grow: they toil not, neither do they spin;

title: Matthew 6:29
text: but I say unto you, that not even Solomon in all his glory was clothed as one of these.

title: Matthew 6:30
text: But if God so clothe the herbage of the field, which is to-day, and to-morrow is cast into [the] oven, will he not much rather you, O [ye] of little faith?

title: Matthew 6:31
text: Be not therefore careful, saying, What shall we eat? or What shall we drink? or What shall we put on?

title: Matthew 6:32
text: for all these things the nations seek after; for your heavenly Father knows that ye have need of all these things.

title: Matthew 6:33
text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things shall be added unto you.

title: Matthew 6:34
text: Be not careful therefore for the morrow, for the morrow shall be careful about itself. Sufficient to the day [is] its own evil.

title: Matthew 7:1
text: ¶Judge not, that ye may not be judged;

title: Matthew 7:2
text: for with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged; and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you.

title: Matthew 7:3
text: But why lookest thou on the mote that is in the eye of thy brother, but observest not the beam that is in thine eye?

title: Matthew 7:4
text: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Allow [me], I will cast out the mote from thine eye; and behold, the beam is in thine eye?

title: Matthew 7:5
text: Hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine eye, and then thou wilt see clearly to cast out the mote out of the eye of thy brother.

title: Matthew 7:6
text: Give not that which is holy to the dogs, nor cast your pearls before the swine, lest they trample them with their feet, and turning round rend you.

title: Matthew 7:7
text: ¶Ask, and it shall be given to you. Seek, and ye shall find. Knock, and it shall be opened to you.

title: Matthew 7:8
text: For every one that asks receives; and he that seeks finds; and to him that knocks it shall be opened.

title: Matthew 7:9
text: Or what man is there of you who, if his son shall ask of him a loaf of bread, will give him a stone;

title: Matthew 7:10
text: and if he ask a fish, will give him a serpent?

title: Matthew 7:11
text: If therefore *ye*, being wicked, know [how] to give good gifts to your children, how much rather shall your Father who is in the heavens give good things to them that ask of him?

title: Matthew 7:12
text: ¶Therefore all things whatever ye desire that men should do to you, thus do *ye* also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

title: Matthew 7:13
text: Enter in through the narrow gate, for wide the gate and broad the way that leads to destruction, and many are they who enter in through it.

title: Matthew 7:14
text: For narrow the gate and straitened the way that leads to life, and they are few who find it.

title: Matthew 7:15
text: ¶But beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but within are ravening wolves.

title: Matthew 7:16
text: By their fruits ye shall know them. Do [men] gather a bunch of grapes from thorns, or from thistles figs?

title: Matthew 7:17
text: So every good tree produces good fruits, but the worthless tree produces bad fruits.

title: Matthew 7:18
text: A good tree cannot produce bad fruits, nor a worthless tree produce good fruits.

title: Matthew 7:19
text: Every tree not producing good fruit is cut down and cast into the fire.

title: Matthew 7:20
text: By their fruits then surely ye shall know them.

title: Matthew 7:21
text: ¶Not every one who says to me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of the heavens, but he that does the will of my Father who is in the heavens.

title: Matthew 7:22
text: Many shall say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied through *thy* name, and through *thy* name cast out demons, and through *thy* name done many works of power?

title: Matthew 7:23
text: and then will I avow unto them, I never knew you. Depart from me, workers of lawlessness.

title: Matthew 7:24
text: Whoever therefore hears these my words and does them, I will liken him to a prudent man, who built his house upon the rock;

title: Matthew 7:25
text: and the rain came down, and the streams came, and the winds blew and fell upon that house, and it did not fall, for it had been founded upon the rock.

title: Matthew 7:26
text: And every one who hears these my words and does not do them, he shall be likened to a foolish man, who built his house upon the sand;

title: Matthew 7:27
text: and the rain came down, and the streams came, and the winds blew and beat upon that house, and it fell, and its fall was great.

title: Matthew 7:28
text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these words, the crowds were astonished at his doctrine,

title: Matthew 7:29
text: for he taught them as having authority, and not as their scribes.

title: Matthew 8:1
text: ¶And when he had come down from the mountain, great crowds followed him.

title: Matthew 8:2
text: And behold, a leper came up to [him] and did him homage, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou art able to cleanse me.

title: Matthew 8:3
text: And he stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, I will; be cleansed. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

title: Matthew 8:4
text: And Jesus says to him, See thou tell no man, but go, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift which Moses ordained, for a testimony to them.

title: Matthew 8:5
text: ¶And when he had entered into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, beseeching him,

title: Matthew 8:6
text: and saying, Lord, my servant lies paralytic in the house, suffering grievously.

title: Matthew 8:7
text: And Jesus says to him, *I* will come and heal him.

title: Matthew 8:8
text: And the centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not fit that thou shouldest enter under my roof; but only speak a word, and my servant shall be healed.

title: Matthew 8:9
text: For *I* also am a man under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say to this [one], Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my bondman, Do this, and he does it.

title: Matthew 8:10
text: And when Jesus heard it, he wondered, and said to those who followed, Verily I say unto you, Not even in Israel have I found so great faith.

title: Matthew 8:11
text: But I say unto you, that many shall come from [the] rising and setting [sun], and shall lie down at table with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of the heavens;

title: Matthew 8:12
text: but the sons of the kingdom shall be cast out into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

title: Matthew 8:13
text: And Jesus said to the centurion, Go, and as thou hast believed, be it to thee. And his servant was healed in that hour.

title: Matthew 8:14
text: ¶And when Jesus had come to Peter's house, he saw his mother-in-law laid down and in a fever;

title: Matthew 8:15
text: and he touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she arose and served him.

title: Matthew 8:16
text: And when the evening was come, they brought to him many possessed by demons, and he cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all that were ill;

title: Matthew 8:17
text: so that that should be fulfilled which was spoken through Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities and bore our diseases.

title: Matthew 8:18
text: ¶And Jesus, seeing great crowds around him, commanded to depart to the other side.

title: Matthew 8:19
text: And a scribe came up and said to him, Teacher, I will follow thee whithersoever thou mayest go.

title: Matthew 8:20
text: And Jesus says to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven roosting-places; but the Son of man has not where he may lay his head.

title: Matthew 8:21
text: But another of his disciples said to him, Lord, suffer me first to go away and bury my father.

title: Matthew 8:22
text: But Jesus said to him, Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.

title: Matthew 8:23
text: ¶And he went on board ship and his disciples followed him;

title: Matthew 8:24
text: and behold, [the water] became very agitated on the sea, so that the ship was covered by the waves; but *he* slept.

title: Matthew 8:25
text: And the disciples came and awoke him, saying, Lord save: we perish.

title: Matthew 8:26
text: And he says to them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then, having arisen, he rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.

title: Matthew 8:27
text: But the men were astonished, saying, What sort [of man] is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him?

title: Matthew 8:28
text: ¶And there met him, when he came to the other side, to the country of the Gergesenes, two possessed by demons, coming out of the tombs, exceeding dangerous, so that no one was able to pass by that way.

title: Matthew 8:29
text: And behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Son of God? hast thou come here before the time to torment us?

title: Matthew 8:30
text: Now there was, a great way off from them, a herd of many swine feeding;

title: Matthew 8:31
text: and the demons besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, send us away into the herd of swine.

title: Matthew 8:32
text: And he said to them, Go. And they, going out, departed into the herd of swine; and lo, the whole herd [of swine] rushed down the steep slope into the sea, and died in the waters.

title: Matthew 8:33
text: But they that fed them fled, and went away into the city and related everything, and what had happened as to those possessed by demons.

title: Matthew 8:34
text: And behold, the whole city went out to meet Jesus; and when they saw him, they begged [him] to go away out of their coasts.

title: Matthew 9:1
text: ¶And going on board the ship, he passed over and came to his own city.

title: Matthew 9:2
text: And behold, they brought to him a paralytic, laid upon a bed; and Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, Be of good courage, child; thy sins are forgiven.

title: Matthew 9:3
text: And behold, certain of the scribes said to themselves, This [man] blasphemes.

title: Matthew 9:4
text: And Jesus, seeing their thoughts, said, Why do *ye* think evil things in your hearts?

title: Matthew 9:5
text: For which is easier: to say, Thy sins are forgiven; or to say, Rise up and walk?

title: Matthew 9:6
text: But that ye may know that the Son of man has power on earth to forgive sins, (then he says to the paralytic,) Rise up, take up thy bed and go to thy house.

title: Matthew 9:7
text: And he rose up and went to his house.

title: Matthew 9:8
text: But the crowds seeing [it], were in fear, and glorified God who gave such power to men.

title: Matthew 9:9
text: ¶And Jesus, passing on thence, saw a man sitting at the tax-office, called Matthew, and says to him, Follow me. And he rose up and followed him.

title: Matthew 9:10
text: And it came to pass, as he lay at table in the house, that behold, many tax-gatherers and sinners came and lay at table with Jesus and his disciples.

title: Matthew 9:11
text: And the Pharisees seeing [it], said to his disciples, Why does your teacher eat with tax-gatherers and sinners?

title: Matthew 9:12
text: But [Jesus] hearing it, said, They that are strong have not need of a physician, but those that are ill.

title: Matthew 9:13
text: But go and learn what [that] is--I will have mercy and not sacrifice; for I have not come to call righteous [men] but sinners.

title: Matthew 9:14
text: ¶Then come to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees often fast, but thy disciples fast not?

title: Matthew 9:15
text: And Jesus said to them, Can the sons of the bridechamber mourn so long as the bridegroom is with them? But days will come when the bridegroom will have been taken away from them, and then they will fast.

title: Matthew 9:16
text: But no one puts a patch of new cloth on an old garment, for its filling up takes from the garment and a worse rent takes place.

title: Matthew 9:17
text: Nor do men put new wine into old skins, otherwise the skins burst and the wine is poured out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into new skins, and both are preserved together.

title: Matthew 9:18
text: ¶As he spoke these things to them, behold, a ruler coming in did homage to him, saying, My daughter has by this died; but come and lay thy hand upon her and she shall live.

title: Matthew 9:19
text: And Jesus rose up and followed him, and [so did] his disciples.

title: Matthew 9:20
text: And behold, a woman, who had had a bloody flux [for] twelve years, came behind and touched the hem of his garment;

title: Matthew 9:21
text: for she said within herself, If I should only touch his garment I shall be healed.

title: Matthew 9:22
text: But Jesus turning and seeing her, said, Be of good courage, daughter; thy faith has healed thee. And the woman was healed from that hour.

title: Matthew 9:23
text: And when Jesus was come to the house of the ruler, and saw the flute-players and the crowd making a tumult,

title: Matthew 9:24
text: he said, Withdraw, for the damsel is not dead, but sleeps. And they derided him.

title: Matthew 9:25
text: But when the crowd had been put out, he went in and took her hand; and the damsel rose up.

title: Matthew 9:26
text: And the fame of it went out into all that land.

title: Matthew 9:27
text: ¶And as Jesus passed on thence, two blind [men] followed him, crying and saying, Have mercy on us, Son of David.

title: Matthew 9:28
text: And when he was come to the house, the blind [men] came to him. And Jesus says to them, Do ye believe that I am able to do this? They say to him, Yea, Lord.

title: Matthew 9:29
text: Then he touched their eyes, saying, According to your faith, be it unto you.

title: Matthew 9:30
text: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus charged them sharply, saying, See, let no man know it.

title: Matthew 9:31
text: But they, when they were gone out, spread his name abroad in all that land.

title: Matthew 9:32
text: But as these were going out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed by a demon.

title: Matthew 9:33
text: And the demon having been cast out, the dumb spake. And the crowds were astonished, saying, It has never been seen thus in Israel.

title: Matthew 9:34
text: But the Pharisees said, He casts out the demons through the prince of the demons.

title: Matthew 9:35
text: ¶And Jesus went round all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the glad tidings of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every bodily weakness.

title: Matthew 9:36
text: But when he saw the crowds he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed, and cast away as sheep not having a shepherd.

title: Matthew 9:37
text: Then saith he to his disciples, The harvest [is] great and the workmen [are] few;

title: Matthew 9:38
text: supplicate therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he send forth workmen unto his harvest.

title: Matthew 10:1
text: ¶And having called to [him] his twelve disciples, he gave them power over unclean spirits, so that they should cast them out, and heal every disease and every bodily weakness.

title: Matthew 10:2
text: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these: first, Simon, who was called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the [son] of Zebedee, and John his brother;

title: Matthew 10:3
text: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the tax-gatherer; James the [son] of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, who was surnamed Thaddaeus;

title: Matthew 10:4
text: Simon the Cananaean, and Judas the Iscariote, who also delivered him up.

title: Matthew 10:5
text: ¶These twelve Jesus sent out when he had charged them, saying, Go not off into [the] way of [the] nations, and into a city of Samaritans enter ye not;

title: Matthew 10:6
text: but go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

title: Matthew 10:7
text: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of the heavens has drawn nigh.

title: Matthew 10:8
text: Heal [the] infirm, [raise the dead], cleanse lepers, cast out demons: ye have received gratuitously, give gratuitously.

title: Matthew 10:9
text: Do not provide yourselves with gold, or silver, or brass, for your belts,

title: Matthew 10:10
text: nor scrip for the way, nor two body coats, nor sandals, nor a staff: for the workman is worthy of his nourishment.

title: Matthew 10:11
text: But into whatsoever city or village ye enter, inquire who in it is worthy, and there remain till ye go forth.

title: Matthew 10:12
text: And as ye enter into a house salute it.

title: Matthew 10:13
text: And if the house indeed be worthy, let your peace come upon it; but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

title: Matthew 10:14
text: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, as ye go forth out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

title: Matthew 10:15
text: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in judgment-day than for that city.

title: Matthew 10:16
text: ¶Behold, *I* send you as sheep in the midst of wolves; be therefore prudent as the serpents, and guileless as the doves.

title: Matthew 10:17
text: But beware of men; for they will deliver you up to sanhedrims, and scourge you in their synagogues;

title: Matthew 10:18
text: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

title: Matthew 10:19
text: But when they deliver you up, be not careful how or what ye shall speak; for it shall be given to you in that hour what ye shall speak.

title: Matthew 10:20
text: For *ye* are not the speakers, but the Spirit of your Father which speaks in you.

title: Matthew 10:21
text: But brother shall deliver up brother to death, and father child; and children shall rise up against parents and shall put them to death;

title: Matthew 10:22
text: and ye shall be hated of all on account of my name. But he that has endured to [the] end, *he* shall be saved.

title: Matthew 10:23
text: But when they persecute you in this city, flee to the other; for verily I say to you, Ye shall not have completed the cities of Israel until the Son of man be come.

title: Matthew 10:24
text: The disciple is not above his teacher, nor the bondman above his lord.

title: Matthew 10:25
text: [It is] sufficient for the disciple that he should become as his teacher, and the bondman as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more those of his household?

title: Matthew 10:26
text: Fear them not therefore; for there is nothing covered which shall not be revealed, and secret which shall not be known.

title: Matthew 10:27
text: What I say to you in darkness speak in the light, and what ye hear in the ear preach upon the houses.

title: Matthew 10:28
text: And be not afraid of those who kill the body, but cannot kill the soul; but fear rather him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

title: Matthew 10:29
text: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall to the ground without your Father;

title: Matthew 10:30
text: but of you even the hairs of the head are all numbered.

title: Matthew 10:31
text: Fear not therefore; *ye* are better than many sparrows.

title: Matthew 10:32
text: Every one therefore who shall confess me before men, *I* also will confess him before my Father who is in [the] heavens.

title: Matthew 10:33
text: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will *I* also deny before my Father who is in [the] heavens.

title: Matthew 10:34
text: Do not think that I have come to send peace upon the earth: I have not come to send peace, but a sword.

title: Matthew 10:35
text: For I have come to set a man at variance with his father, and the daughter with her mother, and the daughter-in-law with her mother-in-law;

title: Matthew 10:36
text: and they of his household [shall be] a man's enemies.

title: Matthew 10:37
text: He who loves father or mother above me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter above me is not worthy of me.

title: Matthew 10:38
text: And he who does not take up his cross and follow after me is not worthy of me.

title: Matthew 10:39
text: He that finds his life shall lose it, and he who has lost his life for my sake shall find it.

title: Matthew 10:40
text: He that receives you receives me, and he that receives me receives him that sent me.

title: Matthew 10:41
text: He that receives a prophet in the name of a prophet, shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man, shall receive a righteous man's reward.

title: Matthew 10:42
text: And whosoever shall give to drink to one of these little ones a cup of cold [water] only, in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

title: Matthew 11:1
text: ¶And it came to pass when Jesus had finished commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and preach in their cities.

title: Matthew 11:2
text: But John, having heard in the prison the works of the Christ, sent by his disciples,

title: Matthew 11:3
text: and said to him, Art *thou* the coming [one]? or are we to wait for another?

title: Matthew 11:4
text: And Jesus answering said to them, Go, report to John what ye hear and see.

title: Matthew 11:5
text: Blind [men] see and lame walk; lepers are cleansed, and deaf hear; and dead are raised, and poor have glad tidings preached to them:

title: Matthew 11:6
text: and blessed is whosoever shall not be offended in me.

title: Matthew 11:7
text: ¶But as they went [away], Jesus began to say to the crowds concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? a reed moved about by the wind?

title: Matthew 11:8
text: But what went ye out to see? a man clothed in delicate raiment? behold, those who wear delicate things are in the houses of kings.

title: Matthew 11:9
text: But what went ye out to see? a prophet? Yea, I say to you, and more than a prophet:

title: Matthew 11:10
text: this is he of whom it is written, Behold, *I* send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee.

title: Matthew 11:11
text: Verily I say to you, that there is not arisen among [the] born of women a greater than John the baptist. But he who is a little one in the kingdom of the heavens is greater than he.

title: Matthew 11:12
text: But from the days of John the baptist until now, the kingdom of the heavens is taken by violence, and [the] violent seize on it.

title: Matthew 11:13
text: For all the prophets and the law have prophesied unto John.

title: Matthew 11:14
text: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, who is to come.

title: Matthew 11:15
text: He that has ears to hear, let him hear.

title: Matthew 11:16
text: ¶But to whom shall I liken this generation? It is like children sitting in the markets, which, calling to their companions,

title: Matthew 11:17
text: say, We have piped to you, and ye have not danced: we have mourned to you, and ye have not wailed.

title: Matthew 11:18
text: For John has come neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He has a demon.

title: Matthew 11:19
text: The Son of man has come eating and drinking, and they say, Behold, a man [that is] eating and wine-drinking, a friend of tax-gatherers, and of sinners: --and wisdom has been justified by her children.

title: Matthew 11:20
text: Then began he to reproach the cities in which most of his works of power had taken place, because they had not repented.

title: Matthew 11:21
text: Woe to thee, Chorazin! woe to thee Bethsaida! for if the works of power which have taken place in you, had taken place in Tyre and Sidon, they had long ago repented in sackcloth and ashes.

title: Matthew 11:22
text: But I say to you, that it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in judgment-day than for you.

title: Matthew 11:23
text: And *thou*, Capernaum, who hast been raised up to heaven, shalt be brought down even to hades. For if the works of power which have taken place in thee, had taken place in Sodom, it had remained until this day.

title: Matthew 11:24
text: But I say to you, that it shall be more tolerable for [the] land of Sodom in judgment-day than for thee.

title: Matthew 11:25
text: ¶At that time, Jesus answering said, I praise thee, Father, Lord of the heaven and of the earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them to babes.

title: Matthew 11:26
text: Yea, Father, for thus has it been well-pleasing in thy sight.

title: Matthew 11:27
text: All things have been delivered to me by my Father, and no one knows the Son but the Father, nor does any one know the Father, but the Son, and he to whom the Son may be pleased to reveal [him].

title: Matthew 11:28
text: Come to me, all ye who labour and are burdened, and *I* will give you rest.

title: Matthew 11:29
text: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me; for I am meek and lowly in heart; and ye shall find rest to your souls;

title: Matthew 11:30
text: for my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

title: Matthew 12:1
text: ¶At that time Jesus went on the sabbath through the cornfields; and his disciples were hungry, and began to pluck the ears and to eat.

title: Matthew 12:2
text: But the Pharisees, seeing [it], said to him, Behold, thy disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on sabbath.

title: Matthew 12:3
text: But he said to them, Have ye not read what David did when he was hungry, and they that were with him?

title: Matthew 12:4
text: How he entered into the house of God, and ate the shewbread, which it was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those with him, but for the priests only?

title: Matthew 12:5
text: Or have ye not read in the law that on the sabbaths the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

title: Matthew 12:6
text: But I say unto you, that there is here what is greater than the temple.

title: Matthew 12:7
text: But if ye had known what is: I will have mercy and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

title: Matthew 12:8
text: For the Son of man is Lord of the sabbath.

title: Matthew 12:9
text: And, going away from thence, he came into their synagogue.

title: Matthew 12:10
text: And behold, there was a man having his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath? that they might accuse him.

title: Matthew 12:11
text: But he said to them, What man shall there be of you who has one sheep, and if this fall into a pit on the sabbath, will not lay hold of it and raise [it] up?

title: Matthew 12:12
text: How much better then is a man than a sheep! So that it is lawful to do well on the sabbath.

title: Matthew 12:13
text: Then he says to the man, Stretch out thy hand. And he stretched [it] out, and it was restored sound as the other.

title: Matthew 12:14
text: ¶But the Pharisees, having gone out, took counsel against him, how they might destroy him.

title: Matthew 12:15
text: But Jesus knowing [it], withdrew thence, and great crowds followed him; and he healed them all:

title: Matthew 12:16
text: and charged them strictly that they should not make him publicly known:

title: Matthew 12:17
text: that that might be fulfilled which was spoken through Esaias the prophet, saying,

title: Matthew 12:18
text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen, my beloved, in whom my soul has found its delight. I will put my Spirit upon him, and he shall shew forth judgment to the nations.

title: Matthew 12:19
text: He shall not strive or cry out, nor shall any one hear his voice in the streets;

title: Matthew 12:20
text: a bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, until he bring forth judgment unto victory;

title: Matthew 12:21
text: and on his name shall [the] nations hope.

title: Matthew 12:22
text: ¶Then was brought to him one possessed by a demon, blind and dumb, and he healed him, so that the dumb [man] spake and saw.

title: Matthew 12:23
text: And all the crowds were amazed and said, Is this [man] the Son of David?

title: Matthew 12:24
text: But the Pharisees, having heard [it], said, This [man] does not cast out demons, but by Beelzebub, prince of demons.

title: Matthew 12:25
text: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not subsist.

title: Matthew 12:26
text: And if Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then shall his kingdom subsist?

title: Matthew 12:27
text: And if *I* cast out demons by Beelzebub, your sons, by whom do they cast [them] out? For this reason *they* shall be your judges.

title: Matthew 12:28
text: But if *I* by [the] Spirit of God cast out demons, then indeed the kingdom of God is come upon you.

title: Matthew 12:29
text: Or how can any one enter into the house of the strong [man] and plunder his goods, unless first he bind the strong [man]? and then he will plunder his house.

title: Matthew 12:30
text: He that is not with me is against me, and he that gathers not with me scatters.

title: Matthew 12:31
text: For this reason I say unto you, Every sin and injurious speaking shall be forgiven to men, but speaking injuriously of the Spirit shall not be forgiven to men.

title: Matthew 12:32
text: And whosoever shall have spoken a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him; but whosoever shall speak against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this age nor in the coming [one].

title: Matthew 12:33
text: Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt. For from the fruit the tree is known.

title: Matthew 12:34
text: Offspring of vipers! how can ye speak good things, being wicked? For of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.

title: Matthew 12:35
text: The good man out of the good treasure brings forth good things; and the wicked man out of the wicked treasure brings forth wicked things.

title: Matthew 12:36
text: But I say unto you, that every idle word which men shall say, they shall render an account of it in judgment-day:

title: Matthew 12:37
text: for by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.

title: Matthew 12:38
text: ¶Then answered him some of the scribes and Pharisees, saying, Teacher, we desire to see a sign from thee.

title: Matthew 12:39
text: But he, answering, said to them, A wicked and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and a sign shall not be given to it save the sign of Jonas the prophet.

title: Matthew 12:40
text: For even as Jonas was in the belly of the great fish three days and three nights, thus shall the Son of man be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.

title: Matthew 12:41
text: Ninevites shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and behold, more than Jonas [is] here.

title: Matthew 12:42
text: A queen of [the] south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, more than Solomon [is] here.

title: Matthew 12:43
text: But when the unclean spirit has gone out of the man, he goes through dry places, seeking rest, and does not find [it].

title: Matthew 12:44
text: Then he says, I will return to my house whence I came out; and having come, he finds [it] unoccupied, swept, and adorned.

title: Matthew 12:45
text: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits worse than himself, and entering in, they dwell there; and the last condition of that man becomes worse than the first. Thus shall it be to this wicked generation also.

title: Matthew 12:46
text: ¶But while he was yet speaking to the crowds, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, seeking to speak to him.

title: Matthew 12:47
text: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren are standing without, seeking to speak to thee.

title: Matthew 12:48
text: But he answering said to him that spoke to him, Who is my mother, and who are my brethren?

title: Matthew 12:49
text: And, stretching out his hand to his disciples, he said, Behold my mother and my brethren;

title: Matthew 12:50
text: for whosoever shall do the will of my Father who is in [the] heavens, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.

title: Matthew 13:1
text: ¶And that [same] day Jesus went out from the house and sat down by the sea.

title: Matthew 13:2
text: And great crowds were gathered together to him, so that going on board ship himself he sat down, and the whole crowd stood on the shore.

title: Matthew 13:3
text: And he spoke to them many things in parables, saying, Behold, the sower went out to sow:

title: Matthew 13:4
text: and as he sowed, some [grains] fell along the way, and the birds came and devoured them;

title: Matthew 13:5
text: and others fell upon the rocky places where they had not much earth, and immediately they sprang up out of [the ground] because of not having [any] depth of earth,

title: Matthew 13:6
text: but when the sun rose they were burned up, and because of not having [any] root were dried up;

title: Matthew 13:7
text: and others fell upon the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked them;

title: Matthew 13:8
text: and others fell upon the good ground, and produced fruit, one a hundred, one sixty, and one thirty.

title: Matthew 13:9
text: He that has ears, let him hear.

title: Matthew 13:10
text: And the disciples came up and said to him, Why speakest thou to them in parables?

title: Matthew 13:11
text: And he answering said to them, Because to you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of the heavens, but to them it is not given;

title: Matthew 13:12
text: for whoever has, to him shall be given, and he shall be caused to be in abundance; but he who has not, even what he has shall be taken away from him.

title: Matthew 13:13
text: For this cause I speak to them in parables, because seeing they do not see, and hearing they do not hear nor understand;

title: Matthew 13:14
text: and in them is filled up the prophecy of Esaias, which says, Hearing ye shall hear and shall not understand, and beholding ye shall behold and not see;

title: Matthew 13:15
text: for the heart of this people has grown fat, and they have heard heavily with their ears, and they have closed their eyes as asleep, lest they should see with the eyes, and hear with the ears, and understand with the heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

title: Matthew 13:16
text: But blessed are *your* eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear;

title: Matthew 13:17
text: for verily I say unto you, that many prophets and righteous [men] have desired to see the things which ye behold and did not see [them], and to hear the things which ye hear and did not hear [them].

title: Matthew 13:18
text: *Ye*, therefore, hear the parable of the sower.

title: Matthew 13:19
text: From every one who hears the word of the kingdom and does not understand [it], the wicked one comes and catches away what was sown in his heart: this is he that is sown by the wayside.

title: Matthew 13:20
text: But he that is sown on the rocky places--this is he who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy,

title: Matthew 13:21
text: but has no root in himself, but is for a time only; and when tribulation or persecution happens on account of the word, he is immediately offended.

title: Matthew 13:22
text: And he that is sown among the thorns--this is he who hears the word, and the anxious care of this life, and the deceit of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

title: Matthew 13:23
text: But he that is sown upon the good ground--this is he who hears and understands the word, who bears fruit also, and produces, one a hundred, one sixty, and one thirty.

title: Matthew 13:24
text: ¶Another parable set he before them, saying, The kingdom of the heavens has become like a man sowing good seed in his field;

title: Matthew 13:25
text: but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel amongst the wheat, and went away.

title: Matthew 13:26
text: But when the blade shot up and produced fruit, then appeared the darnel also.

title: Matthew 13:27
text: And the bondmen of the householder came up and said to him, Sir, hast thou not sown good seed in thy field? whence then has it darnel?

title: Matthew 13:28
text: And he said to them, A man [that is] an enemy has done this. And the bondmen said to him, Wilt thou then that we should go and gather it [up]?

title: Matthew 13:29
text: But he said, No; lest [in] gathering the darnel ye should root up the wheat with it.

title: Matthew 13:30
text: Suffer both to grow together unto the harvest, and in time of the harvest I will say to the harvestmen, Gather first the darnel, and bind it into bundles to burn it; but the wheat bring together into my granary.

title: Matthew 13:31
text: Another parable set he before them, saying, The kingdom of the heavens is like a grain of mustard [seed] which a man took and sowed in his field;

title: Matthew 13:32
text: which is less indeed than all seeds, but when it is grown is greater than herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of heaven come and roost in its branches.

title: Matthew 13:33
text: He spoke another parable to them: The kingdom of the heavens is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal until it had been all leavened.

title: Matthew 13:34
text: All these things Jesus spoke to the crowds in parables, and without a parable he did not speak to them,

title: Matthew 13:35
text: so that that should be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from [the] world's foundation.

title: Matthew 13:36
text: Then, having dismissed the crowds, he went into the house; and his disciples came to him, saying, Expound to us the parable of the darnel of the field.

title: Matthew 13:37
text: But he answering said, He that sows the good seed is the Son of man,

title: Matthew 13:38
text: and the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the sons of the kingdom, but the darnel are the sons of the evil [one];

title: Matthew 13:39
text: and the enemy who has sowed it is the devil; and the harvest is [the] completion of [the] age, and the harvestmen are angels.

title: Matthew 13:40
text: As then the darnel is gathered and is burned in the fire, thus it shall be in the completion of the age.

title: Matthew 13:41
text: The Son of man shall send his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all offences, and those that practise lawlessness;

title: Matthew 13:42
text: and they shall cast them into the furnace of fire; there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

title: Matthew 13:43
text: Then the righteous shall shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He that has ears, let him hear.

title: Matthew 13:44
text: ¶The kingdom of the heavens is like a treasure hid in the field, which a man having found has hid, and for the joy of it goes and sells all whatever he has, and buys that field.

title: Matthew 13:45
text: Again, the kingdom of the heavens is like a merchant seeking beautiful pearls;

title: Matthew 13:46
text: and having found one pearl of great value, he went and sold all whatever he had and bought it.

title: Matthew 13:47
text: Again, the kingdom of the heavens is like a seine which has been cast into the sea, and which has gathered together of every kind,

title: Matthew 13:48
text: which, when it has been filled, having drawn up on the shore and sat down, they gathered the good into vessels and cast the worthless out.

title: Matthew 13:49
text: Thus shall it be in the completion of the age: the angels shall go forth and sever the wicked from the midst of the just,

title: Matthew 13:50
text: and shall cast them into the furnace of fire; there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

title: Matthew 13:51
text: Jesus says to them, Have ye understood all these things? They say to him, Yea, [Lord].

title: Matthew 13:52
text: And he said to them, For this reason every scribe discipled to the kingdom of the heavens is like a man [that is] a householder who brings out of his treasure things new and old.

title: Matthew 13:53
text: ¶And it came to pass when Jesus had finished these parables he withdrew thence.

title: Matthew 13:54
text: And having come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, Whence has this [man] this wisdom and these works of power?

title: Matthew 13:55
text: Is not this the son of the carpenter? Is not his mother called Mary, and his brethren James, and Joseph, and Simon, and Judas?

title: Matthew 13:56
text: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then has this [man] all these things?

title: Matthew 13:57
text: And they were offended in him. And Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honour, unless in his country and in his house.

title: Matthew 13:58
text: And he did not there many works of power, because of their unbelief.

title: Matthew 14:1
text: ¶At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

title: Matthew 14:2
text: and said to his servants, This is John the baptist: *he* is risen from the dead, and because of this these works of power display their force in him.

title: Matthew 14:3
text: For Herod had seized John, and had bound him and put him in prison on account of Herodias the wife of Philip his brother.

title: Matthew 14:4
text: For John said to him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

title: Matthew 14:5
text: And [while] desiring to kill him, he feared the crowd, because they held him for a prophet.

title: Matthew 14:6
text: But when Herod's birthday was celebrated, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod;

title: Matthew 14:7
text: whereupon he promised with oath to give her whatsoever she should ask.

title: Matthew 14:8
text: But she, being set on by her mother, says, Give me here upon a dish the head of John the baptist.

title: Matthew 14:9
text: And the king was grieved; but on account of the oaths, and those lying at table with [him], he commanded [it] to be given.

title: Matthew 14:10
text: And he sent and beheaded John in the prison;

title: Matthew 14:11
text: and his head was brought upon a dish, and was given to the damsel, and she carried [it] to her mother.

title: Matthew 14:12
text: And his disciples came and took the body and buried it, and came and brought word to Jesus.

title: Matthew 14:13
text: ¶And Jesus, having heard it, went away thence by ship to a desert place apart. And the crowds having heard [of it] followed him on foot from the cities.

title: Matthew 14:14
text: And going out he saw a great crowd, and was moved with compassion about them, and healed their infirm.

title: Matthew 14:15
text: But when even was come, his disciples came to him saying, The place is desert, and [much of] the [day] time already gone by; dismiss the crowds, that they may go into the villages and buy food for themselves.

title: Matthew 14:16
text: But Jesus said to them, They have no need to go: give *ye* them to eat.

title: Matthew 14:17
text: But they say to him, We have not here save five loaves and two fishes.

title: Matthew 14:18
text: And he said, Bring them here to me.

title: Matthew 14:19
text: And having commanded the crowds to recline upon the grass, having taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed: and having broken the loaves, he gave [them] to the disciples, and the disciples [gave them] to the crowds.

title: Matthew 14:20
text: And all ate and were filled, and they took up what was over and above of fragments twelve hand-baskets full.

title: Matthew 14:21
text: But those that had eaten were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

title: Matthew 14:22
text: ¶And immediately he compelled the disciples to go on board ship, and to go on before him to the other side, until he should have dismissed the crowds.

title: Matthew 14:23
text: And having dismissed the crowds, he went up into the mountain apart to pray. And when even was come, he was alone there,

title: Matthew 14:24
text: but the ship was already in the middle of the sea tossed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

title: Matthew 14:25
text: But in the fourth watch of the night he went off to them, walking on the sea.

title: Matthew 14:26
text: And the disciples, seeing him walking on the sea, were troubled, saying, It is an apparition. And they cried out through fear.

title: Matthew 14:27
text: But Jesus immediately spoke to them, saying, Take courage; it is *I*: be not afraid.

title: Matthew 14:28
text: And Peter answering him said, Lord, if it be *thou*, command me to come to thee upon the waters.

title: Matthew 14:29
text: And he said, Come. And Peter, having descended from the ship, walked upon the waters to go to Jesus.

title: Matthew 14:30
text: But seeing the wind strong he was afraid; and beginning to sink he cried out, saying, Lord, save me.

title: Matthew 14:31
text: And immediately Jesus stretched out his hand and caught hold of him, and says to him, O thou of little faith, why didst thou doubt?

title: Matthew 14:32
text: And when they had gone up into the ship, the wind fell.

title: Matthew 14:33
text: But those in the ship came and did homage to him, saying, Truly thou art God's Son.

title: Matthew 14:34
text: ¶And having crossed over they came to the land of Gennesaret.

title: Matthew 14:35
text: And when the men of that place recognised him, they sent to that whole country around, and they brought to him all that were ill,

title: Matthew 14:36
text: and besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment; and as many as touched were made thoroughly well.

title: Matthew 15:1
text: ¶Then the scribes and Pharisees from Jerusalem come up to Jesus, saying,

title: Matthew 15:2
text: Why do thy disciples transgress what has been delivered by the ancients? for they do not wash their hands when they eat bread.

title: Matthew 15:3
text: But he answering said to them, Why do *ye* also transgress the commandment of God on account of your traditional teaching?

title: Matthew 15:4
text: For God commanded saying, Honour father and mother; and, He that speaks ill of father or mother, let him die the death.

title: Matthew 15:5
text: But *ye* say, Whosoever shall say to his father or mother, It is a gift, whatsoever [it be] by which [received] from me thou wouldest be profited:

title: Matthew 15:6
text: and he shall in no wise honour his father or his mother; and ye have made void the commandment of God on account of your traditional teaching.

title: Matthew 15:7
text: Hypocrites! well has Esaias prophesied about you, saying,

title: Matthew 15:8
text: This people honour me with the lips, but their heart is far away from me;

title: Matthew 15:9
text: but in vain do they worship me, teaching [as] teachings commandments of men.

title: Matthew 15:10
text: ¶And having called to [him] the crowd, he said to them, Hear and understand:

title: Matthew 15:11
text: Not what enters into the mouth defiles the man; but what goes forth out of the mouth, this defiles the man.

title: Matthew 15:12
text: Then his disciples, coming up, said to him, Dost thou know that the Pharisees, having heard this word, have been offended?

title: Matthew 15:13
text: But he answering said, Every plant which my heavenly Father has not planted shall be rooted up.

title: Matthew 15:14
text: Leave them alone; they are blind leaders of blind: but if blind lead blind, both will fall into a ditch.

title: Matthew 15:15
text: And Peter answering said to him, Expound to us this parable.

title: Matthew 15:16
text: But he said, Are *ye* also still without intelligence?

title: Matthew 15:17
text: Do ye not yet apprehend, that everything that enters into the mouth finds its way into the belly, and is cast forth into the draught?

title: Matthew 15:18
text: but the things which go forth out of the mouth come out of the heart, and those defile man.

title: Matthew 15:19
text: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witnessings, blasphemies;

title: Matthew 15:20
text: these are the things which defile man; but the eating with unwashen hands does not defile man.

title: Matthew 15:21
text: ¶And Jesus, going forth from thence, went away into the parts of Tyre and Sidon;

title: Matthew 15:22
text: and lo, a Canaanitish woman, coming out from those borders, cried [to him] saying, Have pity on me, Lord, Son of David; my daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.

title: Matthew 15:23
text: But he did not answer her a word. And his disciples came to [him] and asked him, saying, Dismiss her, for she cries after us.

title: Matthew 15:24
text: But he answering said, I have not been sent save to the lost sheep of Israel's house.

title: Matthew 15:25
text: But she came and did him homage, saying, Lord, help me.

title: Matthew 15:26
text: But he answering said, It is not well to take the bread of the children and cast it to the dogs.

title: Matthew 15:27
text: But she said, Yea, Lord; for even the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from the table of their masters.

title: Matthew 15:28
text: Then Jesus answering said to her, O woman, thy faith [is] great. Be it to thee as thou desirest. And her daughter was healed from *that* hour.

title: Matthew 15:29
text: ¶And Jesus, going away from thence, came towards the sea of Galilee, and he went up into the mountain and sat down there;

title: Matthew 15:30
text: and great crowds came to him, having with them lame, blind, dumb, crippled, and many others, and they cast them at his feet, and he healed them:

title: Matthew 15:31
text: so that the crowds wondered, seeing dumb speaking, crippled sound, lame walking, and blind seeing; and they glorified the God of Israel.

title: Matthew 15:32
text: But Jesus, having called his disciples to [him], said, I have compassion on the crowd, because they have stayed with me already three days and they have not anything they can eat, and I would not send them away fasting lest they should faint on the way.

title: Matthew 15:33
text: And his disciples say to him, Whence should we have so many loaves in [the] wilderness as to satisfy so great a crowd?

title: Matthew 15:34
text: And Jesus says to them, How many loaves have ye? But they said, Seven, and a few small fishes.

title: Matthew 15:35
text: And he commanded the crowds to lie down on the ground;

title: Matthew 15:36
text: and having taken the seven loaves and the fishes, having given thanks, he broke [them] and gave [them] to his disciples, and the disciples to the crowd.

title: Matthew 15:37
text: And all ate and were filled; and they took up what was over and above of the fragments seven baskets full;

title: Matthew 15:38
text: but they that ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.

title: Matthew 15:39
text: And, having dismissed the crowds, he went on board ship and came to the borders of Magadan.

title: Matthew 16:1
text: ¶And the Pharisees and Sadducees, coming to [him], asked him, tempting [him], to shew them a sign out of heaven.

title: Matthew 16:2
text: But he answering said to them, When evening is come, ye say, Fine weather, for the sky is red;

title: Matthew 16:3
text: and in the morning, A storm to-day, for the sky is red [and] lowering; ye know [how] to discern the face of the sky, but ye cannot the signs of the times.

title: Matthew 16:4
text: A wicked and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and a sign shall not be given to it save the sign of Jonas. And he left them and went away.

title: Matthew 16:5
text: ¶And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

title: Matthew 16:6
text: And Jesus said to them, See and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

title: Matthew 16:7
text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, Because we have taken no bread.

title: Matthew 16:8
text: And Jesus knowing [it], said, Why reason ye among yourselves, O ye of little faith, because ye have taken no bread?

title: Matthew 16:9
text: Do ye not yet understand nor remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many hand-baskets ye took [up]?

title: Matthew 16:10
text: nor the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took [up]?

title: Matthew 16:11
text: How do ye not understand that [it was] not concerning bread I said to you, Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees?

title: Matthew 16:12
text: Then they comprehended that he did not speak of being beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

title: Matthew 16:13
text: ¶But when Jesus was come into the parts of Caesarea-Philippi, he demanded of his disciples, saying, Who do men say that I the Son of man am?

title: Matthew 16:14
text: And they said, Some, John the baptist; and others, Elias; and others again, Jeremias or one of the prophets.

title: Matthew 16:15
text: He says to them, But *ye*, who do ye say that I am?

title: Matthew 16:16
text: And Simon Peter answering said, *Thou* art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

title: Matthew 16:17
text: And Jesus answering said to him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona, for flesh and blood has not revealed [it] to thee, but my Father who is in the heavens.

title: Matthew 16:18
text: And *I* also, I say unto thee that *thou* art Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and hades' gates shall not prevail against it.

title: Matthew 16:19
text: And I will give to thee the keys of the kingdom of the heavens; and whatsoever thou mayest bind upon the earth shall be bound in the heavens; and whatsoever thou mayest loose on the earth shall be loosed in the heavens.

title: Matthew 16:20
text: Then he enjoined on his disciples that they should say to no man that he was the Christ.

title: Matthew 16:21
text: ¶From that time Jesus began to shew to his disciples that he must go away to Jerusalem, and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised.

title: Matthew 16:22
text: And Peter taking him to [him] began to rebuke him, saying, [God] be favourable to thee, Lord; this shall in no wise be unto thee.

title: Matthew 16:23
text: But turning round, he said to Peter, Get away behind me, Satan; thou art an offence to me, for thy mind is not on the things that are of God, but on the things that are of men.

title: Matthew 16:24
text: ¶Then Jesus said to his disciples, If any one desires to come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.

title: Matthew 16:25
text: For whosoever shall desire to save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake shall find it.

title: Matthew 16:26
text: For what does a man profit, if he should gain the whole world and suffer the loss of his soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

title: Matthew 16:27
text: For the Son of man is about to come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to each according to his doings.

title: Matthew 16:28
text: Verily I say unto you, There are some of those standing here that shall not taste of death at all until they shall have seen the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

title: Matthew 17:1
text: ¶And after six days Jesus takes with [him] Peter, and James, and John his brother, and brings them up into a high mountain apart.

title: Matthew 17:2
text: And he was transfigured before them. And his face shone as the sun, and his garments became white as the light;

title: Matthew 17:3
text: and lo, Moses and Elias appeared to them talking with him.

title: Matthew 17:4
text: And Peter answering said to Jesus, Lord, it is good we should be here. If thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles: for thee one, and for Moses one, and one for Elias.

title: Matthew 17:5
text: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and lo, a voice out of the cloud, saying, *This* is my beloved Son, in whom I have found my delight: hear him.

title: Matthew 17:6
text: And the disciples hearing [it] fell upon their faces, and were greatly terrified.

title: Matthew 17:7
text: And Jesus coming to [them] touched them, and said, Rise up, and be not terrified.

title: Matthew 17:8
text: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one but Jesus alone.

title: Matthew 17:9
text: And as they descended from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no one, until the Son of man be risen up from among [the] dead.

title: Matthew 17:10
text: And [his] disciples demanded of him saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first have come?

title: Matthew 17:11
text: And he answering said to them, Elias indeed comes first and will restore all things.

title: Matthew 17:12
text: But I say unto you that Elias has already come, and they have not known him, but have done unto him whatever they would. Thus also the Son of man is about to suffer from them.

title: Matthew 17:13
text: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the baptist.

title: Matthew 17:14
text: ¶And when they came to the crowd, a man came to him, falling on his knees before him, and saying,

title: Matthew 17:15
text: Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is lunatic, and suffers sorely; for often he falls into the fire and often into the water.

title: Matthew 17:16
text: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they were not able to heal him.

title: Matthew 17:17
text: And Jesus answering said, O unbelieving and perverted generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? Bring him here to me.

title: Matthew 17:18
text: And Jesus rebuked him, and the demon went out from him, and the boy was healed from that hour.

title: Matthew 17:19
text: Then the disciples, coming to Jesus apart, said [to him], Why were not *we* able to cast him out?

title: Matthew 17:20
text: And he says to them, Because of your unbelief; for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard [seed], ye shall say to this mountain, Be transported hence there, and it shall transport itself; and nothing shall be impossible to you.

title: Matthew 17:21
text: But this kind does not go out but by prayer and fasting.

title: Matthew 17:22
text: ¶And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of man is about to be delivered up into [the] hands of men,

title: Matthew 17:23
text: and they shall kill him; and the third day he shall be raised up. And they were greatly grieved.

title: Matthew 17:24
text: ¶And when they came to Capernaum, those who received the didrachmas came to Peter and said, Does your teacher not pay the didrachmas?

title: Matthew 17:25
text: He says, Yes. And when he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, What dost thou think, Simon? the kings of the earth, from whom do they receive custom or tribute? from their own sons or from strangers?

title: Matthew 17:26
text: Peter says to him, From strangers. Jesus said to him, Then are the sons free.

title: Matthew 17:27
text: But that we may not be an offence to them, go to the sea and cast a hook, and take the first fish that comes up, and when thou hast opened its mouth thou wilt find a stater; take that and give it to them for me and thee.

title: Matthew 18:1
text: ¶In that hour the disciples came to Jesus saying, Who then is greatest in the kingdom of the heavens?

title: Matthew 18:2
text: And Jesus having called a little child to [him], set it in their midst,

title: Matthew 18:3
text: and said, Verily I say to you, Unless ye are converted and become as little children, ye will not at all enter into the kingdom of the heavens.

title: Matthew 18:4
text: Whoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, *he* is the greatest in the kingdom of the heavens;

title: Matthew 18:5
text: and whosoever shall receive one such little child in my name, receives me.

title: Matthew 18:6
text: But whosoever shall offend one of these little ones who believe in me, it were profitable for him that a great millstone had been hanged upon his neck and he be sunk in the depths of the sea.

title: Matthew 18:7
text: ¶Woe to the world because of offences! For it must needs be that offences come; yet woe to that man by whom the offence comes!

title: Matthew 18:8
text: And if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut it off and cast [it] from thee; it is good for thee to enter into life lame or maimed, [rather] than having two hands or two feet to be cast into eternal fire.

title: Matthew 18:9
text: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out and cast [it] from thee; it is good for thee to enter into life one-eyed, [rather] than having two eyes to be cast into the hell of fire.

title: Matthew 18:10
text: See that ye do not despise one of these little ones; for I say unto you that their angels in [the] heavens continually behold the face of my Father who is in [the] heavens.

title: Matthew 18:11
text: For the Son of man has come to save that which was lost.

title: Matthew 18:12
text: What think ye? If a certain man should have a hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, does he not, leaving the ninety and nine on the mountains, go and seek the one that has gone astray?

title: Matthew 18:13
text: And if it should come to pass that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoices more because of it than because of the ninety and nine not gone astray.

title: Matthew 18:14
text: So it is not the will of your Father who is in [the] heavens that one of these little ones should perish.

title: Matthew 18:15
text: ¶But if thy brother sin against thee, go, reprove him between thee and him alone. If he hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

title: Matthew 18:16
text: But if he do not hear [thee], take with thee one or two besides, that every matter may stand upon the word of two witnesses or of three.

title: Matthew 18:17
text: But if he will not listen to them, tell it to the assembly; and if also he will not listen to the assembly, let him be to thee as one of the nations and a tax-gatherer.

title: Matthew 18:18
text: Verily I say to you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on the earth shall be bound in heaven, and whatsoever ye shall loose on the earth shall be loosed in heaven.

title: Matthew 18:19
text: Again I say to you, that if two of you shall agree on the earth concerning any matter, whatsoever it may be that they shall ask, it shall come to them from my Father who is in [the] heavens.

title: Matthew 18:20
text: For where two or three are gathered together unto my name, there am I in the midst of them.

title: Matthew 18:21
text: ¶Then Peter came to him and said, Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me and I forgive him? until seven times?

title: Matthew 18:22
text: Jesus says to him, I say not to thee until seven times, but until seventy times seven.

title: Matthew 18:23
text: For this cause the kingdom of the heavens has become like a king who would reckon with his bondmen.

title: Matthew 18:24
text: And having begun to reckon, one debtor of ten thousand talents was brought to him.

title: Matthew 18:25
text: But he not having anything to pay, [his] lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and his children, and everything that he had, and that payment should be made.

title: Matthew 18:26
text: The bondman therefore falling down did him homage, saying, Lord, have patience with me and I will pay thee all.

title: Matthew 18:27
text: And the lord of that bondman, being moved with compassion, loosed him and forgave him the loan.

title: Matthew 18:28
text: But that bondman having gone out, found one of his fellow-bondmen who owed him a hundred denarii. And having seized him, he throttled him, saying, Pay [me] if thou owest anything.

title: Matthew 18:29
text: His fellow-bondman therefore, having fallen down [at his feet], besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee.

title: Matthew 18:30
text: But he would not, but went away and cast him into prison, until he should pay what was owing.

title: Matthew 18:31
text: But his fellow-bondmen, having seen what had taken place, were greatly grieved, and went and recounted to their lord all that had taken place.

title: Matthew 18:32
text: Then his lord, having called him to [him], says to him, Wicked bondman! I forgave thee all that debt because thou besoughtest me;

title: Matthew 18:33
text: shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellow-bondman, as *I* also had compassion on thee?

title: Matthew 18:34
text: And his lord being angry delivered him to the tormentors till he paid all that was owing to him.

title: Matthew 18:35
text: Thus also my heavenly Father shall do to you if ye forgive not from your hearts every one his brother.

title: Matthew 19:1
text: ¶And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these words, he withdrew from Galilee, and came to the coasts of Judaea beyond the Jordan;

title: Matthew 19:2
text: and great crowds followed him, and he healed them there.

title: Matthew 19:3
text: ¶And the Pharisees came to him tempting him, and saying, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

title: Matthew 19:4
text: But he answering said [to them], Have ye not read that he who made [them], from the beginning made them male and female,

title: Matthew 19:5
text: and said, On account of this a man shall leave father and mother, and shall be united to his wife, and the two shall be one flesh?

title: Matthew 19:6
text: so that they are no longer two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, let not man separate.

title: Matthew 19:7
text: They say to him, Why then did Moses command to give a letter of divorce and to send [her] away?

title: Matthew 19:8
text: He says to them, Moses, in view of your hardheartedness, allowed you to put away your wives; but from the beginning it was not thus.

title: Matthew 19:9
text: But I say unto you, that whosoever shall put away his wife, not for fornication, and shall marry another, commits adultery; and he who marries one put away commits adultery.

title: Matthew 19:10
text: His disciples say to him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

title: Matthew 19:11
text: And he said to them, All cannot receive this word, but those to whom it has been given;

title: Matthew 19:12
text: for there are eunuchs which have been born thus from [their] mother's womb; and there are eunuchs who have been made eunuchs of men; and there are eunuchs who have made eunuchs of themselves for the sake of the kingdom of the heavens. He that is able to receive [it], let him receive [it].

title: Matthew 19:13
