text: ¶Then there were brought to him little children that he might lay his hands on them and pray; but the disciples rebuked them.

title: Matthew 19:14
text: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and do not hinder them from coming to me; for the kingdom of the heavens is of such:

title: Matthew 19:15
text: and having laid his hands upon them, he departed thence.

title: Matthew 19:16
text: ¶And lo, one coming up said to him, Teacher, what good thing shall I do that I may have life eternal?

title: Matthew 19:17
text: And he said to him, What askest thou me concerning goodness? one is good. But if thou wouldest enter into life, keep the commandments.

title: Matthew 19:18
text: He says to him, Which? And Jesus said, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

title: Matthew 19:19
text: Honour thy father and thy mother, and Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

title: Matthew 19:20
text: The young man says to him, All these have I kept; what lack I yet?

title: Matthew 19:21
text: Jesus said to him, If thou wouldest be perfect, go, sell what thou hast and give to [the] poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.

title: Matthew 19:22
text: But the young man, having heard the word, went away grieved, for he had large possessions.

title: Matthew 19:23
text: ¶And Jesus said to his disciples, Verily I say unto you, A rich man shall with difficulty enter into the kingdom of the heavens;

title: Matthew 19:24
text: and again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to enter a needle's eye than a rich man into the kingdom of God.

title: Matthew 19:25
text: And when the disciples heard [it] they were exceedingly astonished, saying, Who then can be saved?

title: Matthew 19:26
text: But Jesus, looking on [them], said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

title: Matthew 19:27
text: Then Peter answering said to him, Behold, *we* have left all things and have followed thee; what then shall happen to us?

title: Matthew 19:28
text: And Jesus said to them, Verily I say unto you, That *ye* who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit down upon his throne of glory, *ye* also shall sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

title: Matthew 19:29
text: And every one who has left houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and shall inherit life eternal.

title: Matthew 19:30
text: But many first shall be last, and last first.

title: Matthew 20:1
text: ¶For the kingdom of the heavens is like a householder who went out with the early morn to hire workmen for his vineyard.

title: Matthew 20:2
text: And having agreed with the workmen for a denarius the day, he sent them into his vineyard.

title: Matthew 20:3
text: And having gone out about [the] third hour, he saw others standing in the market-place idle;

title: Matthew 20:4
text: and to them he said, Go also ye into the vineyard, and whatsoever may be just I will give you. And they went their way.

title: Matthew 20:5
text: Again, having gone out about the sixth and ninth hour, he did likewise.

title: Matthew 20:6
text: But about the eleventh [hour], having gone out, he found others standing, and says to them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

title: Matthew 20:7
text: They say to him, Because no man has hired us. He says to them, Go also ye into the vineyard [and whatsoever may be just ye shall receive].

title: Matthew 20:8
text: But when the evening was come, the lord of the vineyard says to his steward, Call the workmen and pay [them] their wages, beginning from the last even to the first.

title: Matthew 20:9
text: And when they [who came to work] about the eleventh hour came, they received each a denarius.

title: Matthew 20:10
text: And when the first came, they supposed that they would receive more, and they received also themselves each a denarius.

title: Matthew 20:11
text: And on receiving it they murmured against the master of the house,

title: Matthew 20:12
text: saying, These last have worked one hour, and thou hast made them equal to us, who have borne the burden of the day and the heat.

title: Matthew 20:13
text: But he answering said to one of them, [My] friend, I do not wrong thee. Didst thou not agree with me for a denarius?

title: Matthew 20:14
text: Take what is thine and go. But it is my will to give to this last even as to thee:

title: Matthew 20:15
text: is it not lawful for me to do what I will in my own affairs? Is thine eye evil because *I* am good?

title: Matthew 20:16
text: Thus shall the last be first, and the first last; for many are called ones, but few chosen ones.

title: Matthew 20:17
text: ¶And Jesus, going up to Jerusalem, took the twelve disciples with [him] apart in the way, and said to them,

title: Matthew 20:18
text: Behold we go up to Jerusalem, and the Son of man will be delivered up to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death;

title: Matthew 20:19
text: and they will deliver him up to the nations to mock and to scourge and to crucify, and the third day he shall rise again.

title: Matthew 20:20
text: ¶Then came to him the mother of the sons of Zebedee, with her sons, doing homage, and asking something of him.

title: Matthew 20:21
text: And he said to her, What wilt thou? She says to him, Speak [the word] that these my two sons may sit, one on thy right hand and one on thy left in thy kingdom.

title: Matthew 20:22
text: And Jesus answering said, Ye know not what ye ask. Can ye drink the cup which *I* am about to drink? They say to him, We are able.

title: Matthew 20:23
text: [And] he says to them, Ye shall drink indeed my cup, but to sit on my right hand and on [my] left, is not mine to give, but to those for whom it is prepared of my Father.

title: Matthew 20:24
text: And the ten, having heard [of it], were indignant about the two brothers.

title: Matthew 20:25
text: But Jesus having called them to [him], said, Ye know that the rulers of the nations exercise lordship over them, and the great exercise authority over them.

title: Matthew 20:26
text: It shall not be thus amongst you, but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your servant;

title: Matthew 20:27
text: and whosoever will be first among you, let him be your bondman;

title: Matthew 20:28
text: as indeed the Son of man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many.

title: Matthew 20:29
text: ¶And as they went out from Jericho a great crowd followed him.

title: Matthew 20:30
text: And lo, two blind men, sitting by the wayside, having heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out saying, Have mercy on us, Lord, Son of David.

title: Matthew 20:31
text: But the crowd rebuked them, that they might be silent. But they cried out the more, saying, Have mercy on us, Lord, Son of David.

title: Matthew 20:32
text: And Jesus, having stopped, called them and said, What will ye that I shall do to you?

title: Matthew 20:33
text: They say to him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

title: Matthew 20:34
text: And Jesus, moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes had sight restored to them, and they followed him.

title: Matthew 21:1
text: ¶And when they drew near to Jerusalem and came to Bethphage, at the mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

title: Matthew 21:2
text: saying to them, Go into the village over against you, and immediately ye will find an ass tied, and a colt with it; loose [them] and lead [them] to me.

title: Matthew 21:3
text: And if any one say anything to you, ye shall say, The Lord has need of them, and straightway he will send them.

title: Matthew 21:4
text: But all this came to pass, that that might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

title: Matthew 21:5
text: Say to the daughter of Zion, Behold thy King cometh to thee, meek, and mounted upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

title: Matthew 21:6
text: But the disciples, having gone and done as Jesus had ordered them,

title: Matthew 21:7
text: brought the ass and the colt and put their garments upon them, and he sat on them.

title: Matthew 21:8
text: But a very great crowd strewed their own garments on the way, and others kept cutting down branches from the trees and strewing them on the way.

title: Matthew 21:9
text: And the crowds who went before him and who followed cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; blessed [be] he who comes in the name of [the] Lord; hosanna in the highest.

title: Matthew 21:10
text: And as he entered into Jerusalem, the whole city was moved, saying, Who is this?

title: Matthew 21:11
text: And the crowds said, This is Jesus the prophet who is from Nazareth of Galilee.

title: Matthew 21:12
text: ¶And Jesus entered into the temple [of God], and cast out all that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those that sold the doves.

title: Matthew 21:13
text: And he says to them, It is written, My house shall be called a house of prayer, but *ye* have made it a den of robbers.

title: Matthew 21:14
text: And blind and lame came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

title: Matthew 21:15
text: And when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonders which he wrought, and the children crying in the temple and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David, they were indignant,

title: Matthew 21:16
text: and said to him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus says to them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

title: Matthew 21:17
text: And leaving them he went forth out of the city to Bethany, and there he passed the night.

title: Matthew 21:18
text: ¶But early in the morning, as he came back into the city, he hungered.

title: Matthew 21:19
text: And seeing one fig-tree in the way, he came to it and found on it nothing but leaves only. And he says to it, Let there be never more fruit of thee for ever. And the fig-tree was immediately dried up.

title: Matthew 21:20
text: And when the disciples saw [it], they wondered, saying, How immediately is the fig-tree dried up!

title: Matthew 21:21
text: And Jesus answering said to them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and do not doubt, not only shall ye do what [is done] to the fig-tree, but even if ye should say to this mountain, Be thou taken away and be thou cast into the sea, it shall come to pass.

title: Matthew 21:22
text: And all things whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

title: Matthew 21:23
text: ¶And when he came into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him [as he was] teaching, saying, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

title: Matthew 21:24
text: And Jesus answering said to them, *I* also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, *I* also will tell you by what authority I do these things:

title: Matthew 21:25
text: The baptism of John, whence was it? of heaven or of men? And they reasoned among themselves, saying, If we should say, Of heaven, he will say to us, Why then have ye not believed him?

title: Matthew 21:26
text: but if we should say, Of men, we fear the crowd, for all hold John for a prophet.

title: Matthew 21:27
text: And answering Jesus they said, We do not know. *He* also said to them, Neither do *I* tell you by what authority I do these things.

title: Matthew 21:28
text: ¶But what think ye? A man had two children, and coming to the first he said, Child, go to-day, work in [my] vineyard.

title: Matthew 21:29
text: And he answering said, I will not; but afterwards repenting himself he went.

title: Matthew 21:30
text: And coming to the second he said likewise; and he answering said, *I* [go], sir, and went not.

title: Matthew 21:31
text: Which of the two did the will of the father? They say [to him], The first. Jesus says to them, Verily I say unto you that the tax-gatherers and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

title: Matthew 21:32
text: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not; but the tax-gatherers and the harlots believed him; but *ye* when ye saw [it] repented not yourselves afterwards to believe him.

title: Matthew 21:33
text: ¶Hear another parable: There was a householder who planted a vineyard, and made a fence round it, and dug a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and left the country.

title: Matthew 21:34
text: But when the time of fruit drew near, he sent his bondmen to the husbandmen to receive his fruits.

title: Matthew 21:35
text: And the husbandmen took his bondmen, and beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

title: Matthew 21:36
text: Again he sent other bondmen more than the first, and they did to them in like manner.

title: Matthew 21:37
text: And at last he sent to them his son, saying, They will have respect for my son.

title: Matthew 21:38
text: But the husbandmen, seeing the son, said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him and possess his inheritance.

title: Matthew 21:39
text: And they took him, and cast him forth out of the vineyard, and killed him.

title: Matthew 21:40
text: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what shall he do to those husbandmen?

title: Matthew 21:41
text: They say to him, He will miserably destroy those evil [men], and let out the vineyard to other husbandmen, who shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

title: Matthew 21:42
text: Jesus says to them, Have ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which they that builded rejected, this has become the corner-stone: this is of [the] Lord, and it is wonderful in our eyes?

title: Matthew 21:43
text: Therefore I say to you, that the kingdom of God shall be taken from you and shall be given to a nation producing the fruits of it.

title: Matthew 21:44
text: And he that falls on this stone shall be broken, but on whomsoever it shall fall, it shall grind him to powder.

title: Matthew 21:45
text: And the chief priests and the Pharisees, having heard his parables, knew that he spoke about them.

title: Matthew 21:46
text: And seeking to lay hold of him, they were afraid of the crowds, because they held him for a prophet.

title: Matthew 22:1
text: ¶And Jesus answering spoke to them again in parables, saying,

title: Matthew 22:2
text: The kingdom of the heavens has become like a king who made a wedding feast for his son,

title: Matthew 22:3
text: and sent his bondmen to call the persons invited to the wedding feast, and they would not come.

title: Matthew 22:4
text: Again he sent other bondmen, saying, Say to the persons invited, Behold, I have prepared my dinner; my oxen and my fatted beasts are killed, and all things ready; come to the wedding feast.

title: Matthew 22:5
text: But they made light of it, and went, one to his own land, and another to his commerce.

title: Matthew 22:6
text: And the rest, laying hold of his bondmen, ill-treated and slew [them].

title: Matthew 22:7
text: And [when] the king [heard of it he] was wroth, and having sent his forces, destroyed those murderers and burned their city.

title: Matthew 22:8
text: Then he says to his bondmen, The wedding feast is ready, but those invited were not worthy;

title: Matthew 22:9
text: go therefore into the thoroughfares of the highways, and as many as ye shall find invite to the wedding feast.

title: Matthew 22:10
text: And those bondmen went out into the highways, and brought together all as many as they found, both evil and good; and the wedding feast was furnished with guests.

title: Matthew 22:11
text: And the king, having gone in to see the guests, beheld there a man not clothed with a wedding garment.

title: Matthew 22:12
text: And he says to him, [My] friend, how camest thou in here not having on a wedding garment? But he was speechless.

title: Matthew 22:13
text: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him feet and hands, and take him away, and cast him out into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

title: Matthew 22:14
text: For many are called ones, but few chosen ones.

title: Matthew 22:15
text: ¶Then went the Pharisees and held a council how they might ensnare him in speaking.

title: Matthew 22:16
text: And they send out to him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Teacher, we know that thou art true and teachest the way of God in truth, and carest not for any one, for thou regardest not men's person;

title: Matthew 22:17
text: tell us therefore what thou thinkest: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

title: Matthew 22:18
text: But Jesus, knowing their wickedness, said, Why tempt ye me, hypocrites?

title: Matthew 22:19
text: Shew me the money of the tribute. And they presented to him a denarius.

title: Matthew 22:20
text: And he says to them, Whose [is] this image and superscription?

title: Matthew 22:21
text: They say to him, Caesar's. Then he says to them, Pay then what is Caesar's to Caesar, and what is God's to God.

title: Matthew 22:22
text: And when they heard [him], they wondered, and left him, and went away.

title: Matthew 22:23
text: ¶On that day came to him Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection; and they demanded of him,

title: Matthew 22:24
text: saying, Teacher, Moses said, If any one die, not having children, his brother shall marry his wife and shall raise up seed to his brother.

title: Matthew 22:25
text: Now there were with us seven brethren; and the first having married died, and not having seed, left his wife to his brother.

title: Matthew 22:26
text: In like manner also the second and the third, unto the seven.

title: Matthew 22:27
text: And last of all the woman also died.

title: Matthew 22:28
text: In the resurrection therefore of which of the seven shall she be wife, for all had her?

title: Matthew 22:29
text: And Jesus answering said to them, Ye err, not knowing the scriptures nor the power of God.

title: Matthew 22:30
text: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are as angels of God in heaven.

title: Matthew 22:31
text: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read what was spoken to you by God, saying,

title: Matthew 22:32
text: *I* am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not God of [the] dead, but of [the] living.

title: Matthew 22:33
text: And when the crowds heard [it] they were astonished at his doctrine.

title: Matthew 22:34
text: ¶But the Pharisees, having heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, were gathered together.

title: Matthew 22:35
text: And one of them, a lawyer, demanded, tempting him, and saying,

title: Matthew 22:36
text: Teacher, which is the great commandment in the law?

title: Matthew 22:37
text: And he said to him, Thou shalt love [the] Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy understanding.

title: Matthew 22:38
text: This is [the] great and first commandment.

title: Matthew 22:39
text: And [the] second is like it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

title: Matthew 22:40
text: On these two commandments the whole law and the prophets hang.

title: Matthew 22:41
text: ¶And the Pharisees being gathered together, Jesus demanded of them,

title: Matthew 22:42
text: saying, What think ye concerning the Christ? whose son is he? They say to him, David's.

title: Matthew 22:43
text: He says to them, How then does David in Spirit call him Lord, saying,

title: Matthew 22:44
text: The Lord said to my Lord, Sit on my right hand until I put thine enemies under thy feet?

title: Matthew 22:45
text: If therefore David call him Lord, how is he his son?

title: Matthew 22:46
text: And no one was able to answer him a word, nor did any one dare from that day to question him any more.

title: Matthew 23:1
text: ¶Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to his disciples,

title: Matthew 23:2
text: saying, The scribes and the Pharisees have set themselves down in Moses' seat:

title: Matthew 23:3
text: all things therefore, whatever they may tell you, do and keep. But do not after their works, for they say and do not,

title: Matthew 23:4
text: but bind burdens heavy and hard to bear, and lay them on the shoulders of men, but will not move them with their finger.

title: Matthew 23:5
text: And all their works they do to be seen of men: for they make broad their phylacteries and enlarge the borders [of their garments],

title: Matthew 23:6
text: and love the chief place in feasts and the first seats in the synagogues,

title: Matthew 23:7
text: and salutations in the market-places, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

title: Matthew 23:8
text: But *ye*, be not ye called Rabbi; for one is your instructor, and all *ye* are brethren.

title: Matthew 23:9
text: And call not [any one] your father upon the earth; for one is your Father, he who is in the heavens.

title: Matthew 23:10
text: Neither be called instructors, for one is your instructor, the Christ.

title: Matthew 23:11
text: But the greatest of you shall be your servant.

title: Matthew 23:12
text: And whoever shall exalt himself shall be humbled, and whoever shall humble himself shall be exalted.

title: Matthew 23:13
text: ¶But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, for ye shut up the kingdom of the heavens before men; for *ye* do not enter, nor do ye suffer those that are entering to go in.

title: Matthew 23:15
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, for ye compass the sea and the dry [land] to make one proselyte, and when he is become [such], ye make him twofold more [the] son of hell than yourselves.

title: Matthew 23:16
text: Woe to you, blind guides, who say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor.

title: Matthew 23:17
text: Fools and blind, for which is greater, the gold, or the temple which sanctifies the gold?

title: Matthew 23:18
text: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gift that is upon it is a debtor.

title: Matthew 23:19
text: [Fools and] blind ones, for which is greater, the gift, or the altar which sanctifies the gift?

title: Matthew 23:20
text: He therefore that swears by the altar swears by it and by all things that are upon it.

title: Matthew 23:21
text: And he that swears by the temple swears by it and by him that dwells in it.

title: Matthew 23:22
text: And he that swears by heaven swears by the throne of God and by him that sits upon it.

title: Matthew 23:23
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, for ye pay tithes of mint and anise and cummin, and ye have left aside the weightier matters of the law, judgment and mercy and faith: these ye ought to have done and not have left those aside.

title: Matthew 23:24
text: Blind guides, who strain out the gnat, but drink down the camel.

title: Matthew 23:25
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the dish, but within they are full of rapine and intemperance.

title: Matthew 23:26
text: Blind Pharisee, make clean first the inside of the cup and of the dish, that their outside also may become clean.

title: Matthew 23:27
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, for ye are like whited sepulchres, which appear beautiful outwardly, but within are full of dead men's bones and all uncleanness.

title: Matthew 23:28
text: Thus also *ye*, outwardly ye appear righteous to men, but within are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.

title: Matthew 23:29
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets and adorn the tombs of the just,

title: Matthew 23:30
text: and ye say, If we had been in the days of our fathers we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

title: Matthew 23:31
text: So that ye bear witness of yourselves that ye are sons of those who slew the prophets:

title: Matthew 23:32
text: and *ye*, fill ye up the measure of your fathers.

title: Matthew 23:33
text: Serpents, offspring of vipers, how should ye escape the judgment of hell?

title: Matthew 23:34
text: ¶Therefore, behold, *I* send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes; and [some] of them ye will kill and crucify, and [some] of them ye will scourge in your synagogues, and will persecute from city to city;

title: Matthew 23:35
text: so that all righteous blood shed upon the earth should come upon *you*, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

title: Matthew 23:36
text: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

title: Matthew 23:37
text: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, [the city] that kills the prophets and stones those that are sent unto her, how often would I have gathered thy children as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

title: Matthew 23:38
text: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate;

title: Matthew 23:39
text: for I say unto you, Ye shall in no wise see me henceforth until ye say, Blessed [be] he that comes in the name of [the] Lord.

title: Matthew 24:1
text: ¶And Jesus went forth and went away from the temple, and his disciples came to [him] to point out to him the buildings of the temple.

title: Matthew 24:2
text: And he answering said to them, Do ye not see all these things? Verily I say to you, Not a stone shall be left here upon a stone which shall not be thrown down.

title: Matthew 24:3
text: And as he was sitting upon the mount of Olives the disciples came to him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be, and what is the sign of thy coming and [the] completion of the age?

title: Matthew 24:4
text: ¶And Jesus answering said to them, See that no one mislead you.

title: Matthew 24:5
text: For many shall come in my name, saying, *I* am the Christ, and they shall mislead many.

title: Matthew 24:6
text: But ye will hear of wars and rumours of wars. See that ye be not disturbed; for all [these things] must take place, but it is not yet the end.

title: Matthew 24:7
text: For nation shall rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there shall be famines and pestilences, and earthquakes in divers places.

title: Matthew 24:8
text: But all these [are the] beginning of throes.

title: Matthew 24:9
text: Then shall they deliver you up to tribulation, and shall kill you; and ye will be hated of all the nations for my name's sake.

title: Matthew 24:10
text: And then will many be offended, and will deliver one another up, and hate one another;

title: Matthew 24:11
text: and many false prophets shall arise and shall mislead many;

title: Matthew 24:12
text: and because lawlessness shall prevail, the love of the most shall grow cold;

title: Matthew 24:13
text: but he that has endured to the end, *he* shall be saved.

title: Matthew 24:14
text: And these glad tidings of the kingdom shall be preached in the whole habitable earth, for a witness to all the nations, and then shall come the end.

title: Matthew 24:15
text: When therefore ye shall see the abomination of desolation, which is spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in [what is a] holy place, (he that reads let him understand,)

title: Matthew 24:16
text: then let those who are in Judaea flee to the mountains;

title: Matthew 24:17
text: let not him that is on the house come down to take the things out of his house;

title: Matthew 24:18
text: and let not him that is in the field turn back to take his garment.

title: Matthew 24:19
text: But woe to those that are with child, and those that give suck in those days.

title: Matthew 24:20
text: But pray that your flight may not be in winter time nor on sabbath:

title: Matthew 24:21
text: for then shall there be great tribulation, such as has not been from [the] beginning of [the] world until now, nor ever shall be;

title: Matthew 24:22
text: and if those days had not been cut short, no flesh had been saved; but on account of the elect those days shall be cut short.

title: Matthew 24:23
text: Then if any one say to you, Behold, here is the Christ, or here, believe [it] not.

title: Matthew 24:24
text: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall give great signs and wonders, so as to mislead, if possible, even the elect.

title: Matthew 24:25
text: Behold, I have told you beforehand.

title: Matthew 24:26
text: If therefore they say to you, Behold, he is in the desert, go not forth; behold, [he is] in the inner chambers, do not believe [it].

title: Matthew 24:27
text: For as the lightning goes forth from the east and shines to the west, so shall be the coming of the Son of man.

title: Matthew 24:28
text: [For] wherever the carcase is, there will be gathered the eagles.

title: Matthew 24:29
text: But immediately after the tribulation of those days the sun shall be darkened, and the moon not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.

title: Matthew 24:30
text: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven; and then shall all the tribes of the land lament, and they shall see the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

title: Matthew 24:31
text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from [the one] extremity of [the] heavens to [the other] extremity of them.

title: Matthew 24:32
text: ¶But learn the parable from the fig-tree: When already its branch becomes tender and produces leaves, ye know that the summer is near.

title: Matthew 24:33
text: Thus also *ye*, when ye see all these things, know that it is near, at the doors.

title: Matthew 24:34
text: Verily I say to you, This generation will not have passed away until all these things shall have taken place.

title: Matthew 24:35
text: The heaven and the earth shall pass away, but my words shall in no wise pass away.

title: Matthew 24:36
text: But of that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels of the heavens, but [my] Father alone.

title: Matthew 24:37
text: But as the days of Noe, so also shall be the coming of the Son of man.

title: Matthew 24:38
text: For as they were in the days which were before the flood, eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day on which Noe entered into the ark,

title: Matthew 24:39
text: and they knew not till the flood came and took all away; thus also shall be the coming of the Son of man.

title: Matthew 24:40
text: Then two shall be in the field, one is taken and one is left;

title: Matthew 24:41
text: two [women] grinding at the mill, one is taken and one is left.

title: Matthew 24:42
text: Watch therefore, for ye know not in what hour your Lord comes.

title: Matthew 24:43
text: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch the thief was coming, he would have watched and not have suffered his house to be dug through [into].

title: Matthew 24:44
text: Wherefore *ye* also, be ye ready, for in that hour that ye think not the Son of man comes.

title: Matthew 24:45
text: Who then is the faithful and prudent bondman whom his lord has set over his household, to give them food in season?

title: Matthew 24:46
text: Blessed is that bondman whom his lord on coming shall find doing thus.

title: Matthew 24:47
text: Verily I say unto you, that he will set him over all his substance.

title: Matthew 24:48
text: But if that evil bondman should say in his heart, My lord delays to come,

title: Matthew 24:49
text: and begin to beat his fellow-bondmen, and eat and drink with the drunken;

title: Matthew 24:50
text: the lord of that bondman shall come in a day when he does not expect it, and in an hour he knows not of,

title: Matthew 24:51
text: and shall cut him in two and appoint his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

title: Matthew 25:1
text: ¶Then shall the kingdom of the heavens be made like to ten virgins that having taken their torches, went forth to meet the bridegroom.

title: Matthew 25:2
text: And five of them were prudent and five foolish.

title: Matthew 25:3
text: They that were foolish took their torches and did not take oil with them;

title: Matthew 25:4
text: but the prudent took oil in their vessels with their torches.

title: Matthew 25:5
text: Now the bridegroom tarrying, they all grew heavy and slept.

title: Matthew 25:6
text: But in [the] middle of [the] night there was a cry, Behold, the bridegroom; go forth to meet him.

title: Matthew 25:7
text: Then all those virgins arose and trimmed their torches.

title: Matthew 25:8
text: And the foolish said to the prudent, Give us of your oil, for our torches are going out.

title: Matthew 25:9
text: But the prudent answered saying, [We cannot,] lest it might not suffice for us and for you. Go rather to those that sell, and buy for yourselves.

title: Matthew 25:10
text: But as they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and the [ones that were] ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

title: Matthew 25:11
text: Afterwards come also the rest of the virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us;

title: Matthew 25:12
text: but he answering said, Verily I say unto you, I do not know you.

title: Matthew 25:13
text: Watch therefore, for ye know not the day nor the hour.

title: Matthew 25:14
text: ¶For [it is] as [if] a man going away out of a country called his own bondmen and delivered to them his substance.

title: Matthew 25:15
text: And to one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to each according to his particular ability, and immediately went away out of the country.

title: Matthew 25:16
text: And he that had received the five talents went and trafficked with them, and made five other talents.

title: Matthew 25:17
text: In like manner also he that [had received] the two, [he also] gained two others.

title: Matthew 25:18
text: But he that had received the one went and dug in the earth, and hid the money of his lord.

title: Matthew 25:19
text: And after a long time the lord of those bondmen comes and reckons with them.

title: Matthew 25:20
text: And he that had received the five talents came to [him] and brought five other talents, saying, [My] lord, thou deliveredst me five talents; behold, I have gained five other talents besides them.

title: Matthew 25:21
text: His lord said to him, Well, good and faithful bondman, thou wast faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things: enter into the joy of thy lord.

title: Matthew 25:22
text: And he also that had received the two talents came to [him] and said, [My] lord, thou deliveredst me two talents; behold, I have gained two other talents besides them.

title: Matthew 25:23
text: His lord said to him, Well, good and faithful bondman, thou wast faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

title: Matthew 25:24
text: And he also that had received the one talent coming to [him] said, [My] lord, I knew thee that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou hadst not sowed, and gathering from where thou hadst not scattered,

title: Matthew 25:25
text: and being afraid I went away and hid thy talent in the earth; behold, thou hast that which is thine.

title: Matthew 25:26
text: And his lord answering said to him, Wicked and slothful bondman, thou knewest that I reap where I had not sowed, and gather from where I had not scattered;

title: Matthew 25:27
text: thou oughtest then to have put my money to the money-changers, and when I came I should have got what is mine with interest.

title: Matthew 25:28
text: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it to him that has the ten talents:

title: Matthew 25:29
text: for to every one that has shall be given, and he shall be in abundance; but from him that has not, that even which he has shall be taken from him.

title: Matthew 25:30
text: And cast out the useless bondman into the outer darkness; there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

title: Matthew 25:31
text: ¶But when the Son of man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, then shall he sit down upon his throne of glory,

title: Matthew 25:32
text: and all the nations shall be gathered before him; and he shall separate them from one another, as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats;

title: Matthew 25:33
text: and he will set the sheep on his right hand, and the goats on [his] left.

title: Matthew 25:34
text: Then shall the King say to those on his right hand, Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from [the] world's foundation:

title: Matthew 25:35
text: for I hungered, and ye gave me to eat; I thirsted, and ye gave me to drink; I was a stranger, and ye took me in;

title: Matthew 25:36
text: naked, and ye clothed me; I was ill, and ye visited me; I was in prison, and ye came to me.

title: Matthew 25:37
text: Then shall the righteous answer him saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungering, and nourished thee; or thirsting, and gave thee to drink?

title: Matthew 25:38
text: and when saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in; or naked, and clothed thee?

title: Matthew 25:39
text: and when saw we thee ill, or in prison, and came to thee?

title: Matthew 25:40
text: And the King answering shall say to them, Verily, I say to you, Inasmuch as ye have done it to one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it to me.

title: Matthew 25:41
text: Then shall he say also to those on the left, Go from me, cursed, into eternal fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

title: Matthew 25:42
text: for I hungered, and ye gave me not to eat; I thirsted, and ye gave me not to drink;

title: Matthew 25:43
text: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in; naked, and ye did not clothe me; ill, and in prison, and ye did not visit me.

title: Matthew 25:44
text: Then shall *they* also answer saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungering, or thirsting, or a stranger, or naked, or ill, or in prison, and have not ministered to thee?

title: Matthew 25:45
text: Then shall he answer them saying, Verily I say to you, Inasmuch as ye have not done it to one of these least, neither have ye done it to me.

title: Matthew 25:46
text: And these shall go away into eternal punishment, and the righteous into life eternal.

title: Matthew 26:1
text: ¶And it came to pass when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said to his disciples,

title: Matthew 26:2
text: Ye know that after two days the passover takes place, and the Son of man is delivered up to be crucified.

title: Matthew 26:3
text: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people were gathered together to the palace of the high priest who was called Caiaphas,

title: Matthew 26:4
text: and took counsel together in order that they might seize Jesus by subtlety and kill him;

title: Matthew 26:5
text: but they said, Not in the feast, that there be not a tumult among the people.

title: Matthew 26:6
text: ¶But Jesus being in Bethany, in Simon the leper's house,

title: Matthew 26:7
text: a woman, having an alabaster flask of very precious ointment, came to him and poured it out upon his head as he lay at table.

title: Matthew 26:8
text: But the disciples seeing it became indignant, saying, To what end [was] this waste?

title: Matthew 26:9
text: for this might have been sold for much and been given to the poor.

title: Matthew 26:10
text: But Jesus knowing [it] said to them, Why do ye trouble the woman? for she has wrought a good work toward me.

title: Matthew 26:11
text: For ye have the poor always with you, but me ye have not always.

title: Matthew 26:12
text: For in pouring out this ointment on my body, she has done it for my burying.

title: Matthew 26:13
text: Verily I say to you, Wheresoever these glad tidings may be preached in the whole world, that also which this [woman] has done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

title: Matthew 26:14
text: ¶Then one of the twelve, he who was called Judas Iscariote, went to the chief priests

title: Matthew 26:15
text: and said, What are ye willing to give me, and *I* will deliver him up to you? And they appointed to him thirty pieces of silver.

title: Matthew 26:16
text: And from that time he sought a good opportunity that he might deliver him up.

title: Matthew 26:17
text: ¶Now on the first [day] of [the feast of] unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?

title: Matthew 26:18
text: And he said, Go into the city unto such a one, and say to him, The Teacher says, My time is near, I will keep the passover in thy house with my disciples.

title: Matthew 26:19
text: And the disciples did as Jesus had directed them, and they prepared the passover.

title: Matthew 26:20
text: And when the evening was come he lay down at table with the twelve.

title: Matthew 26:21
text: And as they were eating he said, Verily I say to you, that one of you shall deliver me up.

title: Matthew 26:22
text: And being exceedingly grieved they began to say to him, each of them, Is it *I*, Lord?

title: Matthew 26:23
text: But he answering said, He that dips his hand with me in the dish, *he* it is who shall deliver me up.

title: Matthew 26:24
text: The Son of man goes indeed, according as it is written concerning him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is delivered up; it were good for that man if he had not been born.

title: Matthew 26:25
text: And Judas, who delivered him up, answering said, Is it *I*, Rabbi? He says to him, *Thou* hast said.

title: Matthew 26:26
text: ¶And as they were eating, Jesus, having taken [the] bread and blessed, broke [it] and gave [it] to the disciples, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

title: Matthew 26:27
text: And having taken [the] cup and given thanks, he gave [it] to them, saying, Drink ye all of it.

title: Matthew 26:28
text: For this is my blood, that of the [new] covenant, that shed for many for remission of sins.

title: Matthew 26:29
text: But I say to you, that I will not at all drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in the kingdom of my Father.

title: Matthew 26:30
text: And having sung a hymn, they went out to the mount of Olives.

title: Matthew 26:31
text: ¶Then saith Jesus to them, All *ye* shall be offended in me during this night. For it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

title: Matthew 26:32
text: But after that I shall be risen, I will go before you to Galilee.

title: Matthew 26:33
text: And Peter answering said to him, If all shall be offended in thee, *I* will never be offended.

title: Matthew 26:34
text: Jesus said to him, Verily I say to thee, that during this night, before [the] cock shall crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

title: Matthew 26:35
text: Peter says to him, If I should needs die with thee, I will in no wise deny thee. Likewise said all the disciples also.

title: Matthew 26:36
text: ¶Then Jesus comes with them to a place called Gethsemane, and says to the disciples, Sit here until I go away and pray yonder.

title: Matthew 26:37
text: And taking with [him] Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, he began to be sorrowful and deeply depressed.

title: Matthew 26:38
text: Then he says to them, My soul is very sorrowful even unto death; remain here and watch with me.

title: Matthew 26:39
text: And going forward a little he fell upon his face, praying and saying, My Father, if it be possible let this cup pass from me; but not as *I* will, but as *thou* [wilt].

title: Matthew 26:40
text: And he comes to the disciples and finds them sleeping, and says to Peter, Thus ye have not been able to watch one hour with me?

title: Matthew 26:41
text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed [is] ready, but the flesh weak.

title: Matthew 26:42
text: Again going away a second time he prayed saying, My Father, if this cannot pass [from me] unless I drink it, thy will be done.

title: Matthew 26:43
text: And coming he found them again sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

title: Matthew 26:44
text: And leaving them, he went away again and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.

title: Matthew 26:45
text: Then he comes to the disciples and says to them, Sleep on now and take your rest; behold, the hour has drawn nigh, and the Son of man is delivered up into the hands of sinners.

title: Matthew 26:46
text: Arise, let us go; behold, he that delivers me up has drawn nigh.

title: Matthew 26:47
text: ¶And while he was yet speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great crowd with swords and sticks from the chief priests and elders of the people.

title: Matthew 26:48
text: Now he that delivered him up had given them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, he it is: seize him.

title: Matthew 26:49
text: And immediately coming up to Jesus he said, Hail, Rabbi, and covered him with kisses.

title: Matthew 26:50
text: But Jesus said to him, [My] friend, for what purpose art thou come? Then coming up they laid hands upon Jesus and seized him.

title: Matthew 26:51
text: And behold, one of those with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and smiting the bondman of the high priest took off his ear.

title: Matthew 26:52
text: Then saith Jesus to him, Return thy sword to its place; for all who take the sword shall perish by the sword.

title: Matthew 26:53
text: Or thinkest thou that I cannot now call upon my Father, and he will furnish me more than twelve legions of angels?

title: Matthew 26:54
text: How then should the scriptures be fulfilled that thus it must be?

title: Matthew 26:55
text: In that hour Jesus said to the crowds, Are ye come out as against a robber with swords and sticks to take me? I sat daily [with you] teaching in the temple, and ye did not seize me.

title: Matthew 26:56
text: But all this is come to pass that the scriptures of the prophets may be fulfilled. Then all the disciples left him and fled.

title: Matthew 26:57
text: ¶Now they that had seized Jesus led [him] away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

title: Matthew 26:58
text: And Peter followed him at a distance, even to the palace of the high priest, and entering in sat with the officers to see the end.

title: Matthew 26:59
text: And the chief priests and the elders and the whole sanhedrim sought false witness against Jesus, so that they might put him to death.

title: Matthew 26:60
text: And they found none, though many false witnesses came forward. But at the last two false witnesses came forward

title: Matthew 26:61
text: and said, *He* said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and in three days build it.

title: Matthew 26:62
text: And the high priest standing up said to him, Answerest thou nothing? What do these witness against thee?

title: Matthew 26:63
text: But Jesus was silent. And the high priest answering said to him, I adjure thee by the living God that thou tell us if *thou* art the Christ the Son of God.

title: Matthew 26:64
text: Jesus says to him, *Thou* hast said. Moreover, I say to you, From henceforth ye shall see the Son of man sitting at the right hand of power, and coming on the clouds of heaven.

title: Matthew 26:65
text: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He has blasphemed: what need have we any more of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard the blasphemy.

title: Matthew 26:66
text: What think ye? And they answering said, He is liable to the penalty of death.

title: Matthew 26:67
text: Then they spit in his face, and buffeted him, and some struck him with the palms of their hand,

title: Matthew 26:68
text: saying, Prophesy to us, Christ, Who is it who struck thee?

title: Matthew 26:69
text: ¶But Peter sat without in the palace-court; and a maid came to him, saying, And *thou* wast with Jesus the Galilaean.

title: Matthew 26:70
text: But he denied before all, saying, I do not know what thou sayest.

title: Matthew 26:71
text: And when he had gone out into the entrance, another [maid] saw him, and says to those there, This [man] also was with Jesus the Nazaraean.

title: Matthew 26:72
text: And again he denied with an oath: I do not know the man.

title: Matthew 26:73
text: And after a little, those who stood [there], coming to [him], said to Peter, Truly *thou* too art of them, for also thy speech makes thee manifest.

title: Matthew 26:74
text: Then he began to curse and to swear, I know not the man. And immediately [the] cock crew.

title: Matthew 26:75
text: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, who had said [to him], Before [the] cock crow thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went forth without, and wept bitterly.

title: Matthew 27:1
text: ¶And when it was morning all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus so that they might put him to death.

title: Matthew 27:2
text: And having bound him they led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

title: Matthew 27:3
text: Then Judas, who delivered him up, seeing that he had been condemned, filled with remorse, returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and the elders,

title: Matthew 27:4
text: saying, I have sinned [in] having delivered up guiltless blood. But they said, What is that to us? see *thou* [to that].

title: Matthew 27:5
text: And having cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, he left the place, and went away and hanged himself.

title: Matthew 27:6
text: And the chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, It is not lawful to cast them into the Corban, since it is [the] price of blood.

title: Matthew 27:7
text: And having taken counsel, they bought with them the field of the potter for a burying-ground for strangers.

title: Matthew 27:8
text: Wherefore that field has been called Blood-field unto this day.

title: Matthew 27:9
text: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken through Jeremias the prophet, saying, And I took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was set a price on, whom [they who were] of the sons of Israel had set a price on,

title: Matthew 27:10
text: and they gave them for the field of the potter, according as [the] Lord commanded me.

title: Matthew 27:11
text: ¶But Jesus stood before the governor. And the governor questioned him, saying, Art *thou* the King of the Jews? And Jesus said to him, Thou sayest.

title: Matthew 27:12
text: And when he was accused of the chief priests and the elders, he answered nothing.

title: Matthew 27:13
text: Then says Pilate to him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?

title: Matthew 27:14
text: And he answered him not so much as one word, so that the governor wondered exceedingly.

title: Matthew 27:15
text: Now at [the] feast the governor was accustomed to release one prisoner to the crowd, whom they would.

title: Matthew 27:16
text: And they had then a notable prisoner, named Barabbas.

title: Matthew 27:17
text: They therefore being gathered together, Pilate said to them, Whom will ye that I release to you, Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?

title: Matthew 27:18
text: For he knew that they had delivered him up through envy.

title: Matthew 27:19
text: But, as he was sitting on the judgment-seat, his wife sent to him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that righteous [man]; for I have suffered to-day many things in a dream because of him.

title: Matthew 27:20
text: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowds that they should beg for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

title: Matthew 27:21
text: And the governor answering said to them, Which of the two will ye that I release unto you? And they said, Barabbas.

title: Matthew 27:22
text: Pilate says to them, What then shall I do with Jesus, who is called Christ? They all say, Let him be crucified.

title: Matthew 27:23
text: And the governor said, What evil then has he done? But they cried more than ever, saying, Let him be crucified.

title: Matthew 27:24
text: And Pilate, seeing that it availed nothing, but that rather a tumult was arising, having taken water, washed his hands before the crowd, saying, I am guiltless of the blood of this righteous one: see *ye* [to it].

title: Matthew 27:25
text: And all the people answering said, His blood [be] on us and on our children.

title: Matthew 27:26
text: ¶Then he released to them Barabbas; but Jesus, having scourged [him], he delivered up that he might be crucified.

title: Matthew 27:27
text: Then the soldiers of the governor, having taken Jesus with [them] to the praetorium, gathered against him the whole band,

title: Matthew 27:28
text: and having taken off his garment, put on him a scarlet cloak;

title: Matthew 27:29
text: and having woven a crown out of thorns, they put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and, bowing the knee before him, they mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

title: Matthew 27:30
text: And having spit upon him, they took the reed and beat [him] on his head.

title: Matthew 27:31
text: And when they had mocked him, they took the cloak off him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him away to crucify.

title: Matthew 27:32
text: And as they went forth they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name; him they compelled to go [with them] that he might bear his cross.

title: Matthew 27:33
text: ¶And having come to a place called Golgotha, which means Place of a skull,

title: Matthew 27:34
text: they gave to him to drink vinegar mingled with gall; and having tasted [it], he would not drink.

title: Matthew 27:35
text: And having crucified him, they parted his clothes amongst [themselves], casting lots.

title: Matthew 27:36
text: And sitting down, they kept guard over him there.

title: Matthew 27:37
text: And they set up over his head his accusation written: This is Jesus, the King of the Jews.

title: Matthew 27:38
text: Then are crucified with him two robbers, one on the right hand and one on the left.

title: Matthew 27:39
text: But the passers-by reviled him, shaking their heads

title: Matthew 27:40
text: and saying, Thou that destroyest the temple and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou art Son of God, descend from the cross.

title: Matthew 27:41
text: [And] in like manner the chief priests also, mocking, with the scribes and elders, said,

title: Matthew 27:42
text: He saved others, himself he cannot save. He is King of Israel: let him descend now from the cross, and we will believe on him.

title: Matthew 27:43
text: He trusted upon God; let him save him now if he will [have] him. For he said, I am Son of God.

title: Matthew 27:44
text: And the robbers also who had been crucified with him cast the same reproaches on him.

title: Matthew 27:45
text: Now from [the] sixth hour there was darkness over the whole land until [the] ninth hour;

title: Matthew 27:46
text: but about the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

title: Matthew 27:47
text: And some of those who stood there, when they heard [it], said, This [man] calls for Elias.

title: Matthew 27:48
text: And immediately one of them running and getting a sponge, having filled [it] with vinegar and fixed [it] on a reed, gave him to drink.

title: Matthew 27:49
text: But the rest said, Let be; let us see if Elias comes to save him.

title: Matthew 27:50
text: ¶And Jesus, having again cried with a loud voice, gave up the ghost.

title: Matthew 27:51
text: And lo, the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom, and the earth was shaken, and the rocks were rent,

title: Matthew 27:52
text: and the tombs were opened; and many bodies of the saints fallen asleep arose,

title: Matthew 27:53
text: and going out of the tombs after his arising, entered into the holy city and appeared unto many.

title: Matthew 27:54
text: But the centurion, and they who were with him on guard over Jesus, seeing the earthquake and the things that took place, feared greatly, saying, Truly this [man] was Son of God.

title: Matthew 27:55
text: And there were there many women beholding from afar off, who had followed Jesus from Galilee ministering to him,

title: Matthew 27:56
text: among whom was Mary of Magdala, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

title: Matthew 27:57
text: ¶Now when even was come there came a rich man of Arimathaea, his name Joseph, who also himself was a disciple to Jesus.

title: Matthew 27:58
text: *He*, going to Pilate, begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

title: Matthew 27:59
text: And Joseph having got the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

title: Matthew 27:60
text: and laid it in his new tomb which he had hewn in the rock; and having rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, went away.

title: Matthew 27:61
text: But Mary of Magdala was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the sepulchre.

title: Matthew 27:62
text: Now on the morrow, which is after the preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees came together to Pilate,

title: Matthew 27:63
text: saying, Sir, we have called to mind that that deceiver said when he was still alive, After three days I arise.

title: Matthew 27:64
text: Command therefore that the sepulchre be secured until the third day, lest his disciples should come and steal him away, and say to the people, He is risen from the dead; and the last error shall be worse than the first.

title: Matthew 27:65
text: And Pilate said to them, Ye have a watch: go, secure it as well as ye know how.

title: Matthew 27:66
text: And they went and secured the sepulchre, having sealed the stone, with the watch [besides].

title: Matthew 28:1
text: ¶Now late on sabbath, as it was the dusk of the next day after sabbath, came Mary of Magdala and the other Mary to look at the sepulchre.

title: Matthew 28:2
text: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of [the] Lord, descending out of heaven, came and rolled away the stone and sat upon it.

title: Matthew 28:3
text: And his look was as lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

title: Matthew 28:4
text: And for fear of him the guards trembled and became as dead men.

title: Matthew 28:5
text: And the angel answering said to the women, Fear not *ye*, for I know that ye seek Jesus the crucified one.

title: Matthew 28:6
text: He is not here, for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

title: Matthew 28:7
text: And go quickly and say to his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and behold, he goes before you into Galilee, there shall ye see him. Behold, I have told you.

title: Matthew 28:8
text: And going out quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, they ran to bring his disciples word.

title: Matthew 28:9
text: And as they went to bring his disciples word, behold also, Jesus met them, saying, Hail! And they coming up took him by the feet, and did him homage.

title: Matthew 28:10
text: Then Jesus says to them, Fear not; go, bring word to my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there they shall see me.

title: Matthew 28:11
text: ¶And as they went, behold, some of the watch went into the city, and brought word to the chief priests of all that had taken place.

title: Matthew 28:12
text: And having assembled with the elders, and having taken counsel, they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,

title: Matthew 28:13
text: saying, Say that his disciples coming by night stole him [while] we [were] sleeping.

title: Matthew 28:14
text: And if this should come to the hearing of the governor, *we* will persuade him, and save *you* from all anxiety.

title: Matthew 28:15
text: And they took the money and did as they had been taught. And this report is current among the Jews until this day.

title: Matthew 28:16
text: ¶But the eleven disciples went into Galilee to the mountain which Jesus had appointed them.

title: Matthew 28:17
text: And when they saw him, they did homage to him: but some doubted.

title: Matthew 28:18
text: And Jesus coming up spoke to them, saying, All power has been given me in heaven and upon earth.

title: Matthew 28:19
text: Go [therefore] and make disciples of all the nations, baptising them to the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit;

title: Matthew 28:20
text: teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have enjoined you. And behold, *I* am with you all the days, until the completion of the age.

title: Mark 1:1
text: ¶Beginning of the glad tidings of Jesus Christ, Son of God;

title: Mark 1:2
text: as it is written in [Isaiah] the prophet, Behold, *I* send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way.

title: Mark 1:3
text: Voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare the way of [the] Lord, make his paths straight.

title: Mark 1:4
text: There came John baptising in the wilderness, and preaching [the] baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

title: Mark 1:5
text: And there went out to him all the district of Judaea, and all they of Jerusalem, and were baptised by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.

title: Mark 1:6
text: And John was clothed in camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins, and ate locusts and wild honey.

title: Mark 1:7
text: And he preached, saying, There comes he that is mightier than I after me, the thong of whose sandals I am not fit to stoop down and unloose.

title: Mark 1:8
text: *I* indeed have baptised you with water, but *he* shall baptise you with [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Mark 1:9
text: ¶And it came to pass in those days [that] Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptised by John at the Jordan.

title: Mark 1:10
text: And straightway going up from the water, he saw the heavens parting asunder, and the Spirit, as a dove, descending upon him.

title: Mark 1:11
text: And there came a voice out of the heavens: *Thou* art my beloved Son, in thee I have found my delight.

title: Mark 1:12
text: And immediately the Spirit drives him out into the wilderness.

title: Mark 1:13
text: And he was in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan, and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered to him.

title: Mark 1:14
text: ¶But after John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee preaching the glad tidings of the kingdom of God,

title: Mark 1:15
text: and saying, The time is fulfilled and the kingdom of God has drawn nigh; repent and believe in the glad tidings.

title: Mark 1:16
text: And walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon, and Andrew, [Simon's] brother, casting out a net in the sea, for they were fishers.

title: Mark 1:17
text: And Jesus said to them, Come after me, and I will make you become fishers of men;

title: Mark 1:18
text: and straightway leaving their trawl-nets they followed him.

title: Mark 1:19
text: And going on thence a little, he saw James the [son] of Zebedee, and John his brother, and these [were] in the ship repairing the trawl-nets;

title: Mark 1:20
text: and straightway he called them; and leaving their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, they went away after him.

title: Mark 1:21
text: And they go into Capernaum. And straightway on the sabbath he entered into the synagogue and taught.

title: Mark 1:22
text: And they were astonished at his doctrine, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

title: Mark 1:23
text: ¶And there was in their synagogue a man [possessed] by an unclean spirit, and he cried out

title: Mark 1:24
text: saying, Eh! what have we to do with thee, Jesus, Nazarene? Art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the holy one of God.

title: Mark 1:25
text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace and come out of him.

title: Mark 1:26
text: And the unclean spirit, having torn him, and uttered a cry with a loud voice, came out of him.

title: Mark 1:27
text: And all were amazed, so that they questioned together among themselves, saying, What is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.

title: Mark 1:28
text: And his fame went out straightway into the whole region of Galilee around.

title: Mark 1:29
text: ¶And straightway going out of the synagogue, they came with James and John into the house of Simon and Andrew.

title: Mark 1:30
text: And the mother-in-law of Simon lay in a fever. And straightway they speak to him about her.

title: Mark 1:31
text: And he went up to [her] and raised her up, having taken her by the hand, and straightway the fever left her, and she served them.

title: Mark 1:32
text: But evening being come, when the sun had gone down, they brought to him all that were suffering, and those possessed by demons;

title: Mark 1:33
text: and the whole city was gathered together at the door.

title: Mark 1:34
text: And he healed many suffering from various diseases; and he cast out many demons, and did not suffer the demons to speak because they knew him.

title: Mark 1:35
text: And rising in the morning long before day, he went out and went away into a desert place, and there prayed.

title: Mark 1:36
text: And Simon and those with him went after him:

title: Mark 1:37
text: and having found him, they say to him, All seek thee.

title: Mark 1:38
text: And he says to them, Let us go elsewhere into the neighbouring country towns, that I may preach there also, for for this purpose am I come forth.

title: Mark 1:39
text: And he was preaching in their synagogues in the whole of Galilee, and casting out demons.

title: Mark 1:40
text: ¶And there comes to him a leper, beseeching him, and falling on his knees to him, and saying to him, If thou wilt thou canst cleanse me.

title: Mark 1:41
text: But Jesus, moved with compassion, having stretched out his hand, touched him, and says to him, I will, be thou cleansed.

title: Mark 1:42
text: And as he spoke straightway the leprosy left him, and he was cleansed.

title: Mark 1:43
text: And having sharply charged him, he straightway sent him away,

title: Mark 1:44
text: and says to him, See thou say nothing to any one, but go, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing what Moses ordained, for a testimony to them.

title: Mark 1:45
text: But he, having gone forth, began to proclaim [it] much, and to spread the matter abroad, so that he could no longer enter openly into the city, but was without in desert places, and they came to him from every side.

title: Mark 2:1
text: ¶And he entered again into Capernaum after [several] days, and it was reported that he was at [the] house;

title: Mark 2:2
text: and straightway many were gathered together, so that there was no longer any room, not even at the door; and he spoke the word to them.

title: Mark 2:3
text: And there come to him [men] bringing a paralytic, borne by four;

title: Mark 2:4
text: and, not being able to get near to him on account of the crowd, they uncovered the roof where he was, and having dug [it] up they let down the couch on which the paralytic lay.

title: Mark 2:5
text: But Jesus, seeing their faith, says to the paralytic, Child, thy sins are forgiven [thee].

title: Mark 2:6
text: But certain of the scribes were there sitting, and reasoning in their hearts,

title: Mark 2:7
text: Why does this [man] thus speak? he blasphemes. Who is able to forgive sins except God alone?

title: Mark 2:8
text: And straightway Jesus, knowing in his spirit that they are reasoning thus within themselves, said to them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

title: Mark 2:9
text: Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, [Thy] sins are forgiven [thee]; or to say, Arise, and take up thy couch and walk?

title: Mark 2:10
text: But that ye may know that the Son of man has power on earth to forgive sins, he says to the paralytic,

title: Mark 2:11
text: To thee I say, Arise, take up thy couch and go to thine house.

title: Mark 2:12
text: And he rose up straightway, and, having taken up his couch, went out before [them] all, so that all were amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it thus.

title: Mark 2:13
text: ¶And he went out again by the sea, and all the crowd came to him, and he taught them.

title: Mark 2:14
text: And passing by, he saw Levi the [son] of Alphaeus sitting at the tax-office, and says to him, Follow me. And he rose up and followed him.

title: Mark 2:15
text: And it came to pass as he lay at table in his house, that many tax-gatherers and sinners lay at table with Jesus and his disciples; for they were many, and they followed him.

title: Mark 2:16
text: And the scribes and the Pharisees, seeing him eating with sinners and tax-gatherers, said to his disciples, Why [is it] that he eats and drinks with tax-gatherers and sinners?

title: Mark 2:17
text: And Jesus having heard [it] says to them, They that are strong have not need of a physician, but those who are ill. I have not come to call righteous [men], but sinners.

title: Mark 2:18
text: ¶And the disciples of John and the Pharisees were fasting; and they come and say to him, Why do the disciples of John and [the disciples] of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

title: Mark 2:19
text: And Jesus said to them, Can the sons of the bride-chamber fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them they cannot fast.

title: Mark 2:20
text: But days will come when the bridegroom shall have been taken away from them, and then shall they fast in that day.

title: Mark 2:21
text: No one sews a patch of new cloth on an old garment: otherwise its new filling-up takes from the old [stuff], and there is a worse rent.

title: Mark 2:22
text: And no one puts new wine into old skins; otherwise the wine bursts the skins, and the wine is poured out, and the skins will be destroyed; but new wine is to be put into new skins.

title: Mark 2:23
text: And it came to pass that he went on the sabbath through the cornfields; and his disciples began to walk on, plucking the ears.

title: Mark 2:24
text: And the Pharisees said to him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath what is not lawful?

title: Mark 2:25
text: And *he* said to them, Have ye never read what David did when he had need and hungered, *he* and those with him,

title: Mark 2:26
text: how he entered into the house of God, in [the section of] Abiathar [the] high priest, and ate the shew-bread, which it is not lawful unless for the priests to eat, and gave even to those that were with him?

title: Mark 2:27
text: And he said to them, The sabbath was made on account of man, not man on account of the sabbath;

title: Mark 2:28
text: so that the Son of man is lord of the sabbath also.

title: Mark 3:1
text: ¶And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was there a man having his hand dried up.

title: Mark 3:2
text: And they watched him if he would heal him on the sabbath, that they might accuse him.

title: Mark 3:3
text: And he says to the man who had his hand dried up, Rise up [and come] into the midst.

title: Mark 3:4
text: And he says to them, Is it lawful on the sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill? But they were silent.

title: Mark 3:5
text: And looking round upon them with anger, distressed at the hardening of their heart, he says to the man, Stretch out thy hand. And he stretched [it] out, and his hand was restored.

title: Mark 3:6
text: And the Pharisees going out straightway with the Herodians took counsel against him, how they might destroy him.

title: Mark 3:7
text: And Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the sea; and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

title: Mark 3:8
text: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea and beyond the Jordan; and they of around Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, having heard what things he did, came to him.

title: Mark 3:9
text: And he spoke to his disciples, in order that a little ship should wait upon him on account of the crowd, that they might not press upon him.

title: Mark 3:10
text: For he healed many, so that they beset him that they might touch him, as many as had plagues.

title: Mark 3:11
text: And the unclean spirits, when they beheld him, fell down before him, and cried saying, *Thou* art the Son of God.

title: Mark 3:12
text: And he rebuked them much, that they might not make him manifest.

title: Mark 3:13
text: ¶And he goes up into the mountain, and calls whom he himself would, and they went to him.

title: Mark 3:14
text: And he appointed twelve that they might be with him, and that he might send them to preach,

title: Mark 3:15
text: and to have power [to heal diseases, and] to cast out demons.

title: Mark 3:16
text: And he gave to Simon the surname of Peter;

title: Mark 3:17
text: and James the [son] of Zebedee, and John the brother of James, and he gave them the surname of Boanerges, that is, Sons of thunder;

title: Mark 3:18
text: and Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the [son] of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Cananaean,

title: Mark 3:19
text: and Judas Iscariote, who also delivered him up. And they come to [the] house.

title: Mark 3:20
text: And again a crowd comes together, so that they cannot even eat bread.

title: Mark 3:21
text: And his relatives having heard [of it] went out to lay hold on him, for they said, He is out of his mind.

title: Mark 3:22
text: ¶And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem said, He has Beelzebub, and, By the prince of the demons he casts out demons.

title: Mark 3:23
text: And having called them to [him], he said to them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

title: Mark 3:24
text: And if a kingdom has become divided against itself, that kingdom cannot subsist.

title: Mark 3:25
text: And if a house has become divided against itself, that house cannot subsist.

title: Mark 3:26
text: And if Satan rise up against himself, and is divided, he cannot subsist, but has an end.

title: Mark 3:27
text: But no one can, having entered into his house, plunder the goods of the strong [man] unless he first bind the strong [man], and then he will plunder his house.

title: Mark 3:28
text: Verily I say unto you, that all sins shall be forgiven to the sons of men, and all the injurious speeches [with] which they may speak injuriously;

title: Mark 3:29
text: but whosoever shall speak injuriously against the Holy Spirit, to eternity has no forgiveness; but lies under the guilt of an everlasting sin;

title: Mark 3:30
text: --because they said, He has an unclean spirit.

title: Mark 3:31
text: ¶And his brethren and his mother come, and standing without sent to him calling him.

title: Mark 3:32
text: And a crowd sat around him. And they said to him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren seek thee without.

title: Mark 3:33
text: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother or my brethren?

title: Mark 3:34
text: And looking around in a circuit at those that were sitting around him, he says, Behold my mother and my brethren:

title: Mark 3:35
text: for whosoever shall do the will of God, *he* is my brother, and sister, and mother.

title: Mark 4:1
text: ¶And again he began to teach by the sea. And a great crowd was gathered together to him, so that going on board ship he sat in the sea, and all the crowd were close to the sea on the land.

title: Mark 4:2
text: And he taught them many things in parables. And he said to them in his doctrine,

title: Mark 4:3
text: Hearken: Behold, the sower went forth to sow.

title: Mark 4:4
text: And it came to pass as he sowed, one fell by the wayside, and the birds came and devoured it.

title: Mark 4:5
text: And another fell on the rocky ground, where it had not much earth, and immediately it sprung up out [of the ground] because it had no depth of earth;

title: Mark 4:6
text: and when the sun arose it was burnt up, and because of its not having any root, it withered.

title: Mark 4:7
text: And another fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

title: Mark 4:8
text: And another fell into the good ground, and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing; and bore, one thirty, and one sixty, and one a hundred.

title: Mark 4:9
text: And he said, He that has ears to hear, let him hear.

title: Mark 4:10
text: And when he was alone, those about him with the twelve asked him [as to] the parables.

title: Mark 4:11
text: And he said to them, To you is given [to know] the mystery of the kingdom of God; but to them who are without, all things are done in parables,

title: Mark 4:12
text: that beholding they may behold and not see, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest it may be, they should be converted and they should be forgiven.

title: Mark 4:13
text: And he says to them, Do ye not know this parable? and how will ye be acquainted with all the parables?

title: Mark 4:14
text: The sower sows the word:

title: Mark 4:15
text: and these are they by the wayside where the word is sown, and when they hear, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.

title: Mark 4:16
text: And these are they in like manner who are sown upon the rocky places, who when they hear the word, immediately receive it with joy,

title: Mark 4:17
text: and they have no root in themselves, but are for a time: then, tribulation arising, or persecution on account of the word, immediately they are offended.

title: Mark 4:18
text: And others are they who are sown among the thorns: these are they who have heard the word,

title: Mark 4:19
text: and the cares of life, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things, entering in, choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

title: Mark 4:20
text: And these are they who have been sown on the good ground, such as hear the word and receive it, and bear fruit; one thirty, and one sixty, and one a hundred [fold].

title: Mark 4:21
text: ¶And he said to them, Does the lamp come that it should be put under the bushel or under the couch? [Is it] not that it should be set upon the lamp-stand?

title: Mark 4:22
text: For there is nothing hidden which shall not be made manifest; nor does any secret thing take place, but that it should come to light.

title: Mark 4:23
text: If any one have ears to hear, let him hear.

title: Mark 4:24
text: And he said to them, Take heed what ye hear; with what measure ye mete, it shall be meted to you; and there shall be [more] added to you.

title: Mark 4:25
text: For whosoever has, to him shall be given; and he who has not, even what he has shall be taken from him.

title: Mark 4:26
text: And he said, Thus is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast the seed upon the earth,

title: Mark 4:27
text: and should sleep and rise up night and day, and the seed should sprout and grow, he does not know how.

title: Mark 4:28
text: The earth bears fruit of itself, first [the] blade, then an ear, then full corn in the ear.

title: Mark 4:29
text: But when the fruit is produced, immediately he sends the sickle, for the harvest is come.

title: Mark 4:30
text: And he said, How should we liken the kingdom of God, or with what comparison should we compare it?

title: Mark 4:31
text: As to a grain of mustard [seed], which, when it is sown upon the earth, is less than all seeds which are upon the earth,

title: Mark 4:32
