text: But God said to him, Fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee; and whose shall be what thou hast prepared?

title: Luke 12:21
text: Thus is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

title: Luke 12:22
text: ¶And he said to his disciples, For this cause I say unto you, Be not careful for life, what ye shall eat, nor for the body, what ye shall put on.

title: Luke 12:23
text: The life is more than food, and the body than raiment.

title: Luke 12:24
text: Consider the ravens, that they sow not nor reap; which have neither storehouse nor granary; and God feeds them. How much better are *ye* than the birds?

title: Luke 12:25
text: But which of you by being careful can add to his stature one cubit?

title: Luke 12:26
text: If therefore ye cannot [do] even what is least, why are ye careful about the rest?

title: Luke 12:27
text: Consider the lilies how they grow: they neither toil nor spin; but I say unto you, Not even Solomon in all his glory was clothed as one of these.

title: Luke 12:28
text: But if God thus clothe the grass, which to-day is in the field and to-morrow is cast into [the] oven, how much rather you, O ye of little faith?

title: Luke 12:29
text: And *ye*, seek not what ye shall eat or what ye shall drink, and be not in anxiety;

title: Luke 12:30
text: for all these things do the nations of the world seek after, and your Father knows that ye have need of these things;

title: Luke 12:31
text: but seek his kingdom, and [all] these things shall be added to you.

title: Luke 12:32
text: Fear not, little flock, for it has been the good pleasure of your Father to give you the kingdom.

title: Luke 12:33
text: Sell what ye possess and give alms; make to yourselves purses which do not grow old, a treasure which does not fail in the heavens, where thief does not draw near nor moth destroy.

title: Luke 12:34
text: For where your treasure is, there also will your heart be.

title: Luke 12:35
text: Let your loins be girded about, and lamps burning;

title: Luke 12:36
text: and *ye* like men who wait their own lord whenever he may leave the wedding, that when he comes and knocks, they may open to him immediately.

title: Luke 12:37
text: Blessed are those bondmen whom the lord [on] coming shall find watching; verily I say unto you, that he will gird himself and make them recline at table, and coming up will serve them.

title: Luke 12:38
text: And if he come in the second watch, and come in the third watch, and find [them] thus, blessed are those [bondmen].

title: Luke 12:39
text: But this know, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be dug through.

title: Luke 12:40
text: And ye therefore, be *ye* ready, for in the hour in which ye do not think [it], the Son of man comes.

title: Luke 12:41
text: ¶And Peter said to him, Lord, sayest thou this parable to us, or also to all?

title: Luke 12:42
text: And the Lord said, Who then is the faithful and prudent steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give the measure of corn in season?

title: Luke 12:43
text: Blessed is that bondman whom his lord [on] coming shall find doing thus;

title: Luke 12:44
text: verily I say unto you, that he will set him over all that he has.

title: Luke 12:45
text: But if that bondman should say in his heart, My lord delays to come, and begin to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and to drink and to be drunken,

title: Luke 12:46
text: the lord of that bondman shall come in a day when he does not expect it, and in an hour he knows not of, and shall cut him in two and appoint his portion with the unbelievers.

title: Luke 12:47
text: But that bondman who knew his own lord's will, and had not prepared [himself] nor done his will, shall be beaten with many [stripes];

title: Luke 12:48
text: but he who knew [it] not, and did things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few. And to every one to whom much has been given, much shall be required from him; and to whom [men] have committed much, they will ask from him the more.

title: Luke 12:49
text: I have come to cast a fire on the earth; and what will I if already it has been kindled?

title: Luke 12:50
text: But I have a baptism to be baptised with, and how am I straitened until it shall have been accomplished!

title: Luke 12:51
text: Think ye that I have come to give peace in the earth? Nay, I say to you, but rather division:

title: Luke 12:52
text: for from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided; three shall be divided against two, and two against three:

title: Luke 12:53
text: father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against mother; a mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

title: Luke 12:54
text: ¶And he said also to the crowds, When ye see a cloud rising out of the west, straightway ye say, A shower is coming; and so it happens.

title: Luke 12:55
text: And when [ye see] the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it happens.

title: Luke 12:56
text: Hypocrites, ye know how to judge of the appearance of the earth and of the heaven; how [is it then that] ye do not discern this time?

title: Luke 12:57
text: And why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

title: Luke 12:58
text: For as thou goest with thine adverse party before a magistrate, strive in the way to be reconciled with him, lest he drag thee away to the judge, and the judge shall deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

title: Luke 12:59
text: I say unto thee, Thou shalt in no wise come out thence until thou hast paid the very last mite.

title: Luke 13:1
text: ¶Now at the same time there were present some who told him of the Galileans whose blood Pilate mingled with [that of] their sacrifices.

title: Luke 13:2
text: And he answering said to them, Think ye that these Galileans were sinners beyond all the Galileans because they suffered such things?

title: Luke 13:3
text: No, I say to you, but if ye repent not, ye shall all perish in the same manner.

title: Luke 13:4
text: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them, think ye that *they* were debtors beyond all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

title: Luke 13:5
text: No, I say to you, but if ye repent not, ye shall all perish in like manner.

title: Luke 13:6
text: ¶And he spoke this parable: A certain [man] had a fig-tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit upon it and did not find [any].

title: Luke 13:7
text: And he said to the vinedresser, Behold, [these] three years I come seeking fruit on this fig-tree and find none: cut it down; why does it also render the ground useless?

title: Luke 13:8
text: But he answering says to him, Sir, let it alone for this year also, until I shall dig about it and put dung,

title: Luke 13:9
text: and if it shall bear fruit--but if not, after that thou shalt cut it down.

title: Luke 13:10
text: ¶And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

title: Luke 13:11
text: And lo, [there was] a woman having a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent together and wholly unable to lift her head up.

title: Luke 13:12
text: And Jesus, seeing her, called to [her], and said to her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.

title: Luke 13:13
text: And he laid his hands upon her; and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

title: Luke 13:14
text: But the ruler of the synagogue, indignant because Jesus healed on the sabbath, answering said to the crowd, There are six days in which [people] ought to work; in these therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

title: Luke 13:15
text: The Lord therefore answered him and said, Hypocrites! does not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the manger and leading [it] away, water [it]?

title: Luke 13:16
text: And this [woman], who is a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has bound, lo, [these] eighteen years, ought she not to be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

title: Luke 13:17
text: And as he said these things, all who were opposed to him were ashamed; and all the crowd rejoiced at all the glorious things which were being done by him.

title: Luke 13:18
text: ¶And he said, To what is the kingdom of God like? and to what shall I liken it?

title: Luke 13:19
text: It is like a grain of mustard [seed] which a man took and cast into his garden; and it grew and became a great tree, and the birds of heaven lodged in its branches.

title: Luke 13:20
text: And again he said, To what shall I liken the kingdom of God?

title: Luke 13:21
text: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal until the whole was leavened.

title: Luke 13:22
text: And he went through one city and village after another, teaching, and journeying to Jerusalem.

title: Luke 13:23
text: ¶And one said to him, Sir, [are] such as are to be saved few in number? But he said unto them,

title: Luke 13:24
text: Strive with earnestness to enter in through the narrow door, for many, I say to you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

title: Luke 13:25
text: From the time that the master of the house shall have risen up and shall have shut the door, and ye shall begin to stand without and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, open to us; and he answering shall say to you, I know you not whence ye are:

title: Luke 13:26
text: then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten in thy presence and drunk, and thou hast taught in our streets;

title: Luke 13:27
text: and he shall say, I tell you, I do not know you whence ye are; depart from me, all [ye] workers of iniquity.

title: Luke 13:28
text: There shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but yourselves cast out.

title: Luke 13:29
text: And they shall come from east and west, and from north and south, and shall lie down at table in the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 13:30
text: And behold, there are last who shall be first, and there are first who shall be last.

title: Luke 13:31
text: ¶The same hour certain Pharisees came up, saying to him, Get out, and go hence, for Herod is desirous to kill thee.

title: Luke 13:32
text: And he said to them, Go, tell that fox, Behold, I cast out demons and accomplish cures to-day and to-morrow, and the third [day] I am perfected;

title: Luke 13:33
text: but I must needs walk to-day and to-morrow and the [day] following, for it must not be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

title: Luke 13:34
text: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the [city] that kills the prophets and stones those that are sent unto her, how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen her brood under her wings, and ye would not.

title: Luke 13:35
text: Behold, your house is left unto you; and I say unto you, that ye shall not see me until it come that ye say, Blessed [is] he that comes in the name of [the] Lord.

title: Luke 14:1
text: ¶And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the rulers, [who was] of the Pharisees, to eat bread on [the] sabbath, that *they* were watching him.

title: Luke 14:2
text: And behold, there was a certain dropsical [man] before him.

title: Luke 14:3
text: And Jesus answering spoke unto the doctors of the law and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath?

title: Luke 14:4
text: But they were silent. And taking him he healed him and let him go.

title: Luke 14:5
text: And answering he said to them, Of which of you shall an ass or ox fall into a well, that he does not straightway pull him up on the sabbath day?

title: Luke 14:6
text: And they were not able to answer him to these things.

title: Luke 14:7
text: ¶And he spoke a parable to those that were invited, remarking how they chose out the first places, saying to them,

title: Luke 14:8
text: When thou art invited by any one to a wedding, do not lay thyself down in the first place at table, lest perhaps a more honourable than thou be invited by him,

title: Luke 14:9
text: and he who invited thee and him come and say to thee, Give place to this [man], and then thou begin with shame to take the last place.

title: Luke 14:10
text: But when thou hast been invited, go and put thyself down in the last place, that when he who has invited thee comes, he may say to thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have honour before all that are lying at table with thee;

title: Luke 14:11
text: for every one that exalts himself shall be abased, and he that abases himself shall be exalted.

title: Luke 14:12
text: And he said also to him that had invited him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, nor thy kinsfolk, nor rich neighbours, lest it may be they also should invite thee in return, and a recompense be made thee.

title: Luke 14:13
text: But when thou makest a feast, call poor, crippled, lame, blind:

title: Luke 14:14
text: and thou shalt be blessed; for they have not [the means] to recompense thee; for it shall be recompensed thee in the resurrection of the just.

title: Luke 14:15
text: ¶And one of those that were lying at table with [them], hearing these things, said to him, Blessed [is] he who shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 14:16
text: And he said to him, A certain man made a great supper and invited many.

title: Luke 14:17
text: And he sent his bondman at the hour of supper to say to those who were invited, Come, for already all things are ready.

title: Luke 14:18
text: And all began, without exception, to excuse themselves. The first said to him, I have bought land, and I must go out and see it; I pray thee hold me for excused.

title: Luke 14:19
text: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them; I pray thee hold me for excused.

title: Luke 14:20
text: And another said, I have married a wife, and on this account I cannot come.

title: Luke 14:21
text: And the bondman came up and brought back word of these things to his lord. Then the master of the house, in anger, said to his bondman, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring here the poor and crippled and lame and blind.

title: Luke 14:22
text: And the bondman said, Sir, it is done as thou hast commanded, and there is still room.

title: Luke 14:23
text: And the lord said to the bondman, Go out into the ways and fences and compel to come in, that my house may be filled;

title: Luke 14:24
text: for I say to you, that not one of those men who were invited shall taste of my supper.

title: Luke 14:25
text: ¶And great crowds went with him; and, turning round, he said to them,

title: Luke 14:26
text: If any man come to me, and shall not hate his own father and mother, and wife, and children, and brothers, and sisters, yea, and his own life too, he cannot be my disciple;

title: Luke 14:27
text: and whoever does not carry his cross and come after me cannot be my disciple.

title: Luke 14:28
text: For which of you, desirous of building a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost, if he have what [is needed] to complete it;

title: Luke 14:29
text: in order that, having laid the foundation of it, and not being able to finish it, all who see it do not begin to mock at him,

title: Luke 14:30
text: saying, This man began to build and was not able to finish?

title: Luke 14:31
text: Or what king, going on his way to engage in war with another king, does not, sitting down first, take counsel whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him coming against him with twenty thousand?

title: Luke 14:32
text: and if not, while he is yet far off, having sent an embassy, he asks for terms of peace.

title: Luke 14:33
text: Thus then every one of you who forsakes not all that is his own cannot be my disciple.

title: Luke 14:34
text: Salt [then] [is] good, but if the salt also has become savourless, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

title: Luke 14:35
text: It is proper neither for land nor for dung; it is cast out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

title: Luke 15:1
text: ¶And all the tax-gatherers and the sinners were coming near to him to hear him;

title: Luke 15:2
text: and the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, This [man] receives sinners and eats with them.

title: Luke 15:3
text: And he spoke to them this parable, saying,

title: Luke 15:4
text: What man of you having a hundred sheep, and having lost one of them, does not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

title: Luke 15:5
text: and having found it, he lays it upon his own shoulders, rejoicing;

title: Luke 15:6
text: and being come to the house, calls together the friends and the neighbours, saying to them, Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep.

title: Luke 15:7
text: I say unto you, that thus there shall be joy in heaven for one repenting sinner, [more] than for ninety and nine righteous who have no need of repentance.

title: Luke 15:8
text: Or, what woman having ten drachmas, if she lose one drachma, does not light a lamp and sweep the house and seek carefully till she find it?

title: Luke 15:9
text: and having found it she calls together the friends and neighbours, saying, Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost.

title: Luke 15:10
text: Thus, I say unto you, there is joy before the angels of God for one repenting sinner.

title: Luke 15:11
text: ¶And he said, A certain man had two sons;

title: Luke 15:12
text: and the younger of them said to his father, Father, give to me the share of the property that falls [to me]. And he divided to them what he was possessed of.

title: Luke 15:13
text: And after not many days the younger son gathering all together went away into a country a long way off, and there dissipated his property, living in debauchery.

title: Luke 15:14
text: But when he had spent all there arose a violent famine throughout that country, and he began to be in want.

title: Luke 15:15
text: And he went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

title: Luke 15:16
text: And he longed to fill his belly with the husks which the swine were eating; and no one gave to him.

title: Luke 15:17
text: And coming to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have abundance of bread, and *I* perish here by famine.

title: Luke 15:18
text: I will rise up and go to my father, and I will say to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven and before thee;

title: Luke 15:19
text: I am no longer worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

title: Luke 15:20
text: And he rose up and went to his own father. But while he was yet a long way off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell upon his neck, and covered him with kisses.

title: Luke 15:21
text: And the son said to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven and before thee; I am no longer worthy to be called thy son.

title: Luke 15:22
text: But the father said to his bondmen, Bring out the best robe and clothe him in [it], and put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet;

title: Luke 15:23
text: and bring the fatted calf and kill it, and let us eat and make merry:

title: Luke 15:24
text: for this my son was dead and has come to life, was lost and has been found. And they began to make merry.

title: Luke 15:25
text: And his elder son was in the field; and as, coming [up], he drew nigh to the house, he heard music and dancing.

title: Luke 15:26
text: And having called one of the servants, he inquired what these things might be.

title: Luke 15:27
text: And he said to him, Thy brother is come, and thy father has killed the fatted calf because he has received him safe and well.

title: Luke 15:28
text: But he became angry and would not go in. And his father went out and besought him.

title: Luke 15:29
text: But he answering said to his father, Behold, so many years I serve thee, and never have I transgressed a commandment of thine; and to me hast thou never given a kid that I might make merry with my friends:

title: Luke 15:30
text: but when this thy son, who has devoured thy substance with harlots, is come, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

title: Luke 15:31
text: But he said to him, Child, *thou* art ever with me, and all that is mine is thine.

title: Luke 15:32
text: But it was right to make merry and rejoice, because this thy brother was dead and has come to life again, and was lost and has been found.

title: Luke 16:1
text: ¶And he said also to [his] disciples, There was a certain rich man who had a steward, and *he* was accused to him as wasting his goods.

title: Luke 16:2
text: And having called him, he said to him, What [is] this that I hear of thee? give the reckoning of thy stewardship, for thou canst be no longer steward.

title: Luke 16:3
text: And the steward said within himself, What shall I do; for my lord is taking the stewardship from me? I am not able to dig; I am ashamed to beg.

title: Luke 16:4
text: I know what I will do, that when I shall have been removed from the stewardship I may be received into their houses.

title: Luke 16:5
text: And having called to [him] each one of the debtors of his own lord, he said to the first, How much owest thou to my lord?

title: Luke 16:6
text: And he said, A hundred baths of oil. And he said to him, Take thy writing and sit down quickly and write fifty.

title: Luke 16:7
text: Then he said to another, And thou, how much dost thou owe? And he said, A hundred cors of wheat. And he says to him, Take thy writing and write eighty.

title: Luke 16:8
text: And the lord praised the unrighteous steward because he had done prudently. For the sons of this world are, for their own generation, more prudent than the sons of light.

title: Luke 16:9
text: And *I* say to you, Make to yourselves friends with the mammon of unrighteousness, that when it fails ye may be received into the eternal tabernacles.

title: Luke 16:10
text: He that is faithful in the least is faithful also in much; and he that is unrighteous in the least is unrighteous also in much.

title: Luke 16:11
text: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who shall entrust to you the true?

title: Luke 16:12
text: and if ye have not been faithful in that which is another's, who shall give to you your own?

title: Luke 16:13
text: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and will love the other, or he will cleave to the one and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

title: Luke 16:14
text: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things, and mocked him.

title: Luke 16:15
text: And he said to them, *Ye* are they who justify themselves before men, but God knows your hearts; for what amongst men is highly thought of is an abomination before God.

title: Luke 16:16
text: The law and the prophets [were] until John: from that time the glad tidings of the kingdom of God are announced, and every one forces his way into it.

title: Luke 16:17
text: But it is easier that the heaven and the earth should pass away than that one tittle of the law should fail.

title: Luke 16:18
text: Every one who puts away his wife and marries another commits adultery; and every one that marries one put away from a husband commits adultery.

title: Luke 16:19
text: ¶Now there was a rich man and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, making good cheer in splendour every day.

title: Luke 16:20
text: And [there was] a poor man, by name Lazarus, [who] was laid at his gateway full of sores,

title: Luke 16:21
text: and desiring to be filled with the crumbs which fell from the table of the rich man; but the dogs also coming licked his sores.

title: Luke 16:22
text: And it came to pass that the poor man died, and that he was carried away by the angels into the bosom of Abraham. And the rich man also died and was buried.

title: Luke 16:23
text: And in hades lifting up his eyes, being in torments, he sees Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

title: Luke 16:24
text: And he crying out said, Father Abraham, have compassion on me, and send Lazarus that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, for I am suffering in this flame.

title: Luke 16:25
text: But Abraham said, Child, recollect that *thou* hast fully received thy good things in thy lifetime, and likewise Lazarus evil things. But now he is comforted here, and *thou* art in suffering.

title: Luke 16:26
text: And besides all this, between us and you a great chasm is fixed, so that those who desire to pass hence to you cannot, nor do they who [desire to cross] from there pass over unto us.

title: Luke 16:27
text: And he said, I beseech thee then, father, that thou wouldest send him to the house of my father,

title: Luke 16:28
text: for I have five brothers, so that he may earnestly testify to them, that they also may not come to this place of torment.

title: Luke 16:29
text: But Abraham says to him, They have Moses and the prophets: let them hear them.

title: Luke 16:30
text: But he said, Nay, father Abraham, but if one from the dead should go to them, they will repent.

title: Luke 16:31
text: And he said to him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, not even if one rise from among [the] dead will they be persuaded.

title: Luke 17:1
text: ¶And he said to his disciples, It cannot be but that offences come, but woe [to him] by whom they come!

title: Luke 17:2
text: It would be [more] profitable for him if a millstone were hanged about his neck and he cast into the sea, than that he should be a snare to one of these little ones.

title: Luke 17:3
text: Take heed to yourselves: if thy brother should sin, rebuke him; and if he should repent, forgive him.

title: Luke 17:4
text: And if he should sin against thee seven times in the day, and seven times should return to thee, saying, I repent, thou shalt forgive him.

title: Luke 17:5
text: And the apostles said to the Lord, Give more faith to us.

title: Luke 17:6
text: But the Lord said, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard [seed], ye had said to this sycamine tree, Be thou rooted up, and be thou planted in the sea, and it would have obeyed you.

title: Luke 17:7
text: But which of you [is there] who, having a bondman ploughing or shepherding, when he comes in out of the field, will say, Come and lie down immediately to table?

title: Luke 17:8
text: But will he not say to him, Prepare what I shall sup on, and gird thyself and serve me that I may eat and drink; and after that *thou* shalt eat and drink?

title: Luke 17:9
text: Is he thankful to the bondman because he has done what was ordered? I judge not.

title: Luke 17:10
text: Thus *ye* also, when ye shall have done all things that have been ordered you, say, We are unprofitable bondmen; we have done what it was our duty to do.

title: Luke 17:11
text: ¶And it came to pass as he was going up to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

title: Luke 17:12
text: And as he entered into a certain village ten leprous men met him, who stood afar off.

title: Luke 17:13
text: And they lifted up [their] voice saying, Jesus, Master, have compassion on us.

title: Luke 17:14
text: And seeing [them] he said to them, Go, shew yourselves to the priests. And it came to pass as they were going they were cleansed.

title: Luke 17:15
text: And one of them, seeing that he was cured, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice,

title: Luke 17:16
text: and fell on [his] face at his feet giving him thanks: and *he* was a Samaritan.

title: Luke 17:17
text: And Jesus answering said, Were not the ten cleansed? but the nine, where [are they]?

title: Luke 17:18
text: There have not been found to return and give glory to God save this stranger.

title: Luke 17:19
text: And he said to him, Rise up and go thy way: thy faith has made thee well.

title: Luke 17:20
text: ¶And having been asked by the Pharisees, When is the kingdom of God coming? he answered them and said, The kingdom of God does not come with observation;

title: Luke 17:21
text: nor shall they say, Lo here, or, Lo there; for behold, the kingdom of God is in the midst of you.

title: Luke 17:22
text: And he said to the disciples, Days are coming, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and shall not see [it].

title: Luke 17:23
text: And they will say to you, Lo here, or Lo there; go not, nor follow [them].

title: Luke 17:24
text: For as the lightning shines which lightens from [one end] under heaven to [the other end] under heaven, thus shall the Son of man be in his day.

title: Luke 17:25
text: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected of this generation.

title: Luke 17:26
text: And as it took place in the days of Noe, thus also shall it be in the days of the Son of man:

title: Luke 17:27
text: they ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came and destroyed all [of them];

title: Luke 17:28
text: and in like manner as took place in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

title: Luke 17:29
text: but on the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulphur from heaven, and destroyed all [of them]:

title: Luke 17:30
text: after this [manner] shall it be in the day that the Son of man is revealed.

title: Luke 17:31
text: In that day, he who shall be on the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not go down to take it away; and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

title: Luke 17:32
text: Remember the wife of Lot.

title: Luke 17:33
text: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it, and whosoever shall lose it shall preserve it.

title: Luke 17:34
text: I say to you, In that night there shall be two [men] upon one bed; one shall be seized and the other shall be let go.

title: Luke 17:35
text: Two [women] shall be grinding together; the one shall be seized and the other shall be let go.

title: Luke 17:36
text: [Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be seized and the other let go.]

title: Luke 17:37
text: And answering they say to him, Where, Lord? And he said to them, Where the body [is], there the eagles will be gathered together.

title: Luke 18:1
text: ¶And he spoke also a parable to them to the purport that they should always pray and not faint,

title: Luke 18:2
text: saying, There was a judge in a city, not fearing God and not respecting man:

title: Luke 18:3
text: and there was a widow in that city, and she came to him, saying, Avenge me of mine adverse party.

title: Luke 18:4
text: And he would not for a time; but afterwards he said within himself, If even I fear not God and respect not man,

title: Luke 18:5
text: at any rate because this widow annoys me I will avenge her, that she may not by perpetually coming completely harass me.

title: Luke 18:6
text: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge says.

title: Luke 18:7
text: And shall not God at all avenge his elect, who cry to him day and night, and he bears long as to them?

title: Luke 18:8
text: I say unto you that he will avenge them speedily. But when the Son of man comes, shall he indeed find faith on the earth?

title: Luke 18:9
text: ¶And he spoke also to some, who trusted in themselves that they were righteous and made nothing of all the rest [of men], this parable:

title: Luke 18:10
text: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a tax-gatherer.

title: Luke 18:11
text: The Pharisee, standing, prayed thus to himself: God, I thank thee that I am not as the rest of men, rapacious, unjust, adulterers, or even as this tax-gatherer.

title: Luke 18:12
text: I fast twice in the week, I tithe everything I gain.

title: Luke 18:13
text: And the tax-gatherer, standing afar off, would not lift up even his eyes to heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, O God, have compassion on me, the sinner.

title: Luke 18:14
text: I say unto you, This [man] went down to his house justified rather than that [other]. For every one who exalts himself shall be humbled, and he that humbles himself shall be exalted.

title: Luke 18:15
text: ¶And they brought to him also infants that he might touch them, but the disciples when they saw [it] rebuked them.

title: Luke 18:16
text: But Jesus calling them to [him] said, Suffer little children to come to me, and do not forbid them, for of such is the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 18:17
text: Verily I say to you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

title: Luke 18:18
text: ¶And a certain ruler asked him saying, Good teacher, having done what, shall I inherit eternal life?

title: Luke 18:19
text: But Jesus said to him, Why callest thou me good? There is none good but one, God.

title: Luke 18:20
text: Thou knowest the commandments: Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

title: Luke 18:21
text: And he said, All these things have I kept from my youth.

title: Luke 18:22
text: And when Jesus had heard this, he said to him, One thing is lacking to thee yet: Sell all that thou hast and distribute to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in the heavens, and come, follow me.

title: Luke 18:23
text: But when he heard this he became very sorrowful, for he was very rich.

title: Luke 18:24
text: But when Jesus saw that he became very sorrowful, he said, How difficultly shall those who have riches enter into the kingdom of God;

title: Luke 18:25
text: for it is easier for a camel to enter through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 18:26
text: And those who heard it said, And who can be saved?

title: Luke 18:27
text: But he said, The things that are impossible with men are possible with God.

title: Luke 18:28
text: And Peter said, Behold, *we* have left all things and have followed thee.

title: Luke 18:29
text: And he said to them, Verily I say to you, There is no one who has left home, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

title: Luke 18:30
text: who shall not receive manifold more at this time, and in the coming age life eternal.

title: Luke 18:31
text: ¶And he took the twelve to [him] and said to them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written of the Son of man by the prophets shall be accomplished;

title: Luke 18:32
text: for he shall be delivered up to the nations, and shall be mocked, and insulted, and spit upon.

title: Luke 18:33
text: And when they have scourged [him] they will kill him; and on the third day he will rise again.

title: Luke 18:34
text: And they understood nothing of these things. And this word was hidden from them, and they did not know what was said.

title: Luke 18:35
text: ¶And it came to pass when he came into the neighbourhood of Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the wayside begging.

title: Luke 18:36
text: And when he heard the crowd passing, he inquired what this might be.

title: Luke 18:37
text: And they told him that Jesus the Nazaraean was passing by.

title: Luke 18:38
text: And he called out saying, Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

title: Luke 18:39
text: And those [who were] going before rebuked him that he might be silent; but *he* cried out so much the more, Son of David, have mercy on me.

title: Luke 18:40
text: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be led to him. And when he drew nigh he asked him [saying],

title: Luke 18:41
text: What wilt thou that I shall do to thee? And he said, Lord, that I may see.

title: Luke 18:42
text: And Jesus said to him, See: thy faith has healed thee.

title: Luke 18:43
text: And immediately he saw, and followed him, glorifying God. And all the people when they saw [it] gave praise to God.

title: Luke 19:1
text: ¶And he entered and passed through Jericho.

title: Luke 19:2
text: And behold, [there was] a man by name called Zacchaeus, and he was chief tax-gatherer, and he was rich.

title: Luke 19:3
text: And he sought to see Jesus who he was: and he could not for the crowd, because he was little in stature.

title: Luke 19:4
text: And running on before, he got up into a sycamore that he might see him, for he was going to pass that [way].

title: Luke 19:5
text: And when he came up to the place, Jesus looked up and saw him, and said to him, Zacchaeus, make haste and come down, for to-day I must remain in thy house.

title: Luke 19:6
text: And he made haste and came down, and received him with joy.

title: Luke 19:7
text: And all murmured when they saw [it], saying, He has turned in to lodge with a sinful man.

title: Luke 19:8
text: But Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor, and if I have taken anything from any man by false accusation, I return [him] fourfold.

title: Luke 19:9
text: And Jesus said to him, To-day salvation is come to this house, inasmuch as he also is a son of Abraham;

title: Luke 19:10
text: for the Son of man has come to seek and to save that which is lost.

title: Luke 19:11
text: ¶But as they were listening to these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was near to Jerusalem and they thought that the kingdom of God was about to be immediately manifested.

title: Luke 19:12
text: He said therefore, A certain high-born man went to a distant country to receive for himself a kingdom and return.

title: Luke 19:13
text: And having called his own ten bondmen, he gave to them ten minas, and said to them, Trade while I am coming.

title: Luke 19:14
text: But his citizens hated him, and sent an embassy after him, saying, We will not that this [man] should reign over us.

title: Luke 19:15
text: And it came to pass on his arrival back again, having received the kingdom, that he desired these bondmen to whom he gave the money to be called to him, in order that he might know what every one had gained by trading.

title: Luke 19:16
text: And the first came up, saying, [My] Lord, thy mina has produced ten minas.

title: Luke 19:17
text: And he said to him, Well [done], thou good bondman; because thou hast been faithful in that which is least, be thou in authority over ten cities.

title: Luke 19:18
text: And the second came, saying, [My] Lord, thy mina has made five minas.

title: Luke 19:19
text: And he said also to this one, And *thou*, be over five cities.

title: Luke 19:20
text: And another came, saying, [My] Lord, lo, [there is] thy mina, which I have kept laid up in a towel.

title: Luke 19:21
text: For I feared thee because thou art a harsh man: thou takest up what thou hast not laid down, and thou reapest what thou hast not sowed.

title: Luke 19:22
text: He says to him, Out of thy mouth will I judge thee, wicked bondman: thou knewest that *I* am a harsh man, taking up what I have not laid down and reaping what I have not sowed.

title: Luke 19:23
text: And why didst thou not give my money to [the] bank; and *I* should have received it, at my coming, with interest?

title: Luke 19:24
text: And he said to those that stood by, Take from him the mina and give [it] to him who has the ten minas.

title: Luke 19:25
text: And they said to him, Lord, he has ten minas.

title: Luke 19:26
text: For I say unto you, that to every one that has shall be given; but from him that has not, that even which he has shall be taken from him.

title: Luke 19:27
text: Moreover those mine enemies, who would not [have] me to reign over them, bring them here and slay [them] before me.

title: Luke 19:28
text: ¶And having said these things, he went on before, going up to Jerusalem.

title: Luke 19:29
text: And it came to pass as he drew near to Bethphage and Bethany at the mountain called [the mount] of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

title: Luke 19:30
text: saying, Go into the village over against [you], in which ye will find, on entering it, a colt tied up, on which no [child] of man ever sat at any time: loose it and lead it [here].

title: Luke 19:31
text: And if any one ask you, Why do ye loose [it]? thus shall ye say to him, Because the Lord has need of it.

title: Luke 19:32
text: And they that were sent, having gone their way, found as he had said to them.

title: Luke 19:33
text: And as they were loosing the colt, its masters said to them, Why loose ye the colt?

title: Luke 19:34
text: And they said, Because the Lord has need of it.

title: Luke 19:35
text: And they led it to Jesus; and having cast their own garments on the colt, they put Jesus on [it].

title: Luke 19:36
text: And as he went, they strewed their clothes in the way.

title: Luke 19:37
text: And as he drew near, already at the descent of the mount of Olives, all the multitude of the disciples began, rejoicing, to praise God with a loud voice for all the works of power which they had seen,

title: Luke 19:38
text: saying, Blessed the King that comes in the name of [the] Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

title: Luke 19:39
text: And some of the Pharisees from the crowd said to him, Teacher, rebuke thy disciples.

title: Luke 19:40
text: And he answering said to them, I say unto you, If these shall be silent, the stones will cry out.

title: Luke 19:41
text: ¶And as he drew near, seeing the city, he wept over it,

title: Luke 19:42
text: saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, even at least in this thy day, the things that are for thy peace: but now they are hid from thine eyes;

title: Luke 19:43
text: for days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall make a palisaded mound about thee, and shall close thee around, and keep thee in on every side,

title: Luke 19:44
text: and shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children in thee; and shall not leave in thee a stone upon a stone: because thou knewest not the season of thy visitation.

title: Luke 19:45
text: And entering into the temple, he began to cast out those that sold and bought in it,

title: Luke 19:46
text: saying to them, It is written, My house is a house of prayer, but *ye* have made it a den of robbers.

title: Luke 19:47
text: And he was teaching day by day in the temple: and the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

title: Luke 19:48
text: and did not find what they could do, for all the people hung on him to hear.

title: Luke 20:1
text: ¶And it came to pass on one of the days, as he was teaching the people in the temple, and announcing the glad tidings, the chief priests and the scribes with the elders came up,

title: Luke 20:2
text: and spoke to him saying, Tell us by what authority thou doest these things, or who is it who has given thee this authority?

title: Luke 20:3
text: And he answering said to them, *I* also will ask you [one] thing, and tell me:

title: Luke 20:4
text: The baptism of John, was it of heaven or of men?

title: Luke 20:5
text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, If we should say, Of heaven, he will say, Why have ye not believed him?

title: Luke 20:6
text: but if we should say, Of men, the whole people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.

title: Luke 20:7
text: And they answered, they did not know whence.

title: Luke 20:8
text: And Jesus said to them, Neither do *I* tell you by what authority I do these things.

title: Luke 20:9
text: ¶And he began to speak to the people this parable: A man planted a vineyard and let it out to husbandmen, and left the country for a long time.

title: Luke 20:10
text: And in the season he sent to the husbandmen a bondman, that they might give to him of the fruit of the vineyard; but the husbandmen, having beaten him, sent [him] away empty.

title: Luke 20:11
text: And again he sent another bondman; but they, having beaten him also, and cast insult upon him, sent [him] away empty.

title: Luke 20:12
text: And again he sent a third; and they, having wounded him also, cast [him] out.

title: Luke 20:13
text: And the lord of the vineyard said, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: perhaps when they see him they will respect [him].

title: Luke 20:14
text: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir; [come,] let us kill him, that the inheritance may become ours.

title: Luke 20:15
text: And having cast him forth out of the vineyard, they killed [him]. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do to them?

title: Luke 20:16
text: He will come and destroy those husbandmen, and will give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it they said, May it never be!

title: Luke 20:17
text: But he looking at them said, What then is this that is written, The stone which they that builded rejected, this has become the corner-stone?

title: Luke 20:18
text: Every one falling on this stone shall be broken, but on whomsoever it shall fall, it shall grind him to powder.

title: Luke 20:19
text: And the chief priests and the scribes sought the same hour to lay hands on him, and they feared the people; for they knew that he had spoken this parable of them.

title: Luke 20:20
text: ¶And having watched [him], they sent out suborned persons, pretending to be just men, that they might take hold of him in [his] language, so that they might deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

title: Luke 20:21
text: And they asked him saying, Teacher, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, and acceptest no [man's] person, but teachest with truth the way of God:

title: Luke 20:22
text: Is it lawful for us to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

title: Luke 20:23
text: But perceiving their deceit he said to them, Why do ye tempt me?

title: Luke 20:24
text: Shew me a denarius. Whose image and superscription has it? And answering they said, Caesar's.

title: Luke 20:25
text: And he said to them, Pay therefore what is Caesar's to Caesar, and what is God's to God.

title: Luke 20:26
text: And they were not able to take hold of him in [his] expressions before the people, and, wondering at his answer, they were silent.

title: Luke 20:27
text: ¶And some of the Sadducees, who deny that there is any resurrection, coming up [to him],

title: Luke 20:28
text: demanded of him saying, Teacher, Moses wrote to us, If any one's brother, who has a wife, die, and he die childless, his brother shall take the wife and raise up seed to his brother.

title: Luke 20:29
text: There were then seven brethren: and the first, having taken a wife, died childless;

title: Luke 20:30
text: and the second [took the woman, and *he* died childless];

title: Luke 20:31
text: and the third took her: and in like manner also the seven left no children and died;

title: Luke 20:32
text: and last of all the woman also died.

title: Luke 20:33
text: In the resurrection therefore of which of them does she become wife, for the seven had her as wife?

title: Luke 20:34
text: And Jesus said to them, The sons of this world marry and are given in marriage,

title: Luke 20:35
text: but they who are counted worthy to have part in that world, and the resurrection from among [the] dead, neither marry nor are given in marriage;

title: Luke 20:36
text: for neither can they die any more, for they are equal to angels, and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.

title: Luke 20:37
text: But that the dead rise, even Moses shewed in [the section of] the bush, when he called [the] Lord the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob;

title: Luke 20:38
text: but he is not God of [the] dead but of [the] living; for all live for him.

title: Luke 20:39
text: ¶And some of the scribes answering said, Teacher, thou hast well spoken.

title: Luke 20:40
text: For they did not dare any more to ask him anything.

title: Luke 20:41
text: And he said to them, How do they say that the Christ is David's son,

title: Luke 20:42
text: and David himself says in the book of Psalms, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand

title: Luke 20:43
text: until I put thine enemies [as] footstool of thy feet?

title: Luke 20:44
text: David therefore calls him Lord, and how is he his son?

title: Luke 20:45
text: And, as all the people were listening, he said to his disciples,

title: Luke 20:46
text: Beware of the scribes, who like to walk about in long robes, and who love salutations in the market-places, and first seats in the synagogues, and first places at suppers;

title: Luke 20:47
text: who devour the houses of widows, and as a pretext make long prayers. These shall receive a severer judgment.

title: Luke 21:1
text: ¶And he looked up and saw the rich casting their gifts into the treasury;

title: Luke 21:2
text: but he saw also a certain poor widow casting therein two mites.

title: Luke 21:3
text: And he said, Verily I say unto you, that this poor widow has cast in more than all;

title: Luke 21:4
text: for all these out of their abundance have cast into the gifts [of God]; but she out of her need has cast in all the living which she had.

title: Luke 21:5
text: ¶And as some spoke of the temple, that it was adorned with goodly stones and consecrated offerings, he said,

title: Luke 21:6
text: [As to] these things which ye are beholding, days are coming in which there shall not be left stone upon stone which shall not be thrown down.

title: Luke 21:7
text: And they asked him saying, Teacher, when then shall these things be; and what [is] the sign when these things are going to take place?

title: Luke 21:8
text: And he said, See that ye be not led astray, for many shall come in my name, saying, *I* am [he], and the time is drawn nigh: go ye not [therefore] after them.

title: Luke 21:9
text: And when ye shall hear of wars and tumults, be not terrified, for these things must first take place, but the end is not immediately.

title: Luke 21:10
text: Then he said to them, Nation shall rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom;

title: Luke 21:11
text: there shall be both great earthquakes in different places, and famines and pestilences; and there shall be fearful sights and great signs from heaven.

title: Luke 21:12
text: But before all these things they shall lay their hands upon you and persecute you, delivering [you] up to synagogues and prisons, bringing [you] before kings and governors on account of my name;

title: Luke 21:13
text: but it shall turn out to you for a testimony.

title: Luke 21:14
text: Settle therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand [your] defence,

title: Luke 21:15
text: for *I* will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your opposers shall not be able to reply to or resist.

title: Luke 21:16
text: But ye will be delivered up even by parents and brethren and relations and friends, and they shall put to death [some] from among you,

title: Luke 21:17
text: and ye will be hated of all for my name's sake.

title: Luke 21:18
text: And a hair of your head shall in no wise perish.

title: Luke 21:19
text: By your patient endurance gain your souls.

title: Luke 21:20
text: ¶But when ye see Jerusalem encompassed with armies, then know that its desolation is drawn nigh.

title: Luke 21:21
text: Then let those who are in Judaea flee to the mountains, and those who are in the midst of it depart out, and those who are in the country not enter into it;

title: Luke 21:22
text: for these are days of avenging, that all the things that are written may be accomplished.

title: Luke 21:23
text: But woe to them that are with child and to them who give suck in those days, for there shall be great distress upon the land and wrath upon this people.

title: Luke 21:24
text: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and be led captive into all the nations; and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of [the] nations until [the] times of [the] nations be fulfilled.

title: Luke 21:25
text: And there shall be signs in sun and moon and stars, and upon the earth distress of nations in perplexity [at] the roar of the sea and rolling waves,

title: Luke 21:26
text: men ready to die through fear and expectation of what is coming on the habitable earth, for the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.

title: Luke 21:27
text: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

title: Luke 21:28
text: But when these things begin to come to pass, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption draws nigh.

title: Luke 21:29
text: ¶And he spoke a parable to them: Behold the fig-tree and all the trees;

title: Luke 21:30
text: when they already sprout, ye know of your own selves, [on] looking [at them], that already the summer is near.

title: Luke 21:31
text: So also *ye*, when ye see these things take place, know that the kingdom of God is near.

title: Luke 21:32
text: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall in no wise pass away until all come to pass.

title: Luke 21:33
text: The heaven and the earth shall pass away, but my words shall in no wise pass away.

title: Luke 21:34
text: But take heed to yourselves lest possibly your hearts be laden with surfeiting and drinking and cares of life, and that day come upon you suddenly unawares;

title: Luke 21:35
text: for as a snare shall it come upon all them that dwell upon the face of the whole earth.

title: Luke 21:36
text: Watch therefore, praying at every season, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things which are about to come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

title: Luke 21:37
text: And by day he was teaching in the temple, and by night, going out, he remained abroad on the mountain called [the mount] of Olives;

title: Luke 21:38
text: and all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

title: Luke 22:1
text: ¶Now the feast of unleavened bread, which [is] called the passover, drew nigh,

title: Luke 22:2
text: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

title: Luke 22:3
text: And Satan entered into Judas, who was surnamed Iscariote, being of the number of the twelve.

title: Luke 22:4
text: And he went away and spoke with the chief priests and captains as to how he should deliver him up to them.

title: Luke 22:5
text: And they were rejoiced, and agreed to give him money.

title: Luke 22:6
text: And he came to an agreement to do it, and sought an opportunity to deliver him up to them away from the crowd.

title: Luke 22:7
text: ¶And the day of unleavened bread came, in which the passover was to be killed.

title: Luke 22:8
text: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare the passover for us, that we may eat [it].

title: Luke 22:9
text: But they said to him, Where wilt thou that we prepare [it]?

title: Luke 22:10
text: And he said to them, Behold, as ye enter into the city a man will meet you, carrying an earthen pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he goes in;

title: Luke 22:11
text: and ye shall say to the master of the house, The Teacher says to thee, Where is the guest-chamber where I may eat the passover with my disciples?

title: Luke 22:12
text: And *he* will shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

title: Luke 22:13
text: And having gone they found it as he had said to them; and they prepared the passover.

title: Luke 22:14
text: And when the hour was come, he placed himself at table, and the [twelve] apostles with him.

title: Luke 22:15
text: And he said to them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer.

title: Luke 22:16
text: For I say unto you, that I will not eat any more at all of it until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 22:17
text: And having received a cup, when he had given thanks he said, Take this and divide it among yourselves.

title: Luke 22:18
text: For I say unto you, that I will not drink at all of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God come.

title: Luke 22:19
text: And having taken a loaf, when he had given thanks, he broke [it], and gave [it] to them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

title: Luke 22:20
text: In like manner also the cup, after having supped, saying, This cup [is] the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

title: Luke 22:21
text: ¶Moreover, behold, the hand of him that delivers me up [is] with me on the table;

title: Luke 22:22
text: and the Son of man indeed goes as it is determined, but woe unto that man by whom he is delivered up.

title: Luke 22:23
text: And *they* began to question together among themselves who then it could be of them who was about to do this.

title: Luke 22:24
text: And there was also a strife among them which of them should be held to be [the] greatest.

title: Luke 22:25
text: And he said to them, The kings of the nations rule over them, and they that exercise authority over them are called benefactors.

title: Luke 22:26
text: But *ye* [shall] not [be] thus; but let the greater among you be as the younger, and the leader as he that serves.

title: Luke 22:27
text: For which [is] greater, he that is at table or he that serves? [Is] not he that is at table? But *I* am in the midst of you as the one that serves.

title: Luke 22:28
text: But *ye* are they who have persevered with me in my temptations.

title: Luke 22:29
text: And *I* appoint unto you, as my Father has appointed unto me, a kingdom,

title: Luke 22:30
text: that ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

title: Luke 22:31
text: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has demanded to have you, to sift [you] as wheat;

title: Luke 22:32
text: but *I* have besought for thee that thy faith fail not; and *thou*, when once thou hast been restored, confirm thy brethren.

title: Luke 22:33
text: And he said to him, Lord, with thee I am ready to go both to prison and to death.

title: Luke 22:34
text: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, [the] cock shall not crow to-day before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

title: Luke 22:35
text: And he said to them, When I sent you without purse and scrip and sandals, did ye lack anything? And they said, Nothing.

title: Luke 22:36
text: He said therefore to them, But now he that has a purse let him take [it], in like manner also a scrip, and he that has none let him sell his garment and buy a sword;

title: Luke 22:37
text: for I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned with [the] lawless: for also the things concerning me have an end.

title: Luke 22:38
text: And they said, Lord, behold here are two swords. And he said to them, It is enough.

title: Luke 22:39
text: ¶And going forth he went according to his custom to the mount of Olives, and the disciples also followed him.

title: Luke 22:40
text: And when he was at the place he said to them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

title: Luke 22:41
text: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw, and having knelt down he prayed,

title: Luke 22:42
text: saying, Father, if thou wilt remove this cup from me: --but then, not my will, but thine be done.

title: Luke 22:43
text: And an angel appeared to him from heaven strengthening him.

title: Luke 22:44
text: And being in conflict he prayed more intently. And his sweat became as great drops of blood, falling down upon the earth.

title: Luke 22:45
text: And rising up from his prayer, coming to the disciples, he found them sleeping from grief.

title: Luke 22:46
text: And he said to them, Why sleep ye? rise up and pray that ye enter not into temptation.

title: Luke 22:47
text: ¶As he was yet speaking, behold, a crowd, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went on before them, and drew near to Jesus to kiss him.

title: Luke 22:48
text: And Jesus said to him, Judas, deliverest thou up the Son of man with a kiss?

title: Luke 22:49
text: And they who were around him, seeing what was going to follow, said [to him], Lord, shall we smite with [the] sword?

title: Luke 22:50
text: And a certain one from among them smote the bondman of the high priest and took off his right ear.

title: Luke 22:51
text: And Jesus answering said, Suffer thus far; and having touched his ear, he healed him.

title: Luke 22:52
text: And Jesus said to the chief priests and captains of the temple and elders, who were come against him, Have ye come out as against a robber with swords and sticks?

title: Luke 22:53
text: When I was day by day with you in the temple ye did not stretch out your hands against me; but this is your hour and the power of darkness.

title: Luke 22:54
text: ¶And having laid hold on him, they led him [away], and they led [him] into the house of the high priest. And Peter followed afar off.

title: Luke 22:55
text: And they having lit a fire in the midst of the court and sat down together, Peter sat among them.

title: Luke 22:56
text: And a certain maid, having seen him sitting by the light, and having fixed her eyes upon him, said, And this [man] was with him.

title: Luke 22:57
text: But he denied [him], saying, Woman, I do not know him.

title: Luke 22:58
text: And after a short time another seeing him said, And *thou* art of them. But Peter said, Man, I am not.

title: Luke 22:59
text: And after the lapse of about one hour another stoutly maintained it, saying, In truth this [man] also was with him, for also he is a Galilaean.

title: Luke 22:60
text: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he was yet speaking, [the] cock crew.

title: Luke 22:61
text: And the Lord, turning round, looked at Peter; and Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he said to him, Before [the] cock crow thou shalt deny me thrice.

title: Luke 22:62
text: And Peter, going forth without, wept bitterly.

title: Luke 22:63
text: ¶And the men who held him mocked him, beating [him];

title: Luke 22:64
text: and covering him up, asked him saying, Prophesy, who is it that struck thee?

title: Luke 22:65
text: And they said many other injurious things to him.

title: Luke 22:66
text: And when it was day, the elderhood of the people, both [the] chief priests and scribes, were gathered together, and led him into their council, saying,

title: Luke 22:67
text: If *thou* art the Christ, tell us. And he said to them, If I tell you, ye will not at all believe;

title: Luke 22:68
text: and if I should ask [you], ye would not answer me at all, nor let me go;

title: Luke 22:69
text: but henceforth shall the Son of man be sitting on the right hand of the power of God.

title: Luke 22:70
text: And they all said, *Thou* then art the Son of God? And he said to them, *Ye* say that I am.

title: Luke 22:71
text: And they said, What need have we any more of witness, for we have heard ourselves out of his mouth?

title: Luke 23:1
text: ¶And the whole multitude of them, rising up, led him to Pilate.

title: Luke 23:2
text: And they began to accuse him, saying, We have found this [man] perverting our nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ, a king.

title: Luke 23:3
text: And Pilate demanded of him saying, Art *thou* the king of the Jews? And he answering him said, Thou sayest.

title: Luke 23:4
text: And Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, I find no guilt in this man.

title: Luke 23:5
text: But they insisted, saying, He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judaea, beginning from Galilee even on to here.

title: Luke 23:6
text: But Pilate, having heard Galilee [named], demanded if the man were a Galilaean;

title: Luke 23:7
text: and having learned that he was of Herod's jurisdiction, remitted him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem in those days.

title: Luke 23:8
text: And when Herod saw Jesus he greatly rejoiced, for he had been a long while desirous of seeing him, because of hearing many things concerning him, and he hoped to see some sign done by him;

title: Luke 23:9
text: and he questioned him in many words, but *he* answered him nothing.

title: Luke 23:10
text: And the chief priests and the scribes stood and accused him violently.

title: Luke 23:11
text: And Herod with his troops having set him at nought and mocked him, having put a splendid robe upon him, sent him back to Pilate.

title: Luke 23:12
text: And Pilate and Herod became friends with one another the same day, for they had been at enmity before between themselves.

title: Luke 23:13
text: ¶And Pilate, having called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

title: Luke 23:14
text: said to them, Ye have brought to me this man as turning away the people [to rebellion], and behold, I, having examined him before you, have found nothing criminal in this man as to the things of which ye accuse him;

title: Luke 23:15
text: nor Herod either, for I remitted you to him, and behold, nothing worthy of death is done by him.

title: Luke 23:16
text: Having chastised him therefore, I will release him.

title: Luke 23:17
text: (Now he was obliged to release one for them at the feast.)

title: Luke 23:18
text: But they cried out in a mass saying, Away with this [man] and release Barabbas to us;

title: Luke 23:19
text: who was one who, for a certain tumult which had taken place in the city, and [for] murder, had been cast into prison.

title: Luke 23:20
text: Pilate therefore, desirous to release Jesus, again addressed [them].

title: Luke 23:21
text: But they cried out in reply saying, Crucify, crucify him.

title: Luke 23:22
text: And he said the third time to them, What evil then has this [man] done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will chastise him therefore and release him.

title: Luke 23:23
text: But they were urgent with loud voices, begging that he might be crucified. And their voices [and those of the chief priests] prevailed.

title: Luke 23:24
text: And Pilate adjudged that what they begged should take place.

title: Luke 23:25
text: And he released him who, for tumult and murder, had been cast into prison, whom they begged for, and Jesus he delivered up to their will.

title: Luke 23:26
text: ¶And as they led him away, they laid hold on a certain Simon, a Cyrenian, coming from the field, and put the cross upon him to bear it behind Jesus.

title: Luke 23:27
text: And a great multitude of the people, and of women who wailed and lamented him, followed him.

title: Luke 23:28
text: And Jesus turning round to them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep over me, but weep over yourselves and over your children;

title: Luke 23:29
text: for behold, days are coming in which they will say, Blessed [are] the barren, and wombs that have not borne, and breasts that have not given suck.

title: Luke 23:30
text: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall upon us; and to the hills, Cover us:

title: Luke 23:31
text: for if these things are done in the green tree, what shall take place in the dry?

title: Luke 23:32
text: ¶Now two others also, malefactors, were led with him to be put to death.

title: Luke 23:33
text: And when they came to the place which is called Skull, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, the other on the left.

title: Luke 23:34
text: And Jesus said, Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do. And, parting out his garments, they cast lots.

title: Luke 23:35
text: And the people stood beholding, and the rulers also [with them] sneered, saying, He has saved others; let him save himself if this is the Christ, the chosen one of God.

title: Luke 23:36
text: And the soldiers also made game of him, coming up offering him vinegar,

title: Luke 23:37
text: and saying, If *thou* be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

title: Luke 23:38
text: And there was also an inscription [written] over him in Greek, and Roman, and Hebrew letters: This is the King of the Jews.

title: Luke 23:39
text: Now one of the malefactors who had been hanged spoke insultingly to him, saying, Art not thou the Christ? save thyself and us.

title: Luke 23:40
text: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost *thou* too not fear God, thou that art under the same judgment?

title: Luke 23:41
text: and *we* indeed justly, for we receive the just recompense of what we have done; but this [man] has done nothing amiss.

title: Luke 23:42
text: And he said to Jesus, Remember me, [Lord,] when thou comest in thy kingdom.

title: Luke 23:43
text: And Jesus said to him, Verily I say to thee, To-day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

title: Luke 23:44
text: ¶And it was about [the] sixth hour, and there came darkness over the whole land until [the] ninth hour.

title: Luke 23:45
text: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple rent in the midst.

title: Luke 23:46
text: And Jesus, having cried with a loud voice, said, Father, into thy hands I commit my spirit. And having said this, he expired.

title: Luke 23:47
text: Now the centurion, seeing what took place, glorified God, saying, In very deed this man was just.

title: Luke 23:48
text: And all the crowds who had come together to that sight, having seen the things that took place, returned, beating [their] breasts.

title: Luke 23:49
text: And all those who knew him stood afar off, the women also who had followed him from Galilee, beholding these things.

title: Luke 23:50
text: ¶And behold, a man named Joseph, who was a councillor, a good man and a just

title: Luke 23:51
text: (this [man] had not assented to their counsel and deed), of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who also waited, [himself also,] for the kingdom of God

title: Luke 23:52
text: --he having gone to Pilate begged the body of Jesus;

title: Luke 23:53
text: and having taken it down, wrapped it in fine linen and placed him in a tomb hewn in the rock, where no one had ever been laid.

title: Luke 23:54
text: And it was preparation day, and [the] sabbath twilight was coming on.

title: Luke 23:55
text: And women, who had come along with him out of Galilee, having followed, saw the sepulchre and how his body was placed.

title: Luke 23:56
text: And having returned they prepared aromatic spices and ointments, and remained quiet on the sabbath, according to the commandment.

title: Luke 24:1
text: ¶But on the morrow of the sabbath, very early indeed in the morning, they came to the tomb, bringing the aromatic spices which they had prepared.

title: Luke 24:2
text: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

title: Luke 24:3
text: And when they had entered they found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

title: Luke 24:4
text: And it came to pass as they were in perplexity about it, that behold, two men suddenly stood by them in shining raiment.

title: Luke 24:5
text: And as they were filled with fear and bowed their faces to the ground, they said to them, Why seek ye the living one among the dead?

title: Luke 24:6
text: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spoke to you, being yet in Galilee,

title: Luke 24:7
text: saying, The Son of man must be delivered up into the hands of sinners, and be crucified, and rise the third day.

title: Luke 24:8
text: And they remembered his words;

title: Luke 24:9
text: and, returning from the sepulchre, related all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

title: Luke 24:10
text: Now it was Mary of Magdala, and Johanna, and Mary the [mother] of James, and the others with them, who told these things to the apostles.

title: Luke 24:11
text: And their words appeared in their eyes as an idle tale, and they disbelieved them.

title: Luke 24:12
text: But Peter, rising up, ran to the sepulchre, and stooping down he sees the linen clothes lying there alone, and went away home, wondering at what had happened.

title: Luke 24:13
text: ¶And behold, two of them were going on the same day to a village distant sixty stadia from Jerusalem, called Emmaus;

title: Luke 24:14
text: and they conversed with one another about all these things which had taken place.

title: Luke 24:15
text: And it came to pass as they conversed and reasoned, that Jesus himself drawing nigh, went with them;

title: Luke 24:16
text: but their eyes were holden so as not to know him.

title: Luke 24:17
text: And he said to them, What discourses are these which pass between you as ye walk, and are downcast?

title: Luke 24:18
text: And one [of them], named Cleopas, answering said to him, Thou sojournest alone in Jerusalem, and dost not know what has taken place in it in these days?

title: Luke 24:19
text: And he said to them, What things? And they said to him, The things concerning Jesus the Nazaraean, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

title: Luke 24:20
text: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to [the] judgment of death and crucified him.

title: Luke 24:21
text: But *we* had hoped that *he* was [the one] who is about to redeem Israel. But then, besides all these things, it is now, to-day, the third day since these things took place.

title: Luke 24:22
text: And withal, certain women from amongst us astonished us, having been very early at the sepulchre,

title: Luke 24:23
text: and, not having found his body, came, saying that they also had seen a vision of angels, who say that he is living.

title: Luke 24:24
text: And some of those with us went to the sepulchre, and found it so, as the women also had said, but him they saw not.

title: Luke 24:25
text: And *he* said to them, O senseless and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

title: Luke 24:26
text: Ought not the Christ to have suffered these things and to enter into his glory?

title: Luke 24:27
text: And having begun from Moses and from all the prophets, he interpreted to them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

title: Luke 24:28
text: And they drew near to the village where they were going, and *he* made as though he would go farther.

title: Luke 24:29
text: And they constrained him, saying, Stay with us, for it is toward evening and the day is declining. And he entered in to stay with them.

title: Luke 24:30
text: And it came to pass as he was at table with them, having taken the bread, he blessed, and having broken it, gave it to them.

title: Luke 24:31
text: And their eyes were opened, and they recognised him. And he disappeared from them.

title: Luke 24:32
text: And they said to one another, Was not our heart burning in us as he spoke to us on the way, [and] as he opened the scriptures to us?

title: Luke 24:33
text: And rising up the same hour, they returned to Jerusalem. And they found the eleven, and those with them, gathered together,

title: Luke 24:34
text: saying, The Lord is indeed risen and has appeared to Simon.

title: Luke 24:35
text: And they related what [had happened] on the way, and how he was made known to them in the breaking of bread.

title: Luke 24:36
text: ¶And as they were saying these things, he himself stood in their midst, and says to them, Peace [be] unto you.

title: Luke 24:37
text: But they, being confounded and being frightened, supposed they beheld a spirit.

title: Luke 24:38
text: And he said to them, Why are ye troubled? and why are thoughts rising in your hearts?

title: Luke 24:39
text: behold my hands and my feet, that it is *I* myself. Handle me and see, for a spirit has not flesh and bones as ye see me having.

title: Luke 24:40
text: And having said this he shewed them his hands and his feet.

title: Luke 24:41
text: But while they yet did not believe for joy, and were wondering, he said to them, Have ye anything here to eat?

title: Luke 24:42
text: And they gave him part of a broiled fish and of a honeycomb;

title: Luke 24:43
text: and he took it and ate before them.

title: Luke 24:44
text: And he said to them, These [are] the words which I spoke to you while I was yet with you, that all that is written concerning me in the law of Moses and prophets and psalms must be fulfilled.

title: Luke 24:45
text: Then he opened their understanding to understand the scriptures,

title: Luke 24:46
text: and said to them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved the Christ to suffer, and to rise from among the dead the third day;

title: Luke 24:47
text: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations beginning at Jerusalem.

title: Luke 24:48
text: And *ye* are witnesses of these things.

title: Luke 24:49
text: And behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you; but do ye remain in the city till ye be clothed with power from on high.

title: Luke 24:50
text: ¶And he led them out as far as Bethany, and having lifted up his hands, he blessed them.

title: Luke 24:51
text: And it came to pass as he was blessing them, he was separated from them and was carried up into heaven.

title: Luke 24:52
text: And *they*, having done him homage, returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

title: Luke 24:53
text: and were continually in the temple praising and blessing God.

title: John 1:1
text: ¶In [the] beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

title: John 1:2
text: *He* was in the beginning with God.

title: John 1:3
text: All things received being through him, and without him not one [thing] received being which has received being.

title: John 1:4
text: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

title: John 1:5
text: ¶And the light appears in darkness, and the darkness apprehended it not.

title: John 1:6
text: There was a man sent from God, his name John.

title: John 1:7
text: He came for witness, that he might witness concerning the light, that all might believe through him.

title: John 1:8
text: *He* was not the light, but that he might witness concerning the light.

title: John 1:9
text: The true light was that which, coming into the world, lightens every man.

title: John 1:10
text: He was in the world, and the world had [its] being through him, and the world knew him not.

title: John 1:11
text: He came to his own, and his own received him not;

title: John 1:12
text: but as many as received him, to them gave he [the] right to be children of God, to those that believe on his name;

title: John 1:13
text: who have been born, not of blood, nor of flesh's will, nor of man's will, but of God.

title: John 1:14
text: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us (and we have contemplated his glory, a glory as of an only-begotten with a father), full of grace and truth;

title: John 1:15
text: ¶(John bears witness of him, and he has cried, saying, This was he of whom I said, He that comes after me is preferred before me, for he was before me;)

title: John 1:16
text: for of his fulness we all have received, and grace upon grace.

title: John 1:17
text: For the law was given by Moses: grace and truth subsists through Jesus Christ.

title: John 1:18
text: No one has seen God at any time; the only-begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, *he* hath declared [him].

title: John 1:19
text: ¶And this is the witness of John, when the Jews sent from Jerusalem priests and Levites that they might ask him, Thou, who art thou?

title: John 1:20
text: And he acknowledged and denied not, and acknowledged, I am not the Christ.

title: John 1:21
text: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he says, I am not. Art thou the prophet? And he answered, No.

title: John 1:22
text: They said therefore to him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to those who sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

title: John 1:23
