text: He said, I [am] [the] voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the path of [the] Lord, as said Esaias the prophet.

title: John 1:24
text: And they were sent from among the Pharisees.

title: John 1:25
text: And they asked him and said to him, Why baptisest thou then, if thou art not the Christ, nor Elias, nor the prophet?

title: John 1:26
text: John answered them saying, I baptise with water. In the midst of you stands, whom ye do not know,

title: John 1:27
text: he who comes after me, the thong of whose sandal I am not worthy to unloose.

title: John 1:28
text: These things took place in Bethany, across the Jordan, where John was baptising.

title: John 1:29
text: ¶On the morrow he sees Jesus coming to him, and says, Behold the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world.

title: John 1:30
text: He it is of whom I said, A man comes after me who takes a place before me, because he *was* before me;

title: John 1:31
text: and I knew him not; but that he might be manifested to Israel, therefore have I come baptising with water.

title: John 1:32
text: And John bore witness, saying, I beheld the Spirit descending as a dove from heaven, and it abode upon him.

title: John 1:33
text: And I knew him not; but he who sent me to baptise with water, *he* said to me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending and abiding on him, he it is who baptises with [the] Holy Spirit.

title: John 1:34
text: And I have seen and borne witness that this is the Son of God.

title: John 1:35
text: Again, on the morrow, there stood John and two of his disciples.

title: John 1:36
text: And, looking at Jesus as he walked, he says, Behold the Lamb of God.

title: John 1:37
text: ¶And the two disciples heard him speaking, and followed Jesus.

title: John 1:38
text: But Jesus having turned, and seeing them following, says to them, What seek ye? And *they* said to him, Rabbi (which, being interpreted, signifies Teacher), where abidest thou?

title: John 1:39
text: He says to them, Come and see. They went therefore, and saw where he abode; and they abode with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

title: John 1:40
text: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the two who heard [this] from John and followed him.

title: John 1:41
text: He first finds his own brother Simon, and says to him, We have found the Messias (which being interpreted is Christ).

title: John 1:42
text: And he led him to Jesus. Jesus looking at him said, Thou art Simon, the son of Jonas; thou shalt be called Cephas (which interpreted is stone).

title: John 1:43
text: ¶On the morrow he would go forth into Galilee, and Jesus finds Philip, and says to him, Follow me.

title: John 1:44
text: And Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.

title: John 1:45
text: Philip finds Nathanael, and says to him, We have found him of whom Moses wrote in the law, and the prophets, Jesus, the son of Joseph, who is from Nazareth.

title: John 1:46
text: And Nathanael said to him, Can anything good come out of Nazareth? Philip says to him, Come and see.

title: John 1:47
text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and says of him, Behold [one] truly an Israelite, in whom there is no guile.

title: John 1:48
text: Nathanael says to him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said to him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig-tree, I saw thee.

title: John 1:49
text: Nathanael answered and said to him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God, thou art the King of Israel.

title: John 1:50
text: Jesus answered and said to him, Because I said to thee, I saw thee under the fig-tree, believest thou? Thou shalt see greater things than these.

title: John 1:51
text: And he says to him, Verily, verily, I say to you, Henceforth ye shall see the heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of man.

title: John 2:1
text: ¶And on the third day a marriage took place in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there.

title: John 2:2
text: And Jesus also, and his disciples, were invited to the marriage.

title: John 2:3
text: And wine being deficient, the mother of Jesus says to him, They have no wine.

title: John 2:4
text: Jesus says to her, What have I to do with thee, woman? mine hour has not yet come.

title: John 2:5
text: His mother says to the servants, Whatever he may say to you, do.

title: John 2:6
text: Now there were standing there six stone water-vessels, according to the purification of the Jews, holding two or three measures each.

title: John 2:7
text: Jesus says to them, Fill the water-vessels with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

title: John 2:8
text: And he says to them, Draw out now, and carry [it] to the feast-master. And they carried [it].

title: John 2:9
text: But when the feast-master had tasted the water which had been made wine (and knew not whence it was, but the servants knew who drew the water), the feast-master calls the bridegroom,

title: John 2:10
text: and says to him, Every man sets on first the good wine, and when [men] have well drunk, then the inferior; thou hast kept the good wine till now.

title: John 2:11
text: This beginning of signs did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

title: John 2:12
text: ¶After this he descended to Capernaum, he and his mother and his brethren and his disciples; and there they abode not many days.

title: John 2:13
text: And the passover of the Jews was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

title: John 2:14
text: And he found in the temple the sellers of oxen and sheep and doves, and the money-changers sitting;

title: John 2:15
text: and, having made a scourge of cords, he cast [them] all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the change of the money-changers, and overturned the tables,

title: John 2:16
text: and said to the sellers of doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house a house of merchandise.

title: John 2:17
text: [And] his disciples remembered that it is written, The zeal of thy house devours me.

title: John 2:18
text: The Jews therefore answered and said to him, What sign shewest thou to us, that thou doest these things?

title: John 2:19
text: Jesus answered and said to them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

title: John 2:20
text: The Jews therefore said, Forty and six years was this temple building, and thou wilt raise it up in three days?

title: John 2:21
text: But *he* spoke of the temple of his body.

title: John 2:22
text: When therefore he was raised from among [the] dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this, and believed the scripture and the word which Jesus had spoken.

title: John 2:23
text: ¶And when he was in Jerusalem, at the passover, at the feast, many believed on his name, beholding his signs which he wrought.

title: John 2:24
text: But Jesus himself did not trust himself to them, because he knew all [men],

title: John 2:25
text: and that he had not need that any should testify of man, for himself knew what was in man.

title: John 3:1
text: ¶But there was a man from among the Pharisees, his name Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews;

title: John 3:2
text: he came to him by night, and said to him, Rabbi, we know that thou art come a teacher from God, for none can do these signs that thou doest unless God be with him.

title: John 3:3
text: Jesus answered and said to him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except any one be born anew he cannot see the kingdom of God.

title: John 3:4
text: Nicodemus says to him, How can a man be born being old? can he enter a second time into the womb of his mother and be born?

title: John 3:5
text: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except any one be born of water and of Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

title: John 3:6
text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

title: John 3:7
text: Do not wonder that I said to thee, It is needful that *ye* should be born anew.

title: John 3:8
text: The wind blows where it will, and thou hearest its voice, but knowest not whence it comes and where it goes: thus is every one that is born of the Spirit.

title: John 3:9
text: Nicodemus answered and said to him, How can these things be?

title: John 3:10
text: Jesus answered and said to him, Thou art the teacher of Israel and knowest not these things!

title: John 3:11
text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that which we know, and we bear witness of that which we have seen, and ye receive not our witness.

title: John 3:12
text: If I have said the earthly things to you, and ye believe not, how, if I say the heavenly things to you, will ye believe?

title: John 3:13
text: And no one has gone up into heaven, save he who came down out of heaven, the Son of man who is in heaven.

title: John 3:14
text: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, thus must the Son of man be lifted up,

title: John 3:15
text: that every one who believes on him may [not perish, but] have life eternal.

title: John 3:16
text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only-begotten Son, that whosoever believes on him may not perish, but have life eternal.

title: John 3:17
text: For God has not sent his Son into the world that he may judge the world, but that the world may be saved through him.

title: John 3:18
text: He that believes on him is not judged: but he that believes not has been already judged, because he has not believed on the name of the only-begotten Son of God.

title: John 3:19
text: And this is the judgment, that light is come into the world, and men have loved darkness rather than light; for their works were evil.

title: John 3:20
text: For every one that does evil hates the light, and does not come to the light that his works may not be shewn as they are;

title: John 3:21
text: but he that practises the truth comes to the light, that his works may be manifested that they have been wrought in God.

title: John 3:22
text: ¶After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he abode with them and baptised.

title: John 3:23
text: And John also was baptising in Aenon, near Salim, because there was a great deal of water there; and they came to [him] and were baptised:

title: John 3:24
text: for John was not yet cast into prison.

title: John 3:25
text: There was therefore a reasoning of the disciples of John with a Jew about purification.

title: John 3:26
text: And they came to John and said to him, Rabbi, he who was with thee beyond the Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, he baptises, and all come to him.

title: John 3:27
text: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing unless it be given him out of heaven.

title: John 3:28
text: Ye yourselves bear me witness that I said, I am not the Christ, but, that I am sent before him.

title: John 3:29
text: He that has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices in heart because of the voice of the bridegroom: this my joy then is fulfilled.

title: John 3:30
text: He must increase, but I must decrease.

title: John 3:31
text: He who comes from above is above all. He who has his origin in the earth is of the earth, and speaks [as] of the earth. He who comes out of heaven is above all,

title: John 3:32
text: [and] what he has seen and has heard, this he testifies; and no one receives his testimony.

title: John 3:33
text: He that has received his testimony has set to his seal that God is true;

title: John 3:34
text: for he whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives not the Spirit by measure.

title: John 3:35
text: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things [to be] in his hand.

title: John 3:36
text: He that believes on the Son has life eternal, and he that is not subject to the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God abides upon him.

title: John 4:1
text: ¶When therefore the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus makes and baptises more disciples than John

title: John 4:2
text: (however, Jesus himself did not baptise, but his disciples),

title: John 4:3
text: he left Judaea and went away again unto Galilee.

title: John 4:4
text: ¶And he must needs pass through Samaria.

title: John 4:5
text: He comes therefore to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near to the land which Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

title: John 4:6
text: Now a fountain of Jacob's was there; Jesus therefore, being wearied with the way he had come, sat just as he was at the fountain. It was about the sixth hour.

title: John 4:7
text: A woman comes out of Samaria to draw water. Jesus says to her, Give me to drink

title: John 4:8
text: (for his disciples had gone away into the city that they might buy provisions).

title: John 4:9
text: The Samaritan woman therefore says to him, How dost thou, being a Jew, ask to drink of me who am a Samaritan woman? for Jews have no intercourse with Samaritans.

title: John 4:10
text: Jesus answered and said to her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that says to thee, Give me to drink, thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

title: John 4:11
text: The woman says to him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: whence then hast thou the living water?

title: John 4:12
text: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, and his sons, and his cattle?

title: John 4:13
text: Jesus answered and said to her, Every one who drinks of this water shall thirst again;

title: John 4:14
text: but whosoever drinks of the water which I shall give him shall never thirst for ever, but the water which I shall give him shall become in him a fountain of water, springing up into eternal life.

title: John 4:15
text: The woman says to him, Sir, give me this water, that I may not thirst nor come here to draw.

title: John 4:16
text: Jesus says to her, Go, call thy husband, and come here.

title: John 4:17
text: The woman answered and said, I have not a husband. Jesus says to her, Thou hast well said, I have not a husband;

title: John 4:18
text: for thou hast had five husbands, and he whom now thou hast is not thy husband: this thou hast spoken truly.

title: John 4:19
text: The woman says to him, Sir, I see that thou art a prophet.

title: John 4:20
text: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain, and ye say that in Jerusalem is the place where one must worship.

title: John 4:21
text: Jesus says to her, Woman, believe me, [the] hour is coming when ye shall neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem worship the Father.

title: John 4:22
text: Ye worship ye know not what; we worship what we know, for salvation is of the Jews.

title: John 4:23
text: But [the] hour is coming and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and truth; for also the Father seeks such as his worshippers.

title: John 4:24
text: God [is] a spirit; and they who worship him must worship [him] in spirit and truth.

title: John 4:25
text: The woman says to him, I know that Messias is coming, who is called Christ; when *he* comes he will tell us all things.

title: John 4:26
text: Jesus says to her, I who speak to thee am [he].

title: John 4:27
text: ¶And upon this came his disciples, and wondered that he spoke with a woman; yet no one said, What seekest thou? or, Why speakest thou with her?

title: John 4:28
text: The woman then left her waterpot and went away into the city, and says to the men,

title: John 4:29
text: Come, see a man who told me all things I had ever done: is not he the Christ?

title: John 4:30
text: They went out of the city and came to him.

title: John 4:31
text: But meanwhile the disciples asked him saying, Rabbi, eat.

title: John 4:32
text: But he said to them, I have food to eat which ye do not know.

title: John 4:33
text: The disciples therefore said to one another, Has any one brought him [anything] to eat?

title: John 4:34
text: Jesus says to them, My food is that I should do the will of him that has sent me, and that I should finish his work.

title: John 4:35
text: Do not ye say, that there are yet four months and the harvest comes? Behold, I say to you, Lift up your eyes and behold the fields, for they are already white to harvest.

title: John 4:36
text: He that reaps receives wages and gathers fruit unto life eternal, that both he that sows and he that reaps may rejoice together.

title: John 4:37
text: For in this is [verified] the true saying, It is one who sows and another who reaps.

title: John 4:38
text: I have sent you to reap that on which ye have not laboured; others have laboured, and ye have entered into their labours.

title: John 4:39
text: But many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him because of the word of the woman who bore witness, He told me all things that I had ever done.

title: John 4:40
text: When therefore the Samaritans came to him they asked him to abide with them, and he abode there two days.

title: John 4:41
text: And more a great deal believed on account of his word;

title: John 4:42
text: and they said to the woman, [It is] no longer on account of thy saying that we believe, for we have heard him ourselves, and we know that this is indeed the Saviour of the world.

title: John 4:43
text: ¶But after the two days he went forth thence and went away into Galilee,

title: John 4:44
text: for Jesus himself bore witness that a prophet has no honour in his own country.

title: John 4:45
text: When therefore he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all that he had done in Jerusalem during the feast, for they also went to the feast.

title: John 4:46
text: He came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain courtier in Capernaum whose son was sick.

title: John 4:47
text: He, having heard that Jesus had come out of Judaea into Galilee, went to him and asked [him] that he would come down and heal his son, for he was about to die.

title: John 4:48
text: Jesus therefore said to him, Unless ye see signs and wonders ye will not believe.

title: John 4:49
text: The courtier says to him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

title: John 4:50
text: Jesus says to him, Go, thy son lives. And the man believed the word which Jesus said to him, and went his way.

title: John 4:51
text: But already, as he was going down, his servants met him and brought [him] word saying, Thy child lives.

title: John 4:52
text: He inquired therefore from them the hour at which he got better. And they said to him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

title: John 4:53
text: The father therefore knew that [it was] in that hour in which Jesus said to him, Thy son lives; and he believed, himself and his whole house.

title: John 4:54
text: This second sign again did Jesus, being come out of Judaea into Galilee.

title: John 5:1
text: ¶After these things was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

title: John 5:2
text: Now there is in Jerusalem, at the sheepgate, a pool, which is called in Hebrew, Bethesda, having five porches.

title: John 5:3
text: In these lay a multitude of sick, blind, lame, withered, [awaiting the moving of the water.

title: John 5:4
text: For an angel descended at a certain season in the pool and troubled the water. Whoever therefore first went in after the troubling of the water became well, whatever disease he laboured under.]

title: John 5:5
text: But there was a certain man there who had been suffering under his infirmity thirty and eight years.

title: John 5:6
text: Jesus seeing this [man] lying [there], and knowing that he was [in that state] now a great length of time, says to him, Wouldest thou become well?

title: John 5:7
text: The infirm [man] answered him, Sir, I have not a man, in order, when the water has been troubled, to cast me into the pool; but while I am coming another descends before me.

title: John 5:8
text: Jesus says to him, Arise, take up thy couch and walk.

title: John 5:9
text: And immediately the man became well, and took up his couch and walked: and on that day was sabbath.

title: John 5:10
text: The Jews therefore said to the healed [man], It is sabbath, it is not permitted thee to take up thy couch.

title: John 5:11
text: He answered them, He that made me well, *he* said to me, Take up thy couch and walk.

title: John 5:12
text: They asked him [therefore], Who is the man who said to thee, Take up thy couch and walk?

title: John 5:13
text: But he that had been healed knew not who it was, for Jesus had slidden away, there being a crowd in the place.

title: John 5:14
text: After these things Jesus finds him in the temple, and said to him, Behold, thou art become well: sin no more, that something worse do not happen to thee.

title: John 5:15
text: The man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

title: John 5:16
text: And for this the Jews persecuted Jesus [and sought to kill him], because he had done these things on sabbath.

title: John 5:17
text: ¶But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto and I work.

title: John 5:18
text: For this therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he had not only violated the sabbath, but also said that God was his own Father, making himself equal with God.

title: John 5:19
text: Jesus therefore answered and said to them, Verily, verily, I say to you, The Son can do nothing of himself save whatever he sees the Father doing: for whatever things *he* does, these things also the Son does in like manner.

title: John 5:20
text: For the Father loves the Son and shews him all things which he himself does; and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may wonder.

title: John 5:21
text: For even as the Father raises the dead and quickens [them], thus the Son also quickens whom he will:

title: John 5:22
text: for neither does the Father judge any one, but has given all judgment to the Son;

title: John 5:23
text: that all may honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He who honours not the Son, honours not the Father who has sent him.

title: John 5:24
text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that he that hears my word, and believes him that has sent me, has life eternal, and does not come into judgment, but is passed out of death into life.

title: John 5:25
text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that an hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God, and they that have heard shall live.

title: John 5:26
text: For even as the Father has life in himself, so he has given to the Son also to have life in himself,

title: John 5:27
text: and has given him authority to execute judgment [also], because he is Son of man.

title: John 5:28
text: Wonder not at this, for an hour is coming in which all who are in the tombs shall hear his voice,

title: John 5:29
text: and shall go forth; those that have practised good, to resurrection of life, and those that have done evil, to resurrection of judgment.

title: John 5:30
text: I cannot do anything of myself; as I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous, because I do not seek my will, but the will of him that has sent me.

title: John 5:31
text: ¶If I bear witness concerning myself, my witness is not true.

title: John 5:32
text: It is another who bears witness concerning me, and I know that the witness which he bears concerning me is true.

title: John 5:33
text: Ye have sent unto John, and he has borne witness to the truth.

title: John 5:34
text: But I do not receive witness from man, but I say this that *ye* might be saved.

title: John 5:35
text: *He* was the burning and shining lamp, and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

title: John 5:36
text: But I have the witness [that is] greater than [that] of John; for the works which the Father has given me that I should complete them, the works themselves which I do, bear witness concerning me that the Father has sent me.

title: John 5:37
text: And the Father who has sent me himself has borne witness concerning me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor have seen his shape,

title: John 5:38
text: and ye have not his word abiding in you; for whom *he* hath sent, him ye do not believe.

title: John 5:39
text: Ye search the scriptures, for ye think that in them ye have life eternal, and they it is which bear witness concerning me;

title: John 5:40
text: and ye will not come to me that ye might have life.

title: John 5:41
text: I do not receive glory from men,

title: John 5:42
text: but I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

title: John 5:43
text: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not; if another come in his own name, him ye will receive.

title: John 5:44
text: How can ye believe, who receive glory one of another, and seek not the glory which [comes] from God alone?

title: John 5:45
text: Think not that I will accuse you to the Father: there is [one] who accuses you, Moses, on whom ye trust;

title: John 5:46
text: for if ye had believed Moses, ye would have believed me, for he wrote of me.

title: John 5:47
text: But if ye do not believe his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

title: John 6:1
text: ¶After these things Jesus went away beyond the sea of Galilee, [or] of Tiberias,

title: John 6:2
text: and a great crowd followed him, because they saw the signs which he wrought upon the sick.

title: John 6:3
text: And Jesus went up into the mountain, and there sat with his disciples:

title: John 6:4
text: but the passover, the feast of the Jews, was near.

title: John 6:5
text: Jesus then, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great crowd is coming to him, says to Philip, Whence shall we buy loaves that these may eat?

title: John 6:6
text: But this he said trying him, for he knew what he was going to do.

title: John 6:7
text: Philip answered him, Loaves for two hundred denarii are not sufficient for them, that each may have some little [portion].

title: John 6:8
text: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, says to him,

title: John 6:9
text: There is a little boy here who has five barley loaves and two small fishes; but this, what is it for so many?

title: John 6:10
text: [And] Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place: the men therefore sat down, in number about five thousand.

title: John 6:11
text: And Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, distributed [them] to those that were set down; and in like manner of the small fishes as much as they would.

title: John 6:12
text: And when they had been filled, he says to his disciples, Gather together the fragments which are over and above, that nothing may be lost.

title: John 6:13
text: They gathered [them] therefore together, and filled twelve hand-baskets full of fragments of the five barley loaves, which were over and above to those that had eaten.

title: John 6:14
text: The men therefore, having seen the sign which Jesus had done, said, This is truly the prophet which is coming into the world.

title: John 6:15
text: ¶Jesus therefore knowing that they were going to come and seize him, that they might make [him] king, departed again to the mountain himself alone.

title: John 6:16
text: But when evening was come, his disciples went down to the sea,

title: John 6:17
text: and having gone on board ship, they went over the sea to Capernaum. And it had already become dark, and Jesus had not come to them,

title: John 6:18
text: and the sea was agitated by a strong wind blowing.

title: John 6:19
text: Having rowed then about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they see Jesus walking on the sea and coming near the ship; and they were frightened.

title: John 6:20
text: But he says to them, It is I: be not afraid.

title: John 6:21
text: They were willing therefore to receive him into the ship; and immediately the ship was at the land to which they went.

title: John 6:22
text: ¶On the morrow the crowd which stood on the other side of the sea, having seen that there was no other little ship there except that into which his disciples had got, and that Jesus had not gone with his disciples into the ship, but [that] his disciples had gone away alone;

title: John 6:23
text: (but other little ships out of Tiberias came near to the place where they ate bread after the Lord had given thanks;)

title: John 6:24
text: when therefore the crowd saw that Jesus was not there, nor his disciples, *they* got into the ships, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

title: John 6:25
text: And having found him the other side of the sea, they said to him, Rabbi, when art thou arrived here?

title: John 6:26
text: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say to you, Ye seek me not because ye have seen signs, but because ye have eaten of the loaves and been filled.

title: John 6:27
text: Work not [for] the food which perishes, but [for] the food which abides unto life eternal, which the Son of man shall give to you; for him has the Father sealed, [even] God.

title: John 6:28
text: ¶They said therefore to him, What should we do that we may work the works of God?

title: John 6:29
text: Jesus answered and said to them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom *he* has sent.

title: John 6:30
text: They said therefore to him, What sign then doest thou that we may see and believe thee? what dost thou work?

title: John 6:31
text: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written, He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.

title: John 6:32
text: Jesus therefore said to them, Verily, verily, I say to you, [It is] not Moses that has given you the bread out of heaven; but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

title: John 6:33
text: For the bread of God is he who comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.

title: John 6:34
text: They said therefore to him, Lord, ever give to us this bread.

title: John 6:35
text: [And] Jesus said to them, I am the bread of life: he that comes to me shall never hunger, and he that believes on me shall never thirst at any time.

title: John 6:36
text: But I have said to you, that ye have also seen me and do not believe.

title: John 6:37
text: All that the Father gives me shall come to me, and him that comes to me I will not at all cast out.

title: John 6:38
text: For I am come down from heaven, not that I should do *my* will, but the will of him that has sent me.

title: John 6:39
text: And this is the will of him that has sent me, that of all that he has given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up in the last day.

title: John 6:40
text: For this is the will of my Father, that every one who sees the Son, and believes on him, should have life eternal; and I will raise him up at the last day.

title: John 6:41
text: The Jews therefore murmured about him, because he said, I am the bread which has come down out of heaven.

title: John 6:42
text: And they said, Is not this Jesus the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we have known? how then does *he* say, I am come down out of heaven?

title: John 6:43
text: Jesus therefore answered and said to them, Murmur not among yourselves.

title: John 6:44
text: No one can come to me except the Father who has sent me draw him, and I will raise him up in the last day.

title: John 6:45
text: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every one that has heard from the Father [himself], and has learned [of him], comes to me;

title: John 6:46
text: not that any one has seen the Father, except he who is of God, he has seen the Father.

title: John 6:47
text: Verily, verily, I say to you, He that believes [on me] has life eternal.

title: John 6:48
text: I am the bread of life.

title: John 6:49
text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and died.

title: John 6:50
text: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that one may eat of it and not die.

title: John 6:51
text: I am the living bread which has come down out of heaven: if any one shall have eaten of this bread he shall live for ever; but the bread withal which I shall give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

title: John 6:52
text: The Jews therefore contended among themselves, saying, How can he give us this flesh to eat?

title: John 6:53
text: Jesus therefore said to them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Unless ye shall have eaten the flesh of the Son of man, and drunk his blood, ye have no life in yourselves.

title: John 6:54
text: He that eats my flesh and drinks my blood has life eternal, and I will raise him up at the last day:

title: John 6:55
text: for my flesh is truly food and my blood is truly drink.

title: John 6:56
text: He that eats my flesh and drinks my blood dwells in me and I in him.

title: John 6:57
text: As the living Father has sent me and I live on account of the Father, *he* also who eats me shall live also on account of me.

title: John 6:58
text: This is the bread which has come down out of heaven. Not as the fathers ate and died: he that eats this bread shall live for ever.

title: John 6:59
text: These things he said in [the] synagogue, teaching in Capernaum.

title: John 6:60
text: ¶Many therefore of his disciples having heard [it] said, This word is hard; who can hear it?

title: John 6:61
text: But Jesus, knowing in himself that his disciples murmur concerning this, said to them, Does this offend you?

title: John 6:62
text: If then ye see the Son of man ascending up where he was before?

title: John 6:63
text: It is the Spirit which quickens, the flesh profits nothing: the words which I have spoken unto you are spirit and are life.

title: John 6:64
text: But there are some of you who do not believe. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who did not believe, and who would deliver him up.

title: John 6:65
text: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no one can come to me unless it be given to him from the Father.

title: John 6:66
text: From that [time] many of his disciples went away back and walked no more with him.

title: John 6:67
text: Jesus therefore said to the twelve, Will ye also go away?

title: John 6:68
text: Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast words of life eternal;

title: John 6:69
text: and we have believed and known that thou art the holy one of God.

title: John 6:70
text: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you the twelve? and of you one is a devil.

title: John 6:71
text: Now he spoke of Judas [the son] of Simon, Iscariote, for he [it was who] should deliver him up, being one of the twelve.

title: John 7:1
text: ¶And after these things Jesus walked in Galilee, for he would not walk in Judaea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

title: John 7:2
text: Now the tabernacles, the feast of the Jews, was near.

title: John 7:3
text: His brethren therefore said to him, Remove hence and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see thy works which thou doest;

title: John 7:4
text: for no one does anything in secret and himself seeks to be [known] in public. If thou doest these things, manifest thyself to the world:

title: John 7:5
text: for neither did his brethren believe on him.

title: John 7:6
text: Jesus therefore says to them, My time is not yet come, but your time is always ready.

title: John 7:7
text: The world cannot hate you, but me it hates, because I bear witness concerning it that its works are evil.

title: John 7:8
text: Ye, go ye up to this feast. I go not up to this feast, for *my* time is not yet fulfilled.

title: John 7:9
text: Having said these things to them he abode in Galilee.

title: John 7:10
text: But when his brethren had gone up, then he himself also went up to the feast, not openly, but as in secret.

title: John 7:11
text: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

title: John 7:12
text: And there was much murmuring concerning him among the crowds. Some said, He is [a] good [man]; others said, No; but he deceives the crowd.

title: John 7:13
text: However, no one spoke openly concerning him on account of [their] fear of the Jews.

title: John 7:14
text: ¶But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

title: John 7:15
text: The Jews therefore wondered, saying, How knows this [man] letters, having never learned?

title: John 7:16
text: Jesus therefore answered them and said, My doctrine is not mine, but [that] of him that has sent me.

title: John 7:17
text: If any one desire to practise his will, he shall know concerning the doctrine, whether it is of God, or [that] I speak from myself.

title: John 7:18
text: He that speaks from himself seeks his own glory; but he that seeks the glory of him that has sent him, he is true, and unrighteousness is not in him.

title: John 7:19
text: Has not Moses given you the law, and no one of you practises the law? Why do ye seek to kill me?

title: John 7:20
text: The crowd answered [and said], Thou hast a demon: who seeks to kill thee?

title: John 7:21
text: Jesus answered and said to them, I have done one work, and ye all wonder.

title: John 7:22
text: Therefore Moses gave you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and ye circumcise a man on sabbath.

title: John 7:23
text: If a man receives circumcision on sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be violated, are ye angry with me because I have made a man entirely sound on sabbath?

title: John 7:24
text: Judge not according to sight, but judge righteous judgment.

title: John 7:25
text: Some therefore of those of Jerusalem said, Is not this he whom they seek to kill?

title: John 7:26
text: and behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Have the rulers then indeed recognised that this is the Christ?

title: John 7:27
text: But [as to] this [man] we know whence he is. Now [as to] the Christ, when he comes, no one knows whence he is.

title: John 7:28
text: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, Ye both know me and ye know whence I am; and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye do not know.

title: John 7:29
text: I know him, because I am from him, and *he* has sent me.

title: John 7:30
text: They sought therefore to take him; and no one laid his hand upon him, because his hour had not yet come.

title: John 7:31
text: But many of the crowd believed on him, and said, Will the Christ, when he comes, do more signs than those which this [man] has done?

title: John 7:32
text: The Pharisees heard the crowd murmuring these things concerning him, and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers that they might take him.

title: John 7:33
text: Jesus therefore said, Yet a little while I am with you, and I go to him that has sent me.

title: John 7:34
text: Ye shall seek me and shall not find [me], and where I am ye cannot come.

title: John 7:35
text: The Jews therefore said to one another, Where is he about to go that we shall not find him? Is he about to go to the dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?

title: John 7:36
text: What word is this which he said, Ye shall seek me and shall not find [me]; and where I am ye cannot come?

title: John 7:37
text: ¶In the last, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried saying, If any one thirst, let him come to me and drink.

title: John 7:38
text: He that believes on me, as the scripture has said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

title: John 7:39
text: But this he said concerning the Spirit, which they that believed on him were about to receive; for [the] Spirit was not yet, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.

title: John 7:40
text: [Some] out of the crowd therefore, having heard this word, said, This is truly the prophet.

title: John 7:41
text: Others said, This is the Christ. Others said, Does then the Christ come out of Galilee?

title: John 7:42
text: Has not the scripture said that the Christ comes of the seed of David, and from the village of Bethlehem, where David was?

title: John 7:43
text: There was a division therefore in the crowd on account of him.

title: John 7:44
text: But some of them desired to take him, but no one laid hands upon him.

title: John 7:45
text: ¶The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, Why have ye not brought him?

title: John 7:46
text: The officers answered, Never man spoke thus, as this man [speaks].

title: John 7:47
text: The Pharisees therefore answered them, Are ye also deceived?

title: John 7:48
text: Has any one of the rulers believed on him, or of the Pharisees?

title: John 7:49
text: But this crowd, which does not know the law, are accursed.

title: John 7:50
text: Nicodemus says to them (being one of themselves),

title: John 7:51
text: Does our law judge a man before it have first heard from himself, and know what he does?

title: John 7:52
text: They answered and said to him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search and look, that no prophet arises out of Galilee.

title: John 7:53
text: And every one went to his home.

title: John 8:1
text: ¶But Jesus went to the mount of Olives.

title: John 8:2
text: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him; and he sat down and taught them.

title: John 8:3
text: And the scribes and the Pharisees bring [to him] a woman taken in adultery, and having set her in the midst,

title: John 8:4
text: they say to him, Teacher, this woman has been taken in the very act, committing adultery.

title: John 8:5
text: Now in the law Moses has commanded us to stone such; thou therefore, what sayest thou?

title: John 8:6
text: But this they said proving him, that they might have [something] to accuse him [of]. But Jesus, having stooped down, wrote with his finger on the ground.

title: John 8:7
text: But when they continued asking him, he lifted himself up and said to them, Let him that is without sin among you first cast the stone at her.

title: John 8:8
text: And again stooping down he wrote on the ground.

title: John 8:9
text: But they, having heard [that], went out one by one beginning from the elder ones until the last; and Jesus was left alone and the woman standing there.

title: John 8:10
text: And Jesus, lifting himself up and seeing no one but the woman, said to her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? Has no one condemned thee?

title: John 8:11
text: And she said, No one, sir. And Jesus said to her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

title: John 8:12
text: ¶Again therefore Jesus spoke to them, saying, I am the light of the world; he that follows me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

title: John 8:13
text: The Pharisees therefore said to him, Thou bearest witness concerning thyself; thy witness is not true.

title: John 8:14
text: Jesus answered and said to them, Even if I bear witness concerning myself, my witness is true, because I know whence I came and whither I go: but ye know not whence I come and whither I go.

title: John 8:15
text: Ye judge according to the flesh, I judge no one.

title: John 8:16
text: And if also I judge, my judgment is true, because I am not alone, but I and the Father who has sent me.

title: John 8:17
text: And in your law too it is written that the testimony of two men is true:

title: John 8:18
text: I am [one] who bear witness concerning myself, and the Father who has sent me bears witness concerning me.

title: John 8:19
text: They said to him therefore, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye know neither me nor my Father. If ye had known me, ye would have known also my Father.

title: John 8:20
text: These words spoke he in the treasury, teaching in the temple; and no one took him, for his hour was not yet come.

title: John 8:21
text: ¶He said therefore again to them, I go away, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sin; where I go ye cannot come.

title: John 8:22
text: The Jews therefore said, Will he kill himself, that he says, Where I go ye cannot come?

title: John 8:23
text: And he said to them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above. Ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

title: John 8:24
text: I said therefore to you, that ye shall die in your sins; for unless ye shall believe that I am [he], ye shall die in your sins.

title: John 8:25
text: They said therefore to him, Who art thou? [And] Jesus said to them, Altogether that which I also say to you.

title: John 8:26
text: I have many things to say and to judge concerning you, but he that has sent me is true, and I, what I have heard from him, these things I say to the world.

title: John 8:27
text: They knew not that he spoke to them of the Father.

title: John 8:28
text: Jesus therefore said to them, When ye shall have lifted up the Son of man, then ye shall know that I am [he], and [that] I do nothing of myself, but as the Father has taught me I speak these things.

title: John 8:29
text: And he that has sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, because I do always the things that are pleasing to him.

title: John 8:30
text: As he spoke these things many believed on him.

title: John 8:31
text: ¶Jesus therefore said to the Jews who believed him, If ye abide in my word, ye are truly my disciples;

title: John 8:32
text: and ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall set you free.

title: John 8:33
text: They answered him, We are Abraham's seed, and have never been under bondage to any one; how sayest thou, Ye shall become free?

title: John 8:34
text: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say to you, Every one that practises sin is the bondman of sin.

title: John 8:35
text: Now the bondman abides not in the house for ever: the son abides for ever.

title: John 8:36
text: If therefore the Son shall set you free, ye shall be really free.

title: John 8:37
text: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word has no entrance in you.

title: John 8:38
text: ¶I speak what I have seen with my Father, and ye then do what ye have seen with your father.

title: John 8:39
text: They answered and said to him, Abraham is our father. Jesus says to them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham;

title: John 8:40
text: but now ye seek to kill me, a man who has spoken the truth to you, which I have heard from God: this did not Abraham.

title: John 8:41
text: Ye do the works of your father. They said [therefore] to him, We are not born of fornication; we have one father, God.

title: John 8:42
text: Jesus said to them, If God were your father ye would have loved me, for I came forth from God and am come [from him]; for neither am I come of myself, but *he* has sent me.

title: John 8:43
text: Why do ye not know my speech? Because ye cannot hear my word.

title: John 8:44
text: Ye are of the devil, as [your] father, and ye desire to do the lusts of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and has not stood in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks falsehood, he speaks of what is his own; for he is a liar and its father:

title: John 8:45
text: and because I speak the truth, ye do not believe me.

title: John 8:46
text: ¶Which of you convinces me of sin? If I speak truth, why do ye not believe me?

title: John 8:47
text: He that is of God hears the words of God: therefore ye hear [them] not, because ye are not of God.

title: John 8:48
text: The Jews answered and said to him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan and hast a demon?

title: John 8:49
text: Jesus answered, I have not a demon; but I honour my Father, and ye dishonour me.

title: John 8:50
text: But I do not seek my own glory: there is he that seeks and judges.

title: John 8:51
text: ¶Verily, verily, I say unto you, If any one shall keep my word, he shall never see death.

title: John 8:52
text: The Jews therefore said to him, Now we know that thou hast a demon. Abraham has died, and the prophets, and thou sayest, If any one keep my word, he shall never taste death.

title: John 8:53
text: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, who has died? and the prophets have died: whom makest thou thyself?

title: John 8:54
text: Jesus answered, If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing: it is my Father who glorifies me, [of] whom ye say, He is our God.

title: John 8:55
text: And ye know him not; but I know him; and if I said, I know him not, I should be like you, a liar. But I know him, and I keep his word.

title: John 8:56
text: Your father Abraham exulted in that he should see my day, and he saw and rejoiced.

title: John 8:57
text: The Jews therefore said to him, Thou hast not yet fifty years, and hast thou seen Abraham?

title: John 8:58
text: Jesus said to them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

title: John 8:59
text: They took up therefore stones that they might cast [them] at him; but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, [going through the midst of them, and thus passed on.]

title: John 9:1
text: ¶And as he passed on, he saw a man blind from birth.

title: John 9:2
text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Rabbi, who sinned, this [man] or his parents, that he should be born blind?

title: John 9:3
text: Jesus answered, Neither has this [man] sinned nor his parents, but that the works of God should be manifested in him.

title: John 9:4
text: I must work the works of him that has sent me while it is day. [The] night is coming, when no one can work.

title: John 9:5
text: As long as I am in the world, I am [the] light of the world.

title: John 9:6
text: Having said these things, he spat on the ground and made mud of the spittle, and put the mud, as ointment, on his eyes.

title: John 9:7
text: And he said to him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, which is interpreted, Sent. He went therefore and washed, and came seeing.

title: John 9:8
text: ¶The neighbours therefore, and those who used to see him before, that he was a beggar, said, Is not this he that was sitting and begging?

title: John 9:9
text: Some said, It is he; others said, No, but he is like him: *he* said, It is I.

title: John 9:10
text: They said therefore to him, How have thine eyes been opened?

title: John 9:11
text: He answered [and said], A man called Jesus made mud and anointed mine eyes, and said to me, Go to Siloam and wash: and having gone and washed, I saw.

title: John 9:12
text: They said therefore to him, Where is he? He says, I do not know.

title: John 9:13
text: ¶They bring him who was before blind to the Pharisees.

title: John 9:14
text: Now it was sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

title: John 9:15
text: The Pharisees therefore also again asked him how he received his sight. And he said to them, He put mud upon mine eyes, and I washed, and I see.

title: John 9:16
text: Some of the Pharisees therefore said, This man is not of God, for he does not keep the sabbath. Others said, How can a sinful man perform such signs? And there was a division among them.

title: John 9:17
text: They say therefore again to the blind [man], What dost thou say of him, that he has opened thine eyes? And he said, He is a prophet.

title: John 9:18
text: The Jews therefore did not believe concerning him that he was blind and had received sight, until they had called the parents of him that had received sight.

title: John 9:19
text: And they asked them saying, This is your son, of whom ye say that he was born blind: how then does he now see?

title: John 9:20
text: His parents answered [them] and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

title: John 9:21
text: but how he now sees we do not know, or who has opened his eyes we do not know. *He* is of age: ask *him*; *he* will speak concerning himself.

title: John 9:22
text: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews, for the Jews had already agreed that if any one confessed him [to be the] Christ, he should be excommunicated from the synagogue.

title: John 9:23
text: On this account his parents said, He is of age: ask *him*.

title: John 9:24
text: They called therefore a second time the man who had been blind, and said to him, Give glory to God: we know that this man is sinful.

title: John 9:25
text: He answered therefore, If he is sinful I know not. One thing I know, that, being blind [before], now I see.

title: John 9:26
text: And they said to him again, What did he do to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

title: John 9:27
text: He answered them, I told you already and ye did not hear: why do ye desire to hear again? do ye also wish to become his disciples?

title: John 9:28
text: They railed at him, and said, Thou art his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

title: John 9:29
text: We know that God spoke to Moses; but [as to] this [man], we know not whence he is.

title: John 9:30
text: The man answered and said to them, Now in this is a wonderful thing, that *ye* do not know whence he is, and he has opened mine eyes.

title: John 9:31
text: [But] we know that God does not hear sinners; but if any one be God-fearing and do his will, him he hears.

title: John 9:32
text: Since time was, it has not been heard that any one opened the eyes of one born blind.

title: John 9:33
text: If this [man] were not of God he would be able to do nothing.

title: John 9:34
text: They answered and said to him, Thou hast been wholly born in sins, and thou teachest us? And they cast him out.

title: John 9:35
text: ¶Jesus heard that they had cast him out, and having found him, he said to him, Thou, dost thou believe on the Son of God?

title: John 9:36
text: He answered and said, And who is he, Lord, that I may believe on him?

title: John 9:37
text: And Jesus said to him, Thou hast both seen him, and he that speaks with thee is he.

title: John 9:38
text: And he said, I believe, Lord: and he did him homage.

title: John 9:39
text: ¶And Jesus said, For judgment am I come into this world, that they which see not may see, and they which see may become blind.

title: John 9:40
text: And [some] of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and they said to him, Are we blind also?

title: John 9:41
text: Jesus said to them, If ye were blind ye would not have sin; but now ye say, We see, your sin remains.

title: John 10:1
text: ¶Verily, verily, I say to you, He that enters not in by the door to the fold of the sheep, but mounts up elsewhere, *he* is a thief and a robber;

title: John 10:2
text: but he that enters in by the door is [the] shepherd of the sheep.

title: John 10:3
text: To him the porter opens; and the sheep hear his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.

title: John 10:4
text: When he has put forth all his own, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, because they know his voice.

title: John 10:5
text: But they will not follow a stranger, but will flee from him, because they know not the voice of strangers.

title: John 10:6
text: This allegory spoke Jesus to them, but they did not know what it was [of] which he spoke to them.

title: John 10:7
text: Jesus therefore said again to them, Verily, verily, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

title: John 10:8
text: All whoever came before me are thieves and robbers; but the sheep did not hear them.

title: John 10:9
text: I am the door: if any one enter in by me, he shall be saved, and shall go in and shall go out and shall find pasture.

title: John 10:10
text: The thief comes not but that he may steal, and kill, and destroy: I am come that they might have life, and might have [it] abundantly.

title: John 10:11
text: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep:

title: John 10:12
text: but he who serves for wages, and who is not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming, and leaves the sheep and flees; and the wolf seizes them and scatters the sheep.

title: John 10:13
text: Now he who serves for wages flees because he serves for wages, and is not himself concerned about the sheep.

title: John 10:14
text: I am the good shepherd; and I know those that are mine, and am known of those that are mine,

title: John 10:15
text: as the Father knows me and I know the Father; and I lay down my life for the sheep.

title: John 10:16
text: And I have other sheep which are not of this fold: those also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one flock, one shepherd.

title: John 10:17
text: On this account the Father loves me, because I lay down my life that I may take it again.

title: John 10:18
text: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have authority to lay it down and I have authority to take it again. I have received this commandment of my Father.

title: John 10:19
text: ¶There was a division again among the Jews on account of these words;

title: John 10:20
text: but many of them said, He has a demon and raves; why do ye hear him?

title: John 10:21
text: Others said, These sayings are not [those] of one that is possessed by a demon. Can a demon open blind people's eyes?

title: John 10:22
text: ¶Now the feast of the dedication was celebrating at Jerusalem, and it was winter.

title: John 10:23
text: And Jesus walked in the temple in the porch of Solomon.

title: John 10:24
text: The Jews therefore surrounded him, and said to him, Until when dost thou hold our soul in suspense? If thou art the Christ, say [so] to us openly.

title: John 10:25
text: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye do not believe. The works which I do in my Father's name, these bear witness concerning me:

title: John 10:26
text: but ye do not believe, for ye are not of my sheep, as I told you.

title: John 10:27
text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me;

title: John 10:28
text: and I give them life eternal; and they shall never perish, and no one shall seize them out of my hand.

title: John 10:29
text: My Father who has given [them] to me is greater than all, and no one can seize out of the hand of my Father.

title: John 10:30
text: I and the Father are one.

title: John 10:31
text: The Jews therefore again took stones that they might stone him.

title: John 10:32
text: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewn you of my Father; for which work of them do ye stone me?

title: John 10:33
text: The Jews answered him, For a good work we stone thee not, but for blasphemy, and because thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

title: John 10:34
text: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

title: John 10:35
text: If he called *them* gods to whom the word of God came (and the scripture cannot be broken),

title: John 10:36
text: do ye say of him whom the Father has sanctified and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest, because I said, I am Son of God?

title: John 10:37
text: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not;

title: John 10:38
text: but if I do, even if ye believe not me, believe the works, that ye may know [and believe] that the Father is in me and I in him.

title: John 10:39
text: ¶They sought therefore again to take him; and he went away from out of their hand

title: John 10:40
text: and departed again beyond the Jordan to the place where John was baptising at the first: and he abode there.

title: John 10:41
text: And many came to him, and said, John did no sign; but all things which John said of this [man] were true.

title: John 10:42
text: And many believed on him there.

title: John 11:1
text: ¶Now there was a certain [man] sick, Lazarus of Bethany, of the village of Mary and Martha her sister.

title: John 11:2
text: It was [the] Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

title: John 11:3
text: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

title: John 11:4
text: But when Jesus heard [it], he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified by it.

title: John 11:5
text: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

title: John 11:6
text: When therefore he heard, He is sick, he remained two days then in the place where he was.

title: John 11:7
text: Then after this he says to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

title: John 11:8
text: The disciples say to him, Rabbi, [even but] now the Jews sought to stone thee, and goest thou thither again?

title: John 11:9
text: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any one walk in the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world;

title: John 11:10
text: but if any one walk in the night, he stumbles, because the light is not in him.

title: John 11:11
text: These things said he; and after this he says to them, Lazarus, our friend, is fallen asleep, but I go that I may awake him out of sleep.

title: John 11:12
text: The disciples therefore said to him, Lord, if he be fallen asleep, he will get well.

title: John 11:13
text: But Jesus spoke of his death, but *they* thought that he spoke of the rest of sleep.

title: John 11:14
text: Jesus therefore then said to them plainly, Lazarus has died.

title: John 11:15
text: And I rejoice on your account that I was not there, in order that ye may believe. But let us go to him.

title: John 11:16
text: Thomas therefore, called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, Let *us* also go, that we may die with him.

title: John 11:17
text: ¶Jesus therefore [on] arriving found him to have been four days already in the tomb.

title: John 11:18
text: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia off,

title: John 11:19
text: and many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, that they might console them concerning their brother.

title: John 11:20
text: Martha then, when she heard Jesus is coming, went to meet him; but Mary sat in the house.

title: John 11:21
text: Martha therefore said to Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died;

title: John 11:22
text: but even now I know, that whatsoever thou shalt ask of God, God will give thee.

title: John 11:23
text: Jesus says to her, Thy brother shall rise again.

title: John 11:24
text: Martha says to him, I know that he will rise again in the resurrection in the last day.

title: John 11:25
text: Jesus said to her, I am the resurrection and the life: he that believes on me, though he have died, shall live;

title: John 11:26
text: and every one who lives and believes on me shall never die. Believest thou this?

title: John 11:27
text: She says to him, Yea, Lord; I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, who should come into the world.

title: John 11:28
text: And having said this, she went away and called her sister Mary secretly, saying, The teacher is come and calls thee.

title: John 11:29
text: She, when she heard [that], rises up quickly and comes to him.

title: John 11:30
text: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha came to meet him.

title: John 11:31
text: The Jews therefore who were with her in the house and consoling her, seeing Mary that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, She goes to the tomb, that she may weep there.

title: John 11:32
text: Mary therefore, when she came where Jesus was, seeing him, fell at his feet, saying to him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

title: John 11:33
text: ¶Jesus therefore, when he saw her weeping, and the Jews who came with her weeping, was deeply moved in spirit, and was troubled,

title: John 11:34
text: and said, Where have ye put him? They say to him, Lord, come and see.

title: John 11:35
text: Jesus wept.

title: John 11:36
text: The Jews therefore said, Behold how he loved him!

title: John 11:37
text: And some of them said, Could not this [man], who has opened the eyes of the blind [man], have caused that this [man] also should not have died?

title: John 11:38
text: Jesus therefore, again deeply moved in himself, comes to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

title: John 11:39
text: Jesus says, Take away the stone. Martha, the sister of the dead, says to him, Lord, he stinks already, for he is four days [there].

title: John 11:40
text: Jesus says to her, Did I not say to thee, that if thou shouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

title: John 11:41
text: They took therefore the stone away. And Jesus lifted up his eyes on high and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me;

title: John 11:42
text: but I knew that thou always hearest me; but on account of the crowd who stand around I have said [it], that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

title: John 11:43
text: And having said this, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

title: John 11:44
text: And the dead came forth, bound feet and hands with graveclothes, and his face was bound round with a handkerchief. Jesus says to them, Loose him and let him go.

title: John 11:45
text: ¶Many therefore of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what he had done, believed on him;

title: John 11:46
text: but some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

title: John 11:47
text: The chief priests, therefore, and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, What do we? for this man does many signs.

title: John 11:48
text: If we let him thus alone, all will believe on him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.

title: John 11:49
text: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, Ye know nothing

title: John 11:50
text: nor consider that it is profitable for you that one man die for the people, and not that the whole nation perish.

title: John 11:51
text: But this he did not say of himself; but, being high priest that year, prophesied that Jesus was going to die for the nation;

title: John 11:52
text: and not for the nation only, but that he should also gather together into one the children of God who were scattered abroad.

title: John 11:53
text: From that day therefore they took counsel that they might kill him.

title: John 11:54
text: Jesus therefore walked no longer openly among the Jews, but went away thence into the country near the desert, to a city called Ephraim, and there he sojourned with the disciples.

title: John 11:55
text: But the passover of the Jews was near, and many went up to Jerusalem out of the country before the passover, that they might purify themselves.

title: John 11:56
text: They sought therefore Jesus, and said among themselves, standing in the temple, What do ye think? that he will not come to the feast?

title: John 11:57
text: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given commandment that if any one knew where he was, he should make it known, that they might take him.

title: John 12:1
text: ¶Jesus therefore, six days before the passover, came to Bethany, where was the dead [man] Lazarus, whom Jesus raised from among [the] dead.

title: John 12:2
text: There therefore they made him a supper, and Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those at table with him.

title: John 12:3
text: Mary therefore, having taken a pound of ointment of pure nard of great price, anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair, and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

title: John 12:4
text: One of his disciples therefore, Judas [son] of Simon, Iscariote, who was about to deliver him up, says,

title: John 12:5
text: Why was this ointment not sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?

title: John 12:6
text: But he said this, not that he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief and had the bag, and carried what was put into [it].

title: John 12:7
text: Jesus therefore said, Suffer her to have kept this for the day of my preparation for burial;

title: John 12:8
text: for ye have the poor always with you, but me ye have not always.

title: John 12:9
text: A great crowd therefore of the Jews knew that he was there; and they came, not because of Jesus only, but also that they might see Lazarus whom he raised from among [the] dead.

title: John 12:10
text: But the chief priests took counsel that they might kill Lazarus also,

title: John 12:11
text: because many of the Jews went away on his account and believed on Jesus.

title: John 12:12
text: ¶On the morrow a great crowd who came to the feast, having heard that Jesus is coming into Jerusalem,

title: John 12:13
text: took branches of palms and went out to meet him, and cried, Hosanna, blessed [is] he that comes in the name of [the] Lord, the King of Israel.

title: John 12:14
text: And Jesus, having found a young ass, sat upon it; as it is written,

title: John 12:15
text: Fear not, daughter of Zion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

title: John 12:16
text: [Now] his disciples knew not these things at the first; but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things to him.

title: John 12:17
text: The crowd therefore that was with him bore witness because he had called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from among [the] dead.

title: John 12:18
text: Therefore also the crowd met him because they had heard that he had done this sign.

title: John 12:19
text: The Pharisees therefore said to one another, Ye see that ye profit nothing: behold, the world is gone after him.

title: John 12:20
text: ¶And there were certain Greeks among those who came up that they might worship in the feast;

title: John 12:21
text: these therefore came to Philip, who was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and they asked him saying, Sir, we desire to see Jesus.

title: John 12:22
text: Philip comes and tells Andrew, [and again] Andrew comes and Philip, and they tell Jesus.

title: John 12:23
text: But Jesus answered them saying, The hour is come that the Son of man should be glorified.

title: John 12:24
text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except the grain of wheat falling into the ground die, it abides alone; but if it die, it bears much fruit.

title: John 12:25
text: He that loves his life shall lose it, and he that hates his life in this world shall keep it to life eternal.

title: John 12:26
text: If any one serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there also shall be *my* servant. [And] if any one serve me, him shall the Father honour.

title: John 12:27
text: ¶Now is my soul troubled, and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour. But on account of this have I come to this hour.

title: John 12:28
text: Father, glorify thy name. There came therefore a voice out of heaven, I both have glorified and will glorify [it] again.

title: John 12:29
text: The crowd therefore, which stood [there] and heard [it], said that it had thundered. Others said, An angel has spoken to him.

title: John 12:30
text: Jesus answered and said, Not on my account has this voice come, but on yours.

title: John 12:31
text: Now is [the] judgment of this world; now shall the prince of this world be cast out:

title: John 12:32
text: and I, if I be lifted up out of the earth, will draw all to me.

title: John 12:33
text: But this he said signifying by what death he was about to die.

title: John 12:34
text: The crowd answered him, We have heard out of the law that the Christ abides for ever; and how sayest thou that the Son of man must be lifted up? Who *is* this, the Son of man?

title: John 12:35
text: Jesus therefore said to them, Yet a little while is the light amongst you. Walk while ye have the light, that darkness may not overtake you. And he who walks in the darkness does not know where he goes.

title: John 12:36
text: While ye have the light, believe in the light, that ye may become sons of light. Jesus said these things, and going away hid himself from them.

title: John 12:37
text: ¶But though he had done so many signs before them, they believed not on him,

title: John 12:38
text: that the word of the prophet Esaias which he said might be fulfilled, Lord, who has believed our report? and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

title: John 12:39
text: On this account they could not believe, because Esaias said again,

title: John 12:40
text: He has blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, that they may not see with their eyes, and understand with their heart and be converted, and I should heal them.

title: John 12:41
text: These things said Esaias because he saw his glory and spoke of him.

title: John 12:42
text: ¶Although indeed from among the rulers also many believed on him, but on account of the Pharisees did not confess [him], that they might not be put out of the synagogue:

title: John 12:43
text: for they loved glory from men rather than glory from God.

title: John 12:44
text: ¶But Jesus cried and said, He that believes on me, believes not on me, but on him that sent me;

title: John 12:45
text: and he that beholds me, beholds him that sent me.

title: John 12:46
text: I am come into the world [as] light, that every one that believes on me may not abide in darkness;

title: John 12:47
text: and if any one hear my words and do not keep [them], I judge him not, for I am not come that I might judge the world, but that I might save the world.

title: John 12:48
text: He that rejects me and does not receive my words, has him who judges him: the word which I have spoken, that shall judge him in the last day.

title: John 12:49
text: For I have not spoken from myself, but the Father who sent me has himself given me commandment what I should say and what I should speak;

title: John 12:50
text: and I know that his commandment is life eternal. What therefore I speak, as the Father has said to me, so I speak.

title: John 13:1
text: ¶Now before the feast of the passover, Jesus, knowing that his hour had come that he should depart out of this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, loved them to the end.

title: John 13:2
text: And during supper, the devil having already put it into the heart of Judas [son] of Simon, Iscariote, that he should deliver him up,

title: John 13:3
text: [Jesus,] knowing that the Father had given him all things into his hands, and that he came out from God and was going to God,

title: John 13:4
text: rises from supper and lays aside his garments, and having taken a linen towel he girded himself:

title: John 13:5
text: then he pours water into the washhand basin, and began to wash the feet of the disciples, and to wipe them with the linen towel with which he was girded.

title: John 13:6
text: He comes therefore to Simon Peter; and *he* says to him, Lord, dost thou wash *my* feet?

title: John 13:7
text: Jesus answered and said to him, What I do thou dost not know now, but thou shalt know hereafter.

title: John 13:8
text: Peter says to him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, Unless I wash thee, thou hast not part with me.

title: John 13:9
text: Simon Peter says to him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

title: John 13:10
text: Jesus says to him, He that is washed all over needs not to wash save his feet, but is wholly clean; and ye are clean, but not all.

title: John 13:11
text: For he knew him that delivered him up: on account of this he said, Ye are not all clean.

title: John 13:12
text: When therefore he had washed their feet, and taken his garments, having sat down again, he said to them, Do ye know what I have done to you?

title: John 13:13
text: Ye call me the Teacher and the Lord, and ye say well, for I am [so].

title: John 13:14
text: If I therefore, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, ye also ought to wash one another's feet;

title: John 13:15
text: for I have given you an example that, as I have done to you, ye should do also.

title: John 13:16
text: Verily, verily, I say to you, The bondman is not greater than his lord, nor the sent greater than he who has sent him.

title: John 13:17
text: If ye know these things, blessed are ye if ye do them.

title: John 13:18
text: ¶I speak not of you all. I know those whom I have chosen; but that the scripture might be fulfilled, He that eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.

title: John 13:19
text: I tell you [it] now before it happens, that when it happens, ye may believe that I am [he].

title: John 13:20
text: Verily, verily, I say to you, He who receives whomsoever I shall send receives me; and he that receives me receives him who has sent me.

title: John 13:21
text: Having said these things, Jesus was troubled in spirit, and testified and said, Verily, verily, I say to you, that one of you shall deliver me up.

title: John 13:22
text: The disciples therefore looked one on another, doubting of whom he spoke.

title: John 13:23
text: Now there was at table one of his disciples in the bosom of Jesus, whom Jesus loved.

title: John 13:24
text: Simon Peter makes a sign therefore to him to ask who it might be of whom he spoke.

title: John 13:25
text: But he, leaning on the breast of Jesus, says to him, Lord, who is it?

title: John 13:26
text: Jesus answers, He it is to whom I, after I have dipped the morsel, give it. And having dipped the morsel, he gives it to Judas [son] of Simon, Iscariote.

title: John 13:27
text: And, after the morsel, then entered Satan into him. Jesus therefore says to him, What thou doest, do quickly.

title: John 13:28
text: But none of those at table knew why he said this to him;

title: John 13:29
text: for some supposed, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus was saying to him, Buy the things of which we have need for the feast; or that he should give something to the poor.

title: John 13:30
text: Having therefore received the morsel, he went out immediately; and it was night.

title: John 13:31
text: ¶When therefore he was gone out Jesus says, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

title: John 13:32
text: If God be glorified in him, God also shall glorify him in himself, and shall glorify him immediately.

title: John 13:33
text: Children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me; and, as I said to the Jews, Where I go ye cannot come, I say to you also now.

title: John 13:34
text: A new commandment I give to you, that ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

title: John 13:35
text: By this shall all know that ye are disciples of mine, if ye have love amongst yourselves.

title: John 13:36
text: ¶Simon Peter says to him, Lord, where goest thou? Jesus answered him, Where I go thou canst not follow me now, but thou shalt follow me after.

title: John 13:37
text: Peter says to him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thee.

title: John 13:38
text: Jesus answers, Thou wilt lay down thy life for me! Verily, verily, I say to thee, The cock shall not crow till thou hast denied me thrice.

title: John 14:1
text: ¶Let not your heart be troubled; ye believe on God, believe also on me.

title: John 14:2
text: In my Father's house there are many abodes; were it not so, I had told you: for I go to prepare you a place;

title: John 14:3
text: and if I go and shall prepare you a place, I am coming again and shall receive you to myself, that where I am ye also may be.

title: John 14:4
text: ¶And ye know where I go, and ye know the way.

title: John 14:5
text: Thomas says to him, Lord, we know not where thou goest, and how can we know the way?

title: John 14:6
text: Jesus says to him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father unless by me.

title: John 14:7
text: If ye had known me, ye would have known also my Father, and henceforth ye know him and have seen him.

title: John 14:8
