text: Philip says to him, Lord, shew us the Father and it suffices us.

title: John 14:9
text: Jesus says to him, Am I so long a time with you, and thou hast not known me, Philip? He that has seen me has seen the Father; and how sayest thou, Shew us the Father?

title: John 14:10
text: Believest thou not that I [am] in the Father, and that the Father is in me? The words which I speak to you I do not speak from myself; but the Father who abides in me, he does the works.

title: John 14:11
text: Believe *me* that I [am] in the Father and the Father in me; but if not, believe me for the works' sake themselves.

title: John 14:12
text: ¶Verily, verily, I say to you, He that believes on me, the works which I do shall he do also, and he shall do greater than these, because I go to the Father.

title: John 14:13
text: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, this will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

title: John 14:14
text: If ye shall ask anything in my name, I will do it.

title: John 14:15
text: ¶If ye love me, keep my commandments.

title: John 14:16
text: And I will beg the Father, and he will give you another Comforter, that he may be with you for ever,

title: John 14:17
text: the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see him nor know him; but ye know him, for he abides with you, and shall be in you.

title: John 14:18
text: ¶I will not leave you orphans, I am coming to you.

title: John 14:19
text: Yet a little and the world sees me no longer; but ye see me; because I live ye also shall live.

title: John 14:20
text: In that day ye shall know that I [am] in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

title: John 14:21
text: He that has my commandments and keeps them, he it is that loves me; but he that loves me shall be loved by my Father, and I will love him and will manifest myself to him.

title: John 14:22
text: Judas, not the Iscariote, says to him, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself to us and not to the world?

title: John 14:23
text: Jesus answered and said to him, If any one love me, he will keep my word, and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our abode with him.

title: John 14:24
text: He that loves me not does not keep my words; and the word which ye hear is not mine, but [that] of the Father who has sent me.

title: John 14:25
text: ¶These things I have said to you, abiding with you;

title: John 14:26
text: but the Comforter, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, *he* shall teach you all things, and will bring to your remembrance all the things which I have said to you.

title: John 14:27
text: I leave peace with you; I give *my* peace to you: not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it fear.

title: John 14:28
text: ¶Ye have heard that I have said unto you, I go away and I am coming to you. If ye loved me ye would rejoice that I go to the Father, for [my] Father is greater than I.

title: John 14:29
text: And now I have told you before it comes to pass, that when it shall have come to pass ye may believe.

title: John 14:30
text: I will no longer speak much with you, for the ruler of the world comes, and in me he has nothing;

title: John 14:31
text: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father has commanded me, thus I do. Rise up, let us go hence.

title: John 15:1
text: ¶I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

title: John 15:2
text: [As to] every branch in me not bearing fruit, he takes it away; and [as to] every one bearing fruit, he purges it that it may bring forth more fruit.

title: John 15:3
text: Ye are already clean by reason of the word which I have spoken to you.

title: John 15:4
text: Abide in me and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself unless it abide in the vine, thus neither [can] ye unless ye abide in me.

title: John 15:5
text: I am the vine, ye [are] the branches. He that abides in me and I in him, *he* bears much fruit; for without me ye can do nothing.

title: John 15:6
text: Unless any one abide in me he is cast out as the branch, and is dried up; and they gather them and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

title: John 15:7
text: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will and it shall come to pass to you.

title: John 15:8
text: In this is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit, and ye shall become disciples of mine.

title: John 15:9
text: ¶As the Father has loved me, I also have loved you: abide in my love.

title: John 15:10
text: If ye shall keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love, as I have kept my Father's commandments and abide in his love.

title: John 15:11
text: I have spoken these things to you that my joy may be in you, and your joy be full.

title: John 15:12
text: This is my commandment, that ye love one another, as I have loved you.

title: John 15:13
text: No one has greater love than this, that one should lay down his life for his friends.

title: John 15:14
text: Ye are my friends if ye practise whatever I command you.

title: John 15:15
text: I call you no longer bondmen, for the bondman does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, for all things which I have heard of my Father I have made known to you.

title: John 15:16
text: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and have set you that ye should go and [that] ye should bear fruit, and [that] your fruit should abide, that whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name he may give you.

title: John 15:17
text: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

title: John 15:18
text: ¶If the world hate you, know that it has hated me before you.

title: John 15:19
text: If ye were of the world, the world would love its own; but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, on account of this the world hates you.

title: John 15:20
text: Remember the word which I said unto you, The bondman is not greater than his master. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my word, they will keep also yours.

title: John 15:21
text: But they will do all these things to you on account of my name, because they have not known him that sent me.

title: John 15:22
text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they had not had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

title: John 15:23
text: He that hates me hates also my Father.

title: John 15:24
text: If I had not done among them the works which no other one has done, they had not had sin; but now they have both seen and hated both me and my Father.

title: John 15:25
text: But that the word written in their law might be fulfilled, They hated me without a cause.

title: John 15:26
text: ¶But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who goes forth from with the Father, *he* shall bear witness concerning me;

title: John 15:27
text: and ye too bear witness, because ye are with me from [the] beginning.

title: John 16:1
text: ¶These things I have spoken unto you that ye may not be offended.

title: John 16:2
text: They shall put you out of the synagogues; but the hour is coming that every one who kills you will think to render service to God;

title: John 16:3
text: and these things they will do because they have not known the Father nor me.

title: John 16:4
text: But I have spoken these things to you, that when their hour shall have come, ye may remember them, that I have said [them] unto you. But I did not say these things unto you from [the] beginning, because I was with you.

title: John 16:5
text: But now I go to him that has sent me, and none of you demands of me, Where goest thou?

title: John 16:6
text: But because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.

title: John 16:7
text: ¶But I say the truth to you, It is profitable for you that I go away; for if I do not go away, the Comforter will not come to you; but if I go I will send him to you.

title: John 16:8
text: And having come, he will bring demonstration to the world, of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

title: John 16:9
text: of sin, because they do not believe on me;

title: John 16:10
text: of righteousness, because I go away to [my] Father, and ye behold me no longer;

title: John 16:11
text: of judgment, because the ruler of this world is judged.

title: John 16:12
text: I have yet many things to say to you, but ye cannot bear them now.

title: John 16:13
text: But when *he* is come, the Spirit of truth, he shall guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but whatsoever he shall hear he shall speak; and he will announce to you what is coming.

title: John 16:14
text: He shall glorify me, for he shall receive of mine and shall announce [it] to you.

title: John 16:15
text: All things that the Father has are mine; on account of this I have said that he receives of mine and shall announce [it] to you.

title: John 16:16
text: ¶A little while and ye do not behold me; and again a little while and ye shall see me, [because I go away to the Father].

title: John 16:17
text: [Some] of his disciples therefore said to one another, What is this he says to us, A little while and ye do not behold me; and again a little while and ye shall see me, and, Because I go away to the Father?

title: John 16:18
text: They said therefore, What is this which he says [of] the little while? We do not know [of] what he speaks.

title: John 16:19
text: Jesus knew therefore that they desired to demand of him, and said to them, Do ye inquire of this among yourselves that I said, A little while and ye do not behold me; and again a little while and ye shall see me?

title: John 16:20
text: Verily, verily, I say to you, that ye shall weep and lament, ye, but the world shall rejoice; and ye will be grieved, but your grief shall be turned to joy.

title: John 16:21
text: A woman, when she gives birth to a child, has grief because her hour has come; but when the child is born, she no longer remembers the trouble, on account of the joy that a man has been born into the world.

title: John 16:22
text: And ye now therefore have grief; but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one takes from you.

title: John 16:23
text: ¶And in that day ye shall demand nothing of me: verily, verily, I say to you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give you.

title: John 16:24
text: Hitherto ye have asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

title: John 16:25
text: These things I have spoken to you in allegories; the hour is coming that I will no longer speak to you in allegories, but will declare to you openly concerning the Father.

title: John 16:26
text: In that day ye shall ask in my name; and I say not to you that I will demand of the Father for you,

title: John 16:27
text: for the Father himself has affection for you, because ye have had affection for me, and have believed that I came out from God.

title: John 16:28
text: ¶I came out from the Father and have come into the world; again, I leave the world and go to the Father.

title: John 16:29
text: His disciples say to him, Lo, now thou speakest openly and utterest no allegory.

title: John 16:30
text: Now we know that thou knowest all things, and hast not need that any one should demand of thee. By this we believe that thou art come from God.

title: John 16:31
text: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

title: John 16:32
text: Behold, [the] hour is coming, and has come, that ye shall be scattered, each to his own, and shall leave me alone; and [yet] I am not alone, for the Father is with me.

title: John 16:33
text: These things have I spoken to you that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye have tribulation; but be of good courage: I have overcome the world.

title: John 17:1
text: ¶These things Jesus spoke, and lifted up his eyes to heaven and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son may glorify thee;

title: John 17:2
text: as thou hast given him authority over all flesh, that [as to] all that thou hast given to him, he should give them life eternal.

title: John 17:3
text: And this is the eternal life, that they should know thee, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom thou hast sent.

title: John 17:4
text: I have glorified *thee* on the earth, I have completed the work which thou gavest me that I should do it;

title: John 17:5
text: and now glorify *me*, *thou* Father, along with thyself, with the glory which I had along with thee before the world was.

title: John 17:6
text: ¶I have manifested thy name to the men whom thou gavest me out of the world. They were thine, and thou gavest them me, and they have kept thy word.

title: John 17:7
text: Now they have known that all things that thou hast given me are of thee;

title: John 17:8
text: for the words which thou hast given me I have given them, and they have received [them], and have known truly that I came out from thee, and have believed that thou sentest me.

title: John 17:9
text: I demand concerning them; I do not demand concerning the world, but concerning those whom thou hast given me, for they are thine,

title: John 17:10
text: (and all that is mine is thine, and [all] that is thine mine,) and I am glorified in them.

title: John 17:11
text: ¶And I am no longer in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name which thou hast given me, that they may be one as we.

title: John 17:12
text: When I was with them I kept them in thy name; those thou hast given me I have guarded, and not one of them has perished, but the son of perdition, that the scripture might be fulfilled.

title: John 17:13
text: And now I come to thee. And these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy fulfilled in them.

title: John 17:14
text: I have given them thy word, and the world has hated them, because they are not of the world, as I am not of the world.

title: John 17:15
text: I do not demand that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them out of evil.

title: John 17:16
text: They are not of the world, as I am not of the world.

title: John 17:17
text: ¶Sanctify them by the truth: thy word is truth.

title: John 17:18
text: As thou hast sent me into the world, I also have sent them into the world;

title: John 17:19
text: and I sanctify myself for them, that they also may be sanctified by truth.

title: John 17:20
text: ¶And I do not demand for these only, but also for those who believe on me through their word;

title: John 17:21
text: that they may be all one, as thou, Father, [art] in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us, that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

title: John 17:22
text: And the glory which thou hast given me I have given them, that they may be one, as we are one;

title: John 17:23
text: I in them and thou in me, that they may be perfected into one [and] that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and [that] thou hast loved them as thou hast loved me.

title: John 17:24
text: ¶Father, [as to] those whom thou hast given me, I desire that where I am they also may be with me, that they may behold my glory which thou hast given me, for thou lovedst me before [the] foundation of [the] world.

title: John 17:25
text: Righteous Father, --and the world has not known thee, but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

title: John 17:26
text: And I have made known to them thy name, and will make [it] known; that the love with which thou hast loved me may be in them and I in them.

title: John 18:1
text: ¶Jesus, having said these things, went out with his disciples beyond the torrent Cedron, where was a garden, into which he entered, he and his disciples.

title: John 18:2
text: And Judas also, who delivered him up, knew the place, because Jesus was often there, in company with his disciples.

title: John 18:3
text: Judas therefore, having got the band, and officers of the chief priests and Pharisees, comes there with lanterns and torches and weapons.

title: John 18:4
text: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that were coming upon him, went forth and said to them, Whom seek ye?

title: John 18:5
text: They answered him, Jesus the Nazaraean. Jesus says to them, I am [he]. And Judas also, who delivered him up, stood with them.

title: John 18:6
text: When therefore he said to them, I am [he], they went away backward and fell to the ground.

title: John 18:7
text: He demanded of them therefore again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus the Nazaraean.

title: John 18:8
text: Jesus answered, I told you that I am [he]: if therefore ye seek me, let these go away;

title: John 18:9
text: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, [As to] those whom thou hast given me, I have not lost one of them.

title: John 18:10
text: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, and smote the bondman of the high priest and cut off his right ear; and the bondman's name was Malchus.

title: John 18:11
text: Jesus therefore said to Peter, Put the sword into the sheath; the cup which the Father has given me, shall I not drink it?

title: John 18:12
text: The band therefore, and the chiliarch, and the officers of the Jews, took Jesus and bound him:

title: John 18:13
text: ¶and they led him away to Annas first; for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

title: John 18:14
text: But it was Caiaphas who counselled the Jews that it was better that one man should perish for the people.

title: John 18:15
text: Now Simon Peter followed Jesus, and the other disciple. But that disciple was known to the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest;

title: John 18:16
text: but Peter stood at the door without. The other disciple therefore, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to the porteress and brought in Peter.

title: John 18:17
text: The maid therefore, who was porteress, says to Peter, Art thou also of the disciples of this man? He says, I am not.

title: John 18:18
text: But the bondmen and officers, having made a fire of coals (for it was cold), stood and warmed themselves; and Peter was standing with them and warming himself.

title: John 18:19
text: The high priest therefore demanded of Jesus concerning his disciples and concerning his doctrine.

title: John 18:20
text: Jesus answered him, I spoke openly to the world; I taught always in [the] synagogue and in the temple, where all the Jews come together, and in secret I have spoken nothing.

title: John 18:21
text: Why demandest thou of me? Demand of those who have heard, what I have spoken to them; behold, they know what I have said.

title: John 18:22
text: But as he said these things, one of the officers who stood by gave a blow on the face to Jesus, saying, Answerest thou the high priest thus?

title: John 18:23
text: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil; but if well, why smitest thou me?

title: John 18:24
text: Annas [then] had sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

title: John 18:25
text: But Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, Art thou also of his disciples? He denied, and said, I am not.

title: John 18:26
text: One of the bondmen of the high priest, who was kinsman of him whose ear Peter cut off, says, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

title: John 18:27
text: Peter denied therefore again, and immediately [the] cock crew.

title: John 18:28
text: ¶They lead therefore Jesus from Caiaphas to the praetorium; and it was early morn. And *they* entered not into the praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but eat the passover.

title: John 18:29
text: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, What accusation do ye bring against this man?

title: John 18:30
text: They answered and said to him, If this [man] were not an evildoer, we should not have delivered him up to thee.

title: John 18:31
text: Pilate therefore said to them, Take him, ye, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said to him, It is not permitted to us to put any one to death;

title: John 18:32
text: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled which he spoke, signifying what death he should die.

title: John 18:33
text: Pilate therefore entered again into the praetorium and called Jesus, and said to him, Thou art the king of the Jews?

title: John 18:34
text: Jesus answered [him], Dost thou say this of thyself, or have others said it to thee concerning me?

title: John 18:35
text: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thy nation and the chief priests have delivered thee up to me: what hast thou done?

title: John 18:36
text: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world; if my kingdom were of this world, my servants had fought that I might not be delivered up to the Jews; but now my kingdom is not from hence.

title: John 18:37
text: Pilate therefore said to him, Thou art then a king? Jesus answered, Thou sayest [it], that I am a king. I have been born for this, and for this I have come into the world, that I might bear witness to the truth. Every one that is of the truth hears my voice.

title: John 18:38
text: Pilate says to him, What is truth? And having said this he went out again to the Jews, and says to them, I find no fault whatever in him.

title: John 18:39
text: But ye have a custom that I release [some] one to you at the passover; will ye therefore that I release unto you the king of the Jews?

title: John 18:40
text: They cried therefore again all, saying, Not this [man], but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

title: John 19:1
text: ¶Then Pilate therefore took Jesus and scourged [him].

title: John 19:2
text: And the soldiers having plaited a crown of thorns put it on his head, and put a purple robe on him,

title: John 19:3
text: and came to him and said, Hail, king of the Jews! and gave him blows on the face.

title: John 19:4
text: And Pilate went out again and says to them, Lo, I bring him out to you, that ye may know that I find in him no fault whatever.

title: John 19:5
text: (Jesus therefore went forth without, wearing the crown of thorn, and the purple robe.) And he says to them, Behold the man!

title: John 19:6
text: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him they cried out saying, Crucify, crucify [him]. Pilate says to them, Take him ye and crucify [him], for I find no fault in him.

title: John 19:7
text: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and according to [our] law he ought to die, because he made himself Son of God.

title: John 19:8
text: When Pilate therefore heard this word, he was the rather afraid,

title: John 19:9
text: and went into the praetorium again and says to Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

title: John 19:10
text: Pilate therefore says to him, Speakest thou not to *me*? Dost thou not know that I have authority to release thee and have authority to crucify thee?

title: John 19:11
text: Jesus answered, Thou hadst no authority whatever against me if it were not given to thee from above. On this account he that has delivered me up to thee has [the] greater sin.

title: John 19:12
text: From this time Pilate sought to release him; but the Jews cried out saying, If thou releasest this [man], thou art not a friend to Caesar. Every one making himself a king speaks against Caesar.

title: John 19:13
text: Pilate therefore, having heard these words, led Jesus out and sat down upon [the] judgment-seat, at a place called Pavement, but in Hebrew Gabbatha;

title: John 19:14
text: (now it was [the] preparation of the passover; it was about the sixth hour;) and he says to the Jews, Behold your king!

title: John 19:15
text: But they cried out, Take [him] away, take [him] away, crucify him. Pilate says to them, Shall I crucify your king? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.

title: John 19:16
text: ¶Then therefore he delivered him up to them, that he might be crucified; and they took Jesus and led him away.

title: John 19:17
text: And he went out, bearing his cross, to the place called [place] of a skull, which is called in Hebrew, Golgotha;

title: John 19:18
text: where they crucified him, and with him two others, [one] on this side, and [one] on that, and Jesus in the middle.

title: John 19:19
text: ¶And Pilate wrote a title also and put it on the cross. But there was written: Jesus the Nazaraean, the King of the Jews.

title: John 19:20
text: This title therefore many of the Jews read, for the place of the city where Jesus was crucified was near; and it was written in Hebrew, Greek, Latin.

title: John 19:21
text: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, Do not write, The king of the Jews, but that *he* said, I am king of the Jews.

title: John 19:22
text: Pilate answered, What I have written, I have written.

title: John 19:23
text: The soldiers therefore, when they had crucified Jesus, took his clothes, and made four parts, to each soldier a part, and the body-coat; but the body-coat was seamless, woven through the whole from the top.

title: John 19:24
text: They said therefore to one another, Let us not rend it, but let us cast lots for it, whose it shall be; that the scripture might be fulfilled which says, They parted my garments among themselves, and on my vesture they cast lots. The soldiers therefore did these things.

title: John 19:25
text: And by the cross of Jesus stood his mother, and the sister of his mother, Mary the [wife] of Clopas, and Mary of Magdala.

title: John 19:26
text: Jesus therefore, seeing his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, says to his mother, Woman, behold thy son.

title: John 19:27
text: Then he says unto the disciple, Behold thy mother. And from that hour the disciple took her to his own home.

title: John 19:28
text: After this, Jesus, knowing that all things were now finished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, says, I thirst.

title: John 19:29
text: There was a vessel therefore there full of vinegar, and having filled a sponge with vinegar, and putting hyssop round it, they put it up to his mouth.

title: John 19:30
text: When therefore Jesus had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished; and having bowed his head, he delivered up his spirit.

title: John 19:31
text: ¶The Jews therefore, that the bodies might not remain on the cross on the sabbath, for it was [the] preparation, (for the day of that sabbath was a great [day],) demanded of Pilate that their legs might be broken and they taken away.

title: John 19:32
text: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first and of the other that had been crucified with him;

title: John 19:33
text: but coming to Jesus, when they saw that he was already dead they did not break his legs,

title: John 19:34
text: but one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately there came out blood and water.

title: John 19:35
text: And he who saw it bears witness, and his witness is true, and he knows that he says true that ye also may believe.

title: John 19:36
text: For these things took place that the scripture might be fulfilled, Not a bone of him shall be broken.

title: John 19:37
text: And again another scripture says, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

title: John 19:38
text: ¶And after these things Joseph of Arimathaea, who was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly through fear of the Jews, demanded of Pilate that he might take the body of Jesus: and Pilate allowed it. He came therefore and took away the body of Jesus.

title: John 19:39
text: And Nicodemus also, who at first came to Jesus by night, came, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds [weight].

title: John 19:40
text: They took therefore the body of Jesus and bound it up in linen with the spices, as it is the custom with the Jews to prepare for burial.

title: John 19:41
text: But there was in the place where he had been crucified a garden, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had ever been laid.

title: John 19:42
text: There therefore, on account of the preparation of the Jews, because the tomb was near, they laid Jesus.

title: John 20:1
text: ¶And on the first [day] of the week Mary of Magdala comes in early morn to the tomb, while it was still dark, and sees the stone taken away from the tomb.

title: John 20:2
text: She runs therefore and comes to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, to whom Jesus was attached, and says to them, They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we know not where they have laid him.

title: John 20:3
text: Peter therefore went forth, and the other disciple, and came to the tomb.

title: John 20:4
text: And the two ran together, and the other disciple ran forward faster than Peter, and came first to the tomb,

title: John 20:5
text: and stooping down he sees the linen cloths lying; he did not however go in.

title: John 20:6
text: Simon Peter therefore comes, following him, and entered into the tomb, and sees the linen cloths lying,

title: John 20:7
text: and the handkerchief which was upon his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but folded up in a distinct place by itself.

title: John 20:8
text: Then entered in therefore the other disciple also who came first to the tomb, and he saw and believed;

title: John 20:9
text: for they had not yet known the scripture, that he must rise from among [the] dead.

title: John 20:10
text: The disciples therefore went away again to their own home.

title: John 20:11
text: ¶But Mary stood at the tomb weeping without. As therefore she wept, she stooped down into the tomb,

title: John 20:12
text: and beholds two angels sitting in white [garments], one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

title: John 20:13
text: And they say to her, Woman, why dost thou weep? She says to them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

title: John 20:14
text: Having said these things she turned backward and beholds Jesus standing [there], and knew not that it was Jesus.

title: John 20:15
text: Jesus says to her, Woman, why dost thou weep? Whom seekest thou? She, supposing that it was the gardener, says to him, Sir, if thou hast borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

title: John 20:16
text: Jesus says to her, Mary. She, turning round, says to him in Hebrew, Rabboni, which means Teacher.

title: John 20:17
text: Jesus says to her, Touch me not, for I have not yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brethren and say to them, I ascend to my Father and your Father, and [to] my God and your God.

title: John 20:18
text: Mary of Magdala comes bringing word to the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and [that] he had said these things to her.

title: John 20:19
text: ¶When therefore it was evening on that day, which was the first [day] of the week, and the doors shut where the disciples were, through fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and says to them, Peace [be] to you.

title: John 20:20
text: And having said this, he shewed to them his hands and his side. The disciples rejoiced therefore, having seen the Lord.

title: John 20:21
text: [Jesus] said therefore again to them, Peace [be] to you: as the Father sent me forth, I also send you.

title: John 20:22
text: And having said this, he breathed into [them], and says to them, Receive [the] Holy Spirit:

title: John 20:23
text: whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted to them; whose soever [sins] ye retain, they are retained.

title: John 20:24
text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

title: John 20:25
text: The other disciples therefore said to him, We have seen the Lord. But he said to them, Unless I see in his hands the mark of the nails, and put my finger into the mark of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.

title: John 20:26
text: ¶And eight days after, his disciples were again within, and Thomas with them. Jesus comes, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst and said, Peace [be] to you.

title: John 20:27
text: Then he says to Thomas, Bring thy finger here and see my hands; and bring thy hand and put it into my side; and be not unbelieving, but believing.

title: John 20:28
text: Thomas answered and said to him, My Lord and my God.

title: John 20:29
text: Jesus says to him, Because thou hast seen me thou hast believed: blessed they who have not seen and have believed.

title: John 20:30
text: Many other signs therefore also Jesus did before his disciples, which are not written in this book;

title: John 20:31
text: but these are written that ye may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing ye might have life in his name.

title: John 21:1
text: ¶After these things Jesus manifested himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. And he manifested [himself] thus.

title: John 21:2
text: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael who was of Cana of Galilee, and the [sons] of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples.

title: John 21:3
text: Simon Peter says to them, I go to fish. They say to him, We also come with thee. They went forth, and went on board, and that night took nothing.

title: John 21:4
text: And early morn already breaking, Jesus stood on the shore; the disciples however did not know that it was Jesus.

title: John 21:5
text: Jesus therefore says to them, Children, have ye anything to eat? They answered him, No.

title: John 21:6
text: And he said to them, Cast the net at the right side of the ship and ye will find. They cast therefore, and they could no longer draw it, from the multitude of fishes.

title: John 21:7
text: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved says to Peter, It is the Lord. Simon Peter therefore, having heard that it was the Lord, girded his overcoat [on him] (for he was naked), and cast himself into the sea;

title: John 21:8
text: and the other disciples came in the small boat, for they were not far from the land, but somewhere about two hundred cubits, dragging the net of fishes.

title: John 21:9
text: When therefore they went out on the land, they see a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.

title: John 21:10
text: Jesus says to them, Bring of the fishes which ye have now taken.

title: John 21:11
text: Simon Peter went up and drew the net to the land full of great fishes, a hundred and fifty-three; and though there were so many, the net was not rent.

title: John 21:12
text: Jesus says to them, Come [and] dine. But none of the disciples dared inquire of him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

title: John 21:13
text: Jesus comes and takes the bread and gives it to them, and the fish in like manner.

title: John 21:14
text: This is already the third time that Jesus had been manifested to the disciples, being risen from among [the] dead.

title: John 21:15
text: ¶When therefore they had dined, Jesus says to Simon Peter, Simon, [son] of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He says to him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I am attached to thee. He says to him, Feed my lambs.

title: John 21:16
text: He says to him again a second time, Simon, [son] of Jonas, lovest thou me? He says to him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I am attached to thee. He says to him, Shepherd my sheep.

title: John 21:17
text: He says to him the third time, Simon, [son] of Jonas, art thou attached to me? Peter was grieved because he said to him the third time, Art thou attached to me? and said to him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I am attached to thee. Jesus says to him, Feed my sheep.

title: John 21:18
text: Verily, verily, I say to thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst where thou desiredst; but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and bring thee where thou dost not desire.

title: John 21:19
text: But he said this signifying by what death he should glorify God. And having said this, he says to him, Follow me.

title: John 21:20
text: ¶Peter, turning round, sees the disciple whom Jesus loved following, who also leaned at supper on his breast, and said, Lord, who is it that delivers thee up?

title: John 21:21
text: Peter, seeing him, says to Jesus, Lord, and what [of] this [man]?

title: John 21:22
text: Jesus says to him, If I will that he abide until I come, what [is that] to thee? Follow thou me.

title: John 21:23
text: This word therefore went out among the brethren, That disciple does not die. And Jesus did not say to him, He does not die; but, If I will that he abide until I come, what [is that] to thee?

title: John 21:24
text: This is the disciple who bears witness concerning these things, and who has written these things; and we know that his witness is true.

title: John 21:25
text: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which if they were written one by one, I suppose that not even the world itself would contain the books written.

title: Acts 1:1
text: ¶I composed the first discourse, O Theophilus, concerning all things which Jesus began both to do and to teach,

title: Acts 1:2
text: until that day in which, having by the Holy Spirit charged the apostles whom he had chosen, he was taken up;

title: Acts 1:3
text: to whom also he presented himself living, after he had suffered, with many proofs; being seen by them during forty days, and speaking of the things which concern the kingdom of God;

title: Acts 1:4
text: and, being assembled with [them], commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to await the promise of the Father, which [said he] ye have heard of me.

title: Acts 1:5
text: For John indeed baptised with water, but *ye* shall be baptised with the Holy Spirit after now not many days.

title: Acts 1:6
text: ¶They therefore, being come together, asked him saying, Lord, is it at this time that thou restorest the kingdom to Israel?

title: Acts 1:7
text: And he said to them, It is not yours to know times or seasons, which the Father has placed in his own authority;

title: Acts 1:8
text: but ye will receive power, the Holy Spirit having come upon you, and ye shall be my witnesses both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.

title: Acts 1:9
text: And having said these things he was taken up, they beholding [him], and a cloud received him out of their sight.

title: Acts 1:10
text: And as they were gazing into heaven, as he was going, behold, also two men stood by them in white clothing,

title: Acts 1:11
text: who also said, Men of Galilee, why do ye stand looking into heaven? This Jesus who has been taken up from you into heaven, shall thus come in the manner in which ye have beheld him going into heaven.

title: Acts 1:12
text: ¶Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mount called [the mount] of Olives, which is near Jerusalem, a sabbath-day's journey off.

title: Acts 1:13
text: And when they were come into [the city], they went up to the upper chamber, where were staying both Peter, and John, and James, and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James [son] of Alphaeus, and Simon the zealot, and Jude [the brother] of James.

title: Acts 1:14
text: These gave themselves all with one accord to continual prayer, with [several] women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

title: Acts 1:15
text: ¶And in those days Peter, standing up in the midst of the brethren, said, (the crowd of names [who were] together [was] about a hundred and twenty,)

title: Acts 1:16
text: Brethren, it was necessary that the scripture should have been fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before, by the mouth of David, concerning Judas, who became guide to those who took Jesus;

title: Acts 1:17
text: for he was numbered amongst us, and had received a part in this service.

title: Acts 1:18
text: (This [man] then indeed got a field with [the] reward of iniquity, and, having fallen down headlong, burst in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

title: Acts 1:19
text: And it was known to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that that field was called in their own dialect Aceldama; that is, field of blood.)

title: Acts 1:20
text: For it is written in [the] book of Psalms, Let his homestead become desolate, and let there be no dweller in it; and, Let another take his overseership.

title: Acts 1:21
text: It is necessary therefore, that of the men who have assembled with us all [the] time in which the Lord Jesus came in and went out among us,

title: Acts 1:22
text: beginning from the baptism of John until the day in which he was taken up from us, one of these should be a witness with us of his resurrection.

title: Acts 1:23
text: And they appointed two, Joseph, who was called Barsabas, who had been surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

title: Acts 1:24
text: And they prayed, and said, Thou Lord, knower of the hearts of all, shew which one of these two thou hast chosen,

title: Acts 1:25
text: to receive the lot of this service and apostleship, from which Judas transgressing fell to go to his own place.

title: Acts 1:26
text: And they gave lots on them, and the lot fell on Matthias, and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

title: Acts 2:1
text: ¶And when the day of Pentecost was now accomplishing, they were all together in one place.

title: Acts 2:2
text: And there came suddenly a sound out of heaven as of a violent impetuous blowing, and filled all the house where they were sitting.

title: Acts 2:3
text: And there appeared to them parted tongues, as of fire, and it sat upon each one of them.

title: Acts 2:4
text: And they were all filled with [the] Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other tongues as the Spirit gave to them to speak forth.

title: Acts 2:5
text: ¶Now there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, pious men, from every nation of those under heaven.

title: Acts 2:6
text: But the rumour of this having spread, the multitude came together and were confounded, because each one heard them speaking in his own dialect.

title: Acts 2:7
text: And all were amazed and wondered, saying, Behold, are not all these who are speaking Galilaeans?

title: Acts 2:8
text: and how do *we* hear [them] each in our own dialect in which we have been born,

title: Acts 2:9
text: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and those who inhabit Mesopotamia, and Judaea, and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,

title: Acts 2:10
text: both Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt, and the parts of Libya which adjoin Cyrene, and the Romans sojourning [here], both Jews and proselytes,

title: Acts 2:11
text: Cretans and Arabians, we hear them speaking in our own tongues the great things of God?

title: Acts 2:12
text: And they were all amazed and in perplexity, saying one to another, What would this mean?

title: Acts 2:13
text: But others mocking said, They are full of new wine.

title: Acts 2:14
text: ¶But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke forth to them, Men of Judaea, and all ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and give heed to my words:

title: Acts 2:15
text: for these are not full of wine, as *ye* suppose, for it is the third hour of the day;

title: Acts 2:16
text: but this is that which was spoken through the prophet Joel,

title: Acts 2:17
text: And it shall be in the last days, saith God, [that] I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your elders shall dream with dreams;

title: Acts 2:18
text: yea, even upon my bondmen and upon my bondwomen in those days will I pour out of my Spirit, and they shall prophesy.

title: Acts 2:19
text: And I will give wonders in the heaven above and signs on the earth below, blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

title: Acts 2:20
text: the sun shall be changed to darkness and the moon to blood, before the great and gloriously appearing day of [the] Lord come.

title: Acts 2:21
text: And it shall be that whosoever shall call upon the name of [the] Lord shall be saved.

title: Acts 2:22
text: Men of Israel, hear these words: Jesus the Nazaraean, a man borne witness to by God to you by works of power and wonders and signs, which God wrought by him in your midst, as yourselves know

title: Acts 2:23
text: --him, given up by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye, by [the] hand of lawless [men], have crucified and slain.

title: Acts 2:24
text: Whom God has raised up, having loosed the pains of death, inasmuch as it was not possible that he should be held by its power;

title: Acts 2:25
text: for David says as to him, I foresaw the Lord continually before me, because he is at my right hand that I may not be moved.

title: Acts 2:26
text: Therefore has my heart rejoiced and my tongue exulted; yea more, my flesh also shall dwell in hope,

title: Acts 2:27
text: for thou wilt not leave my soul in hades, nor wilt thou give thy gracious one to see corruption.

title: Acts 2:28
text: Thou hast made known to me [the] paths of life, thou wilt fill me with joy with thy countenance.

title: Acts 2:29
text: Brethren, let it be allowed to speak with freedom to you concerning the patriarch David, that he has both died and been buried, and his monument is amongst us unto this day.

title: Acts 2:30
text: Being therefore a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn to him with an oath, of the fruit of his loins to set upon his throne;

title: Acts 2:31
text: he, seeing [it] before, spoke concerning the resurrection of the Christ, that neither has he been left in hades nor his flesh seen corruption.

title: Acts 2:32
text: This Jesus has God raised up, whereof all *we* are witnesses.

title: Acts 2:33
text: Having therefore been exalted by the right hand of God, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which *ye* behold and hear.

title: Acts 2:34
text: For David has not ascended into the heavens, but he says himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit at my right hand

title: Acts 2:35
text: until I have put thine enemies [to be] the footstool of thy feet.

title: Acts 2:36
text: Let the whole house of Israel therefore know assuredly that God has made him, this Jesus whom *ye* have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

title: Acts 2:37
text: ¶And having heard [it] they were pricked in heart, and said to Peter and the other apostles, What shall we do, brethren?

title: Acts 2:38
text: And Peter said to them, Repent, and be baptised, each one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ, for remission of sins, and ye will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

title: Acts 2:39
text: For to you is the promise and to your children, and to all who [are] afar off, as many as [the] Lord our God may call.

title: Acts 2:40
text: And with many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, Be saved from this perverse generation.

title: Acts 2:41
text: Those then who had accepted his word were baptised; and there were added in that day about three thousand souls.

title: Acts 2:42
text: ¶And they persevered in the teaching and fellowship of the apostles, in breaking of bread and prayers.

title: Acts 2:43
text: And fear was upon every soul, and many wonders and signs took place through the apostles' means.

title: Acts 2:44
text: And all that believed were together, and had all things common,

title: Acts 2:45
text: and sold their possessions and substance, and distributed them to all, according as any one might have need.

title: Acts 2:46
text: And every day, being constantly in the temple with one accord, and breaking bread in [the] house, they received their food with gladness and simplicity of heart,

title: Acts 2:47
text: praising God, and having favour with all the people; and the Lord added [to the assembly] daily those that were to be saved.

title: Acts 3:1
text: ¶And Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, [which is] the ninth [hour];

title: Acts 3:2
text: and a certain man who was lame from his mother's womb was being carried, whom they placed every day at the gate of the temple called Beautiful, to ask alms of those who were going into the temple;

title: Acts 3:3
text: who, seeing Peter and John about to enter into the temple, asked to receive alms.

title: Acts 3:4
text: And Peter, looking stedfastly upon him with John, said, Look on us.

title: Acts 3:5
text: And he gave heed to them, expecting to receive something from them.

title: Acts 3:6
text: But Peter said, Silver and gold I have not; but what I have, this give I to thee: In the name of Jesus Christ the Nazaraean rise up and walk.

title: Acts 3:7
text: And having taken hold of him [by] the right hand he raised him up, and immediately his feet and ankle bones were made strong.

title: Acts 3:8
text: And leaping up he stood and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

title: Acts 3:9
text: And all the people saw him walking and praising God;

title: Acts 3:10
text: and they recognised him, that it was *he* who sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple; and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

title: Acts 3:11
text: And as he held Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the portico which is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

title: Acts 3:12
text: ¶And Peter, seeing it, answered the people, Men of Israel, why are ye astonished at this? or why do ye gaze on us as if we had by our own power or piety made him to walk?

title: Acts 3:13
text: The God of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus, whom *ye* delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when *he* had judged that he should be let go.

title: Acts 3:14
text: But *ye* denied the holy and righteous one, and asked that a man [that was] a murderer should be granted to you;

title: Acts 3:15
text: but the originator of life ye slew, whom God raised from among [the] dead, whereof *we* are witnesses.

title: Acts 3:16
text: And, by faith in his name, his name has made this [man] strong whom ye behold and know; and the faith which is by him has given him this complete soundness in the presence of you all.

title: Acts 3:17
text: And now, brethren, I know that ye did it in ignorance, as also your rulers;

title: Acts 3:18
text: but God has thus fulfilled what he had announced beforehand by the mouth of all the prophets, that his Christ should suffer.

title: Acts 3:19
text: Repent therefore and be converted, for the blotting out of your sins, so that times of refreshing may come from [the] presence of the Lord,

title: Acts 3:20
text: and he may send Jesus Christ, who was foreordained for you,

title: Acts 3:21
text: whom heaven indeed must receive till [the] times of [the] restoring of all things, of which God has spoken by the mouth of his holy prophets since time began.

title: Acts 3:22
text: Moses indeed said, A prophet shall [the] Lord your God raise up to you out of your brethren like me: him shall ye hear in everything whatsoever he shall say to you.

title: Acts 3:23
text: And it shall be that whatsoever soul shall not hear that prophet shall be destroyed from among the people.

title: Acts 3:24
text: And indeed all the prophets from Samuel and those in succession after [him], as many as have spoken, have announced also these days.

title: Acts 3:25
text: *Ye* are the sons of the prophets and of the covenant which God appointed to our fathers, saying to Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

title: Acts 3:26
text: To you first God, having raised up his servant, has sent him, blessing you in turning each one [of you] from your wickedness.

title: Acts 4:1
text: ¶And as they were speaking to the people, the priests and captain of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them,

title: Acts 4:2
text: being distressed on account of their teaching the people and preaching by Jesus the resurrection from among [the] dead;

title: Acts 4:3
text: and they laid hands on them, and put them in ward till the morrow; for it was already evening.

title: Acts 4:4
text: But many of those who had heard the word believed; and the number of the men had become [about] five thousand.

title: Acts 4:5
text: ¶And it came to pass on the morrow that their rulers and elders and scribes were gathered together at Jerusalem,

title: Acts 4:6
text: and Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of [the] high priestly family;

title: Acts 4:7
text: and having placed them in the midst they inquired, In what power or in what name have *ye* done this?

title: Acts 4:8
text: Then Peter, filled with [the] Holy Spirit, said to them, Rulers of the people and elders [of Israel],

title: Acts 4:9
text: if *we* this day are called upon to answer as to the good deed [done] to the infirm man, how *he* has been healed,

title: Acts 4:10
text: be it known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ the Nazaraean, whom *ye* have crucified, whom God has raised from among [the] dead, by *him* this [man] stands here before you sound [in body].

title: Acts 4:11
text: *He* is the stone which has been set at nought by you the builders, which is become the corner stone.

title: Acts 4:12
text: And salvation is in none other, for neither is there another name under heaven which is given among men by which we must be saved.

title: Acts 4:13
text: But seeing the boldness of Peter and John, and perceiving that they were unlettered and uninstructed men, they wondered; and they recognised them that they were with Jesus.

title: Acts 4:14
text: And beholding the man who had been healed standing with them, they had nothing to reply;

title: Acts 4:15
text: ¶but having commanded them to go out of the council they conferred with one another,

title: Acts 4:16
text: saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed an evident sign has come to pass through their means is manifest to all that inhabit Jerusalem, and we cannot deny it.

title: Acts 4:17
text: But that it be not further spread among the people, let us threaten them severely no longer to speak to any man in this name.

title: Acts 4:18
text: And having called them, they charged [them] not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

title: Acts 4:19
text: But Peter and John answering said to them, If it be righteous before God to listen to you rather than to God, judge ye;

title: Acts 4:20
text: for as for us *we* cannot refrain from speaking of the things which we have seen and heard.

title: Acts 4:21
text: But they, having further threatened them, let them go, finding no way how they might punish them, on account of the people, because all glorified God for what had taken place;

title: Acts 4:22
text: for the man on whom this sign of healing had taken place was above forty years old.

title: Acts 4:23
text: ¶And having been let go, they came to their own [company], and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said to them.

title: Acts 4:24
text: And they, having heard [it], lifted up [their] voice with one accord to God, and said, Lord, *thou* art the God who made the heaven and the earth and the sea, and all that is in them;

title: Acts 4:25
text: who hast said by the mouth of thy servant David, Why have [the] nations raged haughtily and [the] peoples meditated vain things?

title: Acts 4:26
text: The kings of the earth were there, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against his Christ.

title: Acts 4:27
text: For in truth against thy holy servant Jesus, whom thou hadst anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with [the] nations, and peoples of Israel, have been gathered together in this city

title: Acts 4:28
text: to do whatever thy hand and thy counsel had determined before should come to pass.

title: Acts 4:29
text: And now, Lord, look upon their threatenings, and give to thy bondmen with all boldness to speak thy word,

title: Acts 4:30
text: in that thou stretchest out thy hand to heal, and that signs and wonders take place through the name of thy holy servant Jesus.

title: Acts 4:31
text: And when they had prayed, the place in which they were assembled shook, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and spoke the word of God with boldness.

title: Acts 4:32
text: ¶And the heart and soul of the multitude of those that had believed were one, and not one said that anything of what he possessed was his own, but all things were common to them;

title: Acts 4:33
text: and with great power did the apostles give witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and great grace was upon them all.

title: Acts 4:34
text: For neither was there any one in want among them; for as many as were owners of lands or houses, selling them, brought the price of what was sold

title: Acts 4:35
text: and laid it at the feet of the apostles; and distribution was made to each according as any one might have need.

title: Acts 4:36
text: And Joseph, who had been surnamed Barnabas by the apostles (which is, being interpreted, Son of consolation), a Levite, Cyprian by birth,

title: Acts 4:37
text: being possessed of land, having sold [it], brought the money and laid it at the feet of the apostles.

title: Acts 5:1
text: ¶But a certain man, Ananias by name, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

title: Acts 5:2
text: and put aside for himself part of the price, [his] wife also being privy to it; and having brought a certain part, laid it at the feet of the apostles.

title: Acts 5:3
text: But Peter said, Ananias, why has Satan filled thy heart that thou shouldest lie to the Holy Spirit, and put aside for thyself a part of the price of the estate?

title: Acts 5:4
text: While it remained did it not remain to *thee*? and sold, was [it not] in thine own power? Why is it that thou hast purposed this thing in thine heart? Thou hast not lied to men, but to God.

title: Acts 5:5
text: And Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and expired. And great fear came upon all who heard [it].

title: Acts 5:6
text: And the young men, rising up, swathed him up for burial, and having carried him out, buried him.

title: Acts 5:7
text: And it came to pass about three hours afterwards, that his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

title: Acts 5:8
text: And Peter answered her, Tell me if ye gave the estate for so much? And she said, Yes, for so much.

title: Acts 5:9
text: And Peter said to her, Why [is it] that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of [the] Lord? Lo, the feet of those that have buried thy husband [are] at the door, and they shall carry thee out.

title: Acts 5:10
text: And she fell down immediately at his feet and expired. And when the young men came in they found her dead; and, having carried her out, they buried her by her husband.

title: Acts 5:11
text: And great fear came upon all the assembly, and upon all who heard these things.

title: Acts 5:12
text: ¶And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders done among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch,

title: Acts 5:13
text: but of the rest durst no man join them, but the people magnified them;

title: Acts 5:14
text: and believers were more than ever added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women;)

title: Acts 5:15
text: so that they brought out the sick into the streets and put [them] on beds and couches, that at least the shadow of Peter, when he came, might overshadow some one of them.

title: Acts 5:16
text: And the multitude also of the cities round about came together to Jerusalem, bringing sick persons and persons beset by unclean spirits, who were all healed.

title: Acts 5:17
text: ¶And the high priest rising up, and all they that were with him, which is the sect of the Sadducees, were filled with wrath,

title: Acts 5:18
text: and laid hands on the apostles and put them in the public prison.

title: Acts 5:19
text: But an angel of [the] Lord during the night opened the doors of the prison, and leading them out, said,

title: Acts 5:20
text: Go ye and stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

title: Acts 5:21
text: And when they heard it, they entered very early into the temple and taught. And when the high priest was come, and they that were with him, they called together the council and all the elderhood of the sons of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

title: Acts 5:22
text: And when the officers were come, they did not find them in the prison; and returned and reported

title: Acts 5:23
text: saying, We found the prison shut with all security, and the keepers standing at the doors; but when we had opened [them], within we found no one.

title: Acts 5:24
text: And when they heard these words, both the priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests were in perplexity as to them, what this would come to.

title: Acts 5:25
text: And some one coming reported to them, Lo, the men whom ye put in the prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.

title: Acts 5:26
text: ¶Then the captain, having gone with the officers, brought them, not with violence, for they feared the people, lest they should be stoned.

title: Acts 5:27
text: And they bring them and set them in the council. And the high priest asked them,

title: Acts 5:28
text: saying, We strictly enjoined you not to teach in this name: and lo, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and purpose to bring upon us the blood of this man.

title: Acts 5:29
text: But Peter answering, and the apostles, said, God must be obeyed rather than men.

title: Acts 5:30
text: The God of our fathers has raised up Jesus, whom *ye* have slain, having hanged on a cross.

title: Acts 5:31
text: Him has God exalted by his right hand as leader and saviour, to give repentance to Israel and remission of sins.

title: Acts 5:32
text: And *we* are [his] witnesses of these things, and the Holy Spirit also, which God has given to those that obey him.

title: Acts 5:33
text: But they, when they heard [these things], were cut to the heart, and took counsel to kill them.

title: Acts 5:34
text: But a certain [man], a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, held in honour of all the people, rose up in the council, and commanded to put the men out for a short while,

title: Acts 5:35
text: and said to them, Men of Israel, take heed to yourselves as regards these men what ye are going to do;

title: Acts 5:36
text: for before these days Theudas rose up, alleging himself to be somebody, to whom a number of men, about four hundred, were joined; who was slain, and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

title: Acts 5:37
text: After him rose Judas the Galilean in the days of the census, and drew away [a number of] people after him; and *he* perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

title: Acts 5:38
text: And now I say to you, Withdraw from these men and let them alone, for if this counsel or this work have its origin from men, it will be destroyed;

title: Acts 5:39
text: but if it be from God, ye will not be able to put them down, lest ye be found also fighters against God.

title: Acts 5:40
text: And they listened to his advice; and having called the apostles, they beat them, and enjoined them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and dismissed them.

title: Acts 5:41
text: They therefore went their way from [the] presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to be dishonoured for the name.

title: Acts 5:42
text: And every day, in the temple and in the houses, they ceased not teaching and announcing the glad tidings that Jesus [was] the Christ.

title: Acts 6:1
text: ¶But in those days, the disciples multiplying in number, there arose a murmuring of the Hellenists against the Hebrews because their widows were overlooked in the daily ministration.

title: Acts 6:2
text: And the twelve, having called the multitude of the disciples to [them], said, It is not right that we, leaving the word of God, should serve tables.

title: Acts 6:3
text: Look out therefore, brethren, from among yourselves seven men, well reported of, full of [the] [Holy] Spirit and wisdom, whom we will establish over this business:

title: Acts 6:4
text: but *we* will give ourselves up to prayer and the ministry of the word.

title: Acts 6:5
text: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and [the] Holy Spirit, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas, a proselyte of Antioch,

title: Acts 6:6
text: whom they set before the apostles; and, having prayed, they laid their hands on them.

title: Acts 6:7
text: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples in Jerusalem was very greatly multiplied, and a great crowd of the priests obeyed the faith.

title: Acts 6:8
text: ¶And Stephen, full of grace and power, wrought wonders and great signs among the people.

title: Acts 6:9
text: And there arose up certain of those of the synagogue called of freedmen, and of Cyrenians, and of Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia, disputing with Stephen.

title: Acts 6:10
text: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the Spirit with which he spoke.

title: Acts 6:11
text: Then they suborned men, saying, We have heard him speaking blasphemous words against Moses and God.

title: Acts 6:12
text: And they roused the people, and the elders, and the scribes. And coming upon [him] they seized him and brought [him] to the council.

title: Acts 6:13
text: And they set false witnesses, saying, This man does not cease speaking words against the holy place and the law;

title: Acts 6:14
text: for we have heard him saying, This Jesus the Nazaraean shall destroy this place, and change the customs which Moses taught us.

title: Acts 6:15
text: And all who sat in the council, looking fixedly on him, saw his face as [the] face of an angel.

title: Acts 7:1
text: ¶And the high priest said, Are these things then so?

title: Acts 7:2
text: And he said, Brethren and fathers, hearken. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

title: Acts 7:3
text: and said to him, Go out of thy land and out of thy kindred, and come into the land which I will shew thee.

title: Acts 7:4
text: Then going out of the land of the Chaldeans he dwelt in Charran, and thence, after his father died, he removed him into this land in which *ye* now dwell.

title: Acts 7:5
text: And he did not give him an inheritance in it, not even what his foot could stand on; and promised to give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when he had no child.

title: Acts 7:6
text: And God spoke thus: His seed shall be a sojourner in a strange land, and they shall enslave them and evil entreat [them] four hundred years;

title: Acts 7:7
text: and the nation to which they shall be in bondage will *I* judge, said God; and after these things they shall come forth and serve me in this place.

title: Acts 7:8
text: And he gave to him [the] covenant of circumcision; and thus he begat Isaac and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac Jacob, and Jacob the twelve patriarchs.

title: Acts 7:9
text: And the patriarchs, envying Joseph, sold him away into Egypt. And God was with him,

title: Acts 7:10
text: and delivered him out of all his tribulations, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he appointed him chief over Egypt and all his house.

title: Acts 7:11
text: But a famine came upon all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great distress, and our fathers found no food.

title: Acts 7:12
text: But Jacob, having heard of there being corn in Egypt, sent out our fathers first;

title: Acts 7:13
text: and the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren, and the family of Joseph became known to Pharaoh.

title: Acts 7:14
text: And Joseph sent and called down to him his father Jacob and all [his] kindred, seventy-five souls.

title: Acts 7:15
text: And Jacob went down into Egypt and died, he and our fathers,

title: Acts 7:16
text: and were carried over to Sychem and placed in the sepulchre which Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the [father] of Sychem.

title: Acts 7:17
text: ¶But as the time of promise drew near which God had promised to Abraham, the people increased and multiplied in Egypt,

title: Acts 7:18
text: until another king over Egypt arose who did not know Joseph.

title: Acts 7:19
text: *He* dealt subtilly with our race, and evil entreated the fathers, casting out their infants that they might not live.

title: Acts 7:20
text: In which time Moses was born, and was exceedingly lovely, who was nourished three months in the house of his father.

title: Acts 7:21
text: And when he was cast out, the daughter of Pharaoh took him up, and brought him up for herself [to be] for a son.

title: Acts 7:22
text: And Moses was instructed in all [the] wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was mighty in his words and deeds.

title: Acts 7:23
text: And when a period of forty years was fulfilled to him, it came into his heart to look upon his brethren, the sons of Israel;

title: Acts 7:24
text: and seeing a certain one wronged, he defended [him], and avenged him that was being oppressed, smiting the Egyptian.

title: Acts 7:25
text: For he thought that his brethren would understand that God by his hand was giving them deliverance. But they understood not.

title: Acts 7:26
text: And on the morrow he shewed himself to them as they were contending, and compelled them to peace, saying, *Ye* are brethren, why do ye wrong one another?

title: Acts 7:27
text: But he that was wronging his neighbour thrust him away, saying, Who established thee ruler and judge over us?

title: Acts 7:28
text: Dost *thou* wish to kill me as thou killedst the Egyptian yesterday?

title: Acts 7:29
text: And Moses fled at this saying, and became a sojourner in the land of Madiam, where he begat two sons.

title: Acts 7:30
text: ¶And when forty years were fulfilled, an angel appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai, in a flame of fire of a bush.

title: Acts 7:31
text: And Moses seeing it wondered at the vision; and as he went up to consider it, there was a voice of [the] Lord,

title: Acts 7:32
text: *I* am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob. And Moses trembled, and durst not consider [it].

title: Acts 7:33
text: And the Lord said to him, Loose the sandal of thy feet, for the place on which thou standest is holy ground.

title: Acts 7:34
text: I have surely seen the ill treatment of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groan, and have come down to take them out of it; and now, come, I will send thee to Egypt.

title: Acts 7:35
text: This Moses, whom they refused, saying, Who made thee ruler and judge? him did God send [to be] a ruler and deliverer with the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

title: Acts 7:36
text: *He* led them out, having wrought wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

title: Acts 7:37
text: This is the Moses who said to the sons of Israel, A prophet shall God raise up to you out of your brethren like me [him shall ye hear].

title: Acts 7:38
text: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness, with the angel who spoke to him in the mount Sinai, and with our fathers; who received living oracles to give to us;

title: Acts 7:39
text: to whom our fathers would not be subject, but thrust [him] from them, and in their hearts turned back to Egypt,

title: Acts 7:40
text: saying to Aaron, Make us gods who shall go before us; for this Moses, who brought us out of the land of Egypt, we know not what has happened to him.

title: Acts 7:41
text: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

title: Acts 7:42
text: ¶But God turned and delivered them up to serve the host of heaven; as it is written in [the] book of the prophets, Have ye offered me victims and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

title: Acts 7:43
text: Yea, ye took up the tent of Moloch, and the star of [your] god Remphan, the forms which ye made to do homage to them; and I will transport you beyond Babylon.

title: Acts 7:44
text: Our fathers had the tent of the testimony in the wilderness, as he that spoke to Moses commanded to make it according to the model which he had seen;

title: Acts 7:45
text: which also our fathers, receiving from their predecessors, brought in with Joshua when they entered into possession of [the lands of] the nations, whom God drove out from [the] face of our fathers, until the days of David;

title: Acts 7:46
text: who found favour before God, and asked to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob;

title: Acts 7:47
text: but Solomon built him a house.

title: Acts 7:48
text: But the Most High dwells not in [places] made with hands; as says the prophet,
